jobs.title: Associate Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Joining Ramboll

As our new Electrical Engineer, you will be joining our Data Center Facilities design team. You'll work on data center projects during every stage of their development with a multidisciplinary team of engineers and designers. You will be involved in developing leading edge electrical infrastructure solutions to address data center designs for some of the industry’s leading names for enterprise, hyperscale and colocation data centers. You will be engaged in solving the engineering challenges associated with AI data centers, and grid capacity constraints. You will work with colleagues from every stage of the development of data centers and their campuses including site selection, environmental and regulatory due diligence, master planning as well as commissioning.

Tasks and Responsibilities

• Preparing basic designs and performs calculations in support of projects, following design, construction and government standards, using design software and drawing tools with supervision
• Analyzing reports, maps, drawings, and other data to plan projects.
• Gathers and records information to be used for writing specifications and review vendor submittals and drawings.
• Visits job sites to gain field experience, broaden background, and develop practical engineering skills.
• Develop a working knowledge of applicable codes and standards.
• Prepares and presents routine technical reports.

Your starting point for constant growth

From the moment you join Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you grow with the company. For this role, we believe your starting point is:

• Candidates should have a B.S or M.S degree in Electrical or Architectural Engineering
• Candidates with course work, or experience related to power systems, architectural or fire alarm design are preferred.
• Excellent verbal and written communication
• Excellent organization and time management
• Ability to work independently and in a team setting
• Familiarity with drawing production tools such as AutoCAD, REVIT is favorable.
• Having passed the Fundamentals of Engineering (EIT) is an advantage and we will support you in pursuit of your PE.

Ramboll in Americas

Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company that has over 2,000 experts working across more than 60 offices in the Americas applying their passion to deliver innovative solutions across Buildings, Transport, Energy, Environment & Health, Water, Management Consulting, and Architecture and Landscape.  As a company, we are committed to reducing our environmental impact, contributing to a cohesive society with equal rights and opportunities for all, and fostering a culture of excellence, enjoyment, and equal opportunities for all our employees. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering culture.

Our Commitment to Sustainability

Responsible business conduct and sustainable practices have been part of Ramboll’s DNA since the company’s inception. Today these principles are an integral part of Our Mission and services and are formalized through our systematic work with the UN sustainable development goals. We are dedicated to taking a leading role in sharing best practices and creating value for clients by delivering solutions that are environmentally, economically, and socially sustainable. We have also committed to ambitious targets to maximize our own sustainability performance and set the industry benchmark.

How to apply

Apply online. Attach your CV, cover letter and relevant documents showcasing why you are the right fit for the role, and when you are available to start. We look forward to receiving your application.

Salary Transparency Statement

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets. The U.S. pay range for this position is $65,000 to $77,500. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do.  Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
We are seeking an Economic Damages & Valuation Director to join our ED&V team. This is a unique opportunity for an entrepreneurial, highly driven professional with a well‑rounded skill set to join the group, whose responsibilities extend beyond those of traditional roles in this space. The ideal person for this position will not only have a strong grasp of economic damages and valuation methodologies but also be flexible and a strategic thinker able to take on a wide variety of tasks.

In this role, you'll work on high‑impact litigation and valuation matters across a wide range of industries, applying your expertise in evaluating economic damages. You’ll use your financial statement analysis skills and experience preparing expert reports to support clients through complex business disputes.

You’ll help lead day‑to‑day project management and client communications across multiple engagements, offering variety, pace, and exposure to challenging cases. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys analytical work and wants to deepen their expertise in economic damages methodologies. Our most successful experts are naturally curious, strong writers, and committed to producing clear, defensible reports that make a meaningful impact for clients.

Job Responsibilities:

• Will help lead complex business litigation engagements to evaluate economic damages
• Building client relationships and acting as a direct contact with current and prospective clients
• Interacting with clients, including face-to-face meetings, to gather data and information pertinent to the engagement
• Providing insight and expertise on target industries, market, and competitor information
• Managing damages analyses, including determining appropriate methodologies and building and reviewing financial models
• Review and analyze reports of opposing damages experts

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree with strong quantitative bias (e.g. Business, Economics, Math, Finance or Accounting)
• Relevant experience evaluating economic damages in business litigation cases (5 years minimum)
• Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word with strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to produce high-quality expert reports.
• Strong project management skills.
• Strong analysis and critical thinking skills.
• Able to meet deadlines while being detail oriented.
• Strong independent work ethic and leadership skills and qualities.
• Exceptional communication skills to support and solve our client’s questions and requests.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Professional certifications (ex. CPA, ASA, CVA, ABV, CFA, etc.), or have demonstrated progress towards obtaining certifications.
• Testimony experience preferred but not required

Physical and Mental Job Qualifications:

• Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

jobs.title: Content Solutions Specialist
jobs.location: New York, NEW YORK, United States
jobs.description:
The Media Operations, Operations & Technology group is responsible for prepping content needed for domestic and international distribution as well as broadcast operations. This includes transcode, edit and delivery services to meet client fulfilment around the globe 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Aside from supporting the day-to-day content supply, this position becomes integral to the success of high-profile LRP and strategic goals. We also support marketing supply chains as well as network stunts and events, which have included the Olympics, FIFA World Cup, and the Superbowl in the past.

The Content Solutions Specialist is responsible for strategy, administration, workflow design & solutions, integrations, and day-to-day operational builds. This role sits at the intersection of business stakeholders, clients, product, engineering, and operations; translating requirements into scalable content supply chain workflows and DAM/MAM solutions that support fast turnaround projects and LRP goals. This role designs and implements automations that support the full media asset lifecycle—from ingest through metadata enrichment & translations, QC, versioning, transcoding, delivery, and archival.

The ideal candidate is deeply technical, operationally minded, and comfortable both gathering requirements from non-technical partners, and working closely with product and engineering to bring short term and long term workflow designs into the larger supply chain.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Design, build, and support end-to-end DAM/MAM supply chain workflows covering: Asset ingest (file- and API-based) Metadata validation, normalization, transformation and enrichment Automated QC and review workflows Transcoding and proxy generation Versioning, derivatives, packaging, and delivery
• Design and support API-based integrations between internal and third-party tooling and clients, for both upstream/downstream systems (e.g., MAMs, encoders, delivery platforms, analytics, metadata stores).
• Partner with Engineering on REST APIs, MCP integrations, webhooks, JSON/XML schemas/contracts, event-driven patterns, and authentication models.
• Build and maintain integration workflows using low-code (Java, YAML, Python, etc.) and automation platforms (e.g., Qibb, Power Automate/Logic Apps, ETLworks, AirTable) to orchestrate cross-system handoffs, automate operational processes and reduce manual touchpoints.
• Build and support ETL metadata architecture, schemas and workflows supporting content ingestion, transformation, validation, enrichment, and fulfillment.
• Support and integrate supplementary CSC/Marketing Supply chain systems including AI Video & Image Technologies, Orange Logic DAM, Telestream Vantage Encoding, AWS EMC, Fabric Metadata, and other marketing, metadata, analytics, and discovery tools that intersect with the media content lifecycle.
• Design and build agentic AI/ML‑enabled workflows using Microsoft Copilot Studio (or equivalent), creating agents that streamline operational pain points, enable self‑service, orchestrate multi‑step workflows, and improve team productivity.
• Create productivity and support solutions using our tools to enhance BAU & Projects.
• Advise and maintain vendor engagement, including feature requests, issue escalation, release validation, and platform upgrade risk/benefits.

Qualifications

Requirements:

• 2+ years of experience in full‑stack development using low‑code platforms to build scalable workflow solutions, leveraging Java, Python, or YAML for customization and integration.
• 3+ years of experience in an operational, product, support or customer facing position for a media or technology company.
• 3+ years experience in a role demonstrating strong technical, quantitative, or analytical skills
• 3+ years experience in a role exhibiting excellent written and oral communications, effective interpersonal skills, project management, and presentation abilities

Desired Characteristics:

• An individual with a strong desire to learn, take on new technologies and challenges.
• Working knowledge of low-code, tools and best practices (python, java, yaml, github, vscode, etc).
• Working knowledge/experience in ML/AI tools, functionality, enablement.
• Ability to write clean documentation, SOPs, enable cross‑team training, and ongoing functional support for platforms and workflows.
• Knowledge of operational ticketing/metrics/tracking systems; Salesforce, Jira, AirTable, SmartSheets, ServiceNow
• Experience with film/tv/media workflow and content supply chain.
• Knowledge of digital media video, audio, components and metadata.
• Experience with DAM/MAM solutions (Orange Logic, Evertz Mediator, Frame.io, etc).
• Experience with file encoders such as Vantage, AWS Elemental MediaConvert, Adobe Media Encoder, etc.
• Excellent troubleshooting, problem solving, and escalation skills.
• Experience working with or supporting post-production software and environments such Avid Media Composer, Adobe Suite, Final Cut Pro. Etc.
• Experience with digital delivery methods, such as AWS, Aspera, Signiant, etc.
• Experience with QC Software such as Baton, Quasar, GrayMeta Iris, Switch etc.
• Experience with Closed Caption creation, editing and converting (CapMate, TimedText Flip, CaptionCreator, etc)
• Experience supporting customer workflows through operations team and/or help desk.

• Strong ability to multi-task and make effective decisions in a high-pressure deadline driven environment.

Additional Requirements:

General

• Business proficiency in English AND either Spanish or Portuguese.

Projects

jobs.title: Senior Staff Digital Engineer
jobs.description:
Renesas is seeking an experienced Senior Staff Digital Engineer to lead verification and evidence

development for control-loop features and functions in advanced digital power management products

used in AI, datacenter, and high-performance computing applications.

This role focuses on proving that specific control-loop features behave as intended across requirements,

behavioral models, digital implementation, analog interactions, simulation, emulation, bench validation,

and silicon.

The successful candidate will translate feature intent into measurable test plans, define clear pass/fail

criteria, develop reusable verification methods, and correlate results across engineering environments.

The role requires a strong understanding of digital control loops, mixed-signal behavior, power-system

dynamics, data analysis, and verification automation.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on control-loop expertise with disciplined verification and the

ability to identify and resolve differences between expected behavior, implementation results, and

measured performance.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

• Build clear, repeatable evidence that control-loop features and functions operate as intended.
• Improve confidence in feature and architecture decisions by connecting requirements, models, implementation, tests, and measured results.
• Identify feature-level gaps and unexpected interactions before they become product or customer issues.
• Create reusable verification methods that improve engineering quality and reduce repeated manual testing.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Lead verification and evidence development for digital control-loop features and functions.
• Translate feature requirements and system intent into measurable verification plans, test scenarios, and pass/fail criteria.
• Verify control-loop behavior across operating conditions, configurations, limits, sequencing, and corner cases.
• Develop tests covering compensation, stability, bandwidth, transient response, latency, sampling, quantization, saturation, limits, mode transitions, sensing behavior, telemetry, and feature interactions.
• Correlate feature behavior across behavioral models, RTL, analog/mixed-signal simulation, emulation, bench validation, and silicon measurements where applicable.
• Evaluate interactions between digital loop functions and analog components, including sensing paths, ADCs, DACs, references, PWM generation, timing paths, and power stages.
• Produce clear verification evidence containing test conditions, configurations, metrics, plots, waveforms, results, conclusions, and identified risks.
• Develop reusable automation for parameter sweeps, corner testing, waveform analysis, regression testing, and evidence generation.
• Investigate discrepancies between expected feature behavior and results from simulation, emulation, bench testing, or silicon.
• Collaborate with systems, analog design, digital design, firmware, design verification, validation, applications, and software/tool teams.
• Identify missing requirements, test coverage, observability, or infrastructure needed to verify loop features effectively.
• Document test intent, assumptions, configurations, results, limitations, and residual risks clearly for technical and leadership audiences.
• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers working on control-loop verification and validation.

Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• 8+ years of relevant experience in digital power control, mixed-signal verification, semiconductor validation, systems engineering, power electronics, design verification, or related product development.
• Strong understanding of feedback control systems, including compensation, stability, bandwidth, transient response, latency, sampling, quantization, saturation, and nonlinear behavior.
• Experience verifying or validating control-loop features and functions using measurable engineering evidence.
• Strong understanding of mixed-signal building blocks such as ADCs, DACs, sensing paths, amplifiers, references, timing circuits, PWM paths, and power stages.
• Experience developing test plans, test scenarios, pass/fail criteria, metrics, and technical evidence for complex electronic systems.
• Ability to analyze waveforms and data, isolate behavioral differences, and connect observed results to feature intent and implementation.
• Ability to independently lead technically complex verification activities from requirements through final correlation and documentation.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex loop behavior and verification results clearly

PREFERRED

• Experience with digital multiphase controllers, DC/DC converters, voltage regulators, power management ICs, or high-current datacenter power applications.
• Experience with model-to-silicon correlation, behavioral modeling, real-number modeling, Verilog-AMS, SystemVerilog RNM, MATLAB, Python, SIMPLIS, or equivalent environments.
• Experience with verification automation, data analysis, test infrastructure, dashboards, databases, or API-driven workflows.
• Familiarity with control loops, stability, latency, quantization, noise, telemetry, and power-system measurement techniques.
• Experience creating reusable verification frameworks that improve quality and reduce repeated manual test setup.

jobs.title: Sr Digital Engineer
jobs.description:
Renesas is seeking an experienced Senior Digital Engineer to develop and execute verification for control-loop features and functions in advanced digital power management products used in AI, datacenter, and high-performance computing applications.

This role focuses on verifying that specific control-loop features behave as intended across behavioral models, digital implementation, analog interactions, simulation, emulation, bench validation, and silicon.

The successful candidate will translate feature requirements into measurable test scenarios, execute verification plans, analyze results, and help correlate behavior across engineering environments. The role requires a solid understanding of digital control loops, mixed-signal systems, power-system behavior, data analysis, and verification automation.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on engineering experience with disciplined verification practices and the ability to investigate differences between expected behavior, implementation results, and measured performance.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

• Create clear, repeatable verification evidence that control-loop features and functions operate as intended.

• Improve confidence in feature implementation by connecting requirements, models, tests, and measured results.

• Identify feature-level issues and unexpected interactions before they become product or customer problems.

• Develop reusable test methods that improve verification quality and reduce repeated manual effort.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and execute verification plans for digital control-loop features and functions.

• Translate feature requirements and system intent into measurable test scenarios and pass/fail criteria.

• Verify control-loop behavior across operating conditions, configurations, limits, sequencing, and corner cases.

• Develop tests covering compensation, stability, bandwidth, transient response, latency, sampling, quantization, saturation, mode transitions, sensing behavior, telemetry, protection, and feature interactions.

• Analyze feature behavior using behavioral models, RTL simulations, analog/mixed-signal simulations, emulation, bench measurements, and silicon results where applicable.

• Correlate results across models, simulation, emulation, bench validation, and silicon to identify differences and support engineering decisions.

• Evaluate interactions between digital loop functions and analog components, including sensing paths, ADCs, DACs, references, PWM generation, timing paths, and power stages.

• Produce clear verification evidence that documents test conditions, configurations, metrics, plots, waveforms, results, and conclusions.

• Develop and maintain automation for parameter sweeps, corner testing, waveform analysis, regression testing, and verification reporting.

• Investigate discrepancies between expected feature behavior and results obtained from simulation, emulation, bench testing, or silicon.

• Collaborate with systems, analog design, digital design, firmware, design verification, validation, applications, and software/tool teams.

• Identify missing requirements, test coverage, observability, or infrastructure that could prevent effective feature verification.

• Document test intent, assumptions, test configurations, results, limitations, and identified risks clearly.

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• 5+ years of relevant experience in digital power control, mixed-signal verification, semiconductor validation, systems engineering, power electronics, design verification, or related product development.

• Solid understanding of feedback control systems, including compensation, stability, bandwidth, transient response, latency, sampling, quantization, saturation, and nonlinear behavior.

• Experience testing or verifying digital control functions, mixed-signal systems, power-management features, or other complex electronic systems.

• Understanding of mixed-signal building blocks such as ADCs, DACs, sensing paths, amplifiers, references, timing circuits, PWM paths, and power stages.

• Experience developing and executing test plans, test scenarios, pass/fail criteria, and measurable engineering results.

• Ability to analyze waveforms and data, isolate behavioral differences, and relate observed results to feature requirements and implementation.

• Experience with scripting or programming for test automation, data analysis, or verification infrastructure.

• Ability to work effectively across systems, analog, digital, firmware, verification, validation, applications, and software/tool disciplines.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical results clearly.

PREFERRED

• Experience with digital multiphase controllers, DC/DC converters, voltage regulators, power management ICs, or high-current datacenter power applications.

• Experience verifying digital compensation, current balancing, current estimation, adaptive control, transient enhancement, telemetry, protection, or other loop-related features.

• Experience with behavioral modeling, model correlation, real-number modeling, Verilog-AMS, SystemVerilog RNM, MATLAB, Python, SIMPLIS, or equivalent environments.

• Experience with RTL simulation, mixed-signal simulation, bench automation, or semiconductor validation.

• Experience automating parameter sweeps, corner testing, waveform analysis, regression testing, or verification reporting.

• Familiarity with Bode analysis, gain and phase margin, load-transient testing, output-impedance analysis, timing measurements, latency measurements, and power-system measurement techniques.

• Familiarity with structured test results, dashboards, databases, or API-driven engineering workflows.

• Experience debugging differences among feature specifications, behavioral models, RTL implementation, bench results, and silicon measurements.

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Digital Systems & Emulation Engineer
jobs.description:
Renesas is seeking an experienced Senior Staff Digital Systems & Emulation Engineer  to develop and drive advanced pre-silicon emulation and digital system validation for next-generation power management products targeting AI, datacenter, and high-performance computing applications.

This role will focus on bridging system architecture, digital design, FPGA/emulation, control algorithms, and hardware validation, enabling complex digital power-management functions to be exercised and validated ahead of silicon availability.

The successful candidate will combine strong digital design fundamentals with hands-on FPGA and emulation expertise and a working knowledge of digital signal processing and control techniques. The engineer will work closely with System Architecture, Digital Design, Firmware, Design Verification, Analog/Mixed-Signal Design, Applications, and Validation teams to translate product requirements and algorithms into executable real-time prototypes.

The position is a senior individual-contributor role with significant technical ownership and influence on emulation architecture, methodology, and future development platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Emulation & FPGA Development

• Architect, develop, and maintain FPGA-based emulation platforms for advanced digital power controllers and mixed-signal power-management products.

• Map and integrate production or representative RTL into FPGA/emulation environments for pre-silicon feature development and validation.

• Develop reusable FPGA infrastructure, interfaces, test capabilities, and debug methodologies supporting multiple product generations.

• Develop and improve build, configuration, automation, and debug flows to make emulation environments accessible and repeatable across engineering teams.

• Support integration of FPGA/emulated controllers with real power stages, loads, instrumentation, and system-level hardware.

• Identify differences between ASIC and FPGA implementation and develop appropriate strategies to maintain meaningful system-level behavior and correlation.

Digital Systems & RTL

• Understand and contribute to digital system architecture, microarchitecture, and RTL implementation where required.

• Analyze timing, latency, clock-domain, interface, datapath, and real-time execution requirements relevant to system behavior.

• Develop or modify synthesizable RTL blocks required for emulation, instrumentation, prototyping, and architectural exploration.

• Support integration and debug of digital interfaces, ADC/DAC data paths, PWM generation, telemetry, protection functions, state machines, and embedded control logic.

• Work with Digital Design and Verification teams to correlate behavior between behavioral models, RTL simulation, emulation, and silicon.

DSP & Control Algorithm Implementation

• Support implementation and evaluation of digital control and signal-processing functions used within power-management systems.

• Translate mathematical or system-level algorithms into practical fixed-point and real-time digital implementations.

• Evaluate effects of sampling rate, latency, quantization, numerical precision, filtering, and computational architecture on system performance.

• Implement and evaluate digital filters, signal conditioning, control-loop functions, and related DSP algorithms where required.

• Collaborate with system architects to rapidly prototype new algorithms before committing them to production RTL.

System-Level Validation

• Develop system-level emulation scenarios representing realistic customer use cases and operating conditions.

• Define measurable pass/fail criteria and validation methodologies for new architectural features.

• Correlate emulation results with simulation, behavioral models, bench measurements, and silicon measurements where available.

• Support pre-silicon validation of control-loop behavior, transient response, telemetry, protection mechanisms, sequencing, communication interfaces, and other system-level functions.

• Perform detailed debug across hardware, RTL, firmware, and system boundaries to identify root causes of complex issues.

Methodology & Technical Leadership

• Define and improve methodologies for FPGA prototyping and emulation of mixed-signal and digitally controlled power systems.

• Develop reusable architectures, automation, scripts, and engineering workflows that reduce setup and debug time.

• Participate in architecture, design, and verification reviews and provide technical guidance on emulation feasibility and implementation trade-offs.

• Work independently on complex technical problems and drive issues to resolution across organizational boundaries.

• Mentor engineers in FPGA, digital design, emulation, and system-debug techniques.

• Document architecture, implementation, test methodology, limitations, and results to enable reuse across programs.

Required

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
• 10+ years of relevant industry experience in digital design, FPGA development, emulation, or related semiconductor development.
• Strong hands-on experience with FPGA architecture, implementation, integration, and debug.
• Strong knowledge of Verilog and/or SystemVerilog RTL design.
• Good understanding of digital design fundamentals including clocks, resets, CDC, state machines, datapaths, pipelining, timing, and hardware interfaces.
• Experience with FPGA synthesis, implementation, timing analysis, and hardware bring-up.
• Experience developing scripting and automation using Python, TCL, shell, or similar languages.
• Hands-on experience debugging complex interactions between RTL, firmware/software, and hardware.
• Ability to interpret system requirements and translate them into practical emulation and validation architectures.
• Strong technical documentation and communication skills.
• Demonstrated ability to work effectively across geographically distributed and cross-functional engineering teams.

Preferred

• Experience with semiconductor pre-silicon emulation or FPGA prototyping.
• Experience with major FPGA platforms and development environments.
• Knowledge of digital signal processing, including digital filters, fixed-point arithmetic, sampling, quantization, and signal-processing datapaths.
• Understanding of digital control systems and feedback-loop concepts.
• Experience with digital power management, multiphase voltage regulators, PMICs, or mixed-signal ICs.
• Familiarity with ADC/DAC interfaces, PWM generation, telemetry, high-speed digital interfaces, and real-time control systems.
• Experience correlating behavioral models, RTL simulations, FPGA/emulation results, and laboratory measurements.
• Familiarity with Python-based modeling, data analysis, and automated hardware validation.
• Experience developing reusable FPGA/emulation platforms supporting multiple products or development teams.

Key Attributes

The ideal candidate is a hands-on senior technical contributor who is comfortable moving between system concepts, algorithms, RTL, FPGA implementation, and laboratory hardware. The candidate should be able to take an architectural concept, determine how it can be emulated, implement the required infrastructure, demonstrate it operating in real time, and provide objective data that allows the engineering team to make product decisions.

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. Even if you just need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

We are searching for qualified customer service reps with personality and people skills. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, drop us a line. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From customer service representative to management, General Manager to Manager Corporate Operations or Franchisee, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

JOB REQUIREMENTS

You must be 16 years of age or older.

General Job Duties For All Store Team Members

· Operate all equipment.

· Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

· Prepare product.

· Receive and process telephone orders.

· Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

· Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

· Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

· Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

· Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

· Must be able to make correct monetary change.

· Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

· Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

· In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

· Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

· Fumes from food odors.

· Exposure to cornmeal dust.

· Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

· Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

· Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

· Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

· Depth perception.

· Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

Additional Information:

• Pay range $17.13 to $22.00 per hour
• Healthcare (after 90 days and must work 40 hours)
• Flexible schedule
• Employee discounts
• Washington paid sick leave

Must be 18 years or older

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4".

Walking

For short distances for short durations

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

· Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

· Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

· Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

· Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

· Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

· Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

· To move trays which are placed on dollies.

· A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

· Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

· Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

· Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

· Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

· Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

· Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

· Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

· Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

· Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

· Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

· Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

· Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

· Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

· Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

jobs.title: Vegetables Seed Production Intern
jobs.description:
At Syngenta, our goal is to build the most collaborative and trustworthy team in agriculture, providing top-quality seeds and innovative crop protection solutions that improve farmers' success. We invite you to help shape the future of agriculture and play a role in safely feeding the world while caring for our planet.

Syngenta's SE Production Operations Team is seeking a Vegetables Seed Production Intern in Woodland, CA. This internship role will execute established Small Seed Vegetables (SSV) production activities to assure that Syngenta has a consistent, timely, and reliable supply of high-quality seed in the Cage Production and Commercial Open Field Program.

As part of Syngenta's Emerging Talent Program, you will gain hands-on experience, exposure to day-to-day business operations, and opportunities to apply your academic knowledge to real-world challenges while developing your professional skills.

Accountabilities:

• Foster an operational culture founded on adherence to all applicable HSE and other corporate policies, procedures, and guidelines.
• Support Agronomists and Field Production Technicians in field-related activities as directed at the Woodland, California production site.
• Participate in accurate and timely crop scouting and data collection of emergence and vegetative growth stages, pollination dates, stand counts, and IPM scouting thresholds.
• Perform activities related to planting, scouting, weed and insect management, rouging, safety, training, harvesting, and reporting at the site.
• Perform a project to study potential production improvements. Present findings to the Field Production Team in Woodland, California.
• Ensure all clean-downs and changeovers are done correctly to eliminate any product mixture.
• Actively support an image that reflects the highest regard for cleanliness and organization.
• Perform other duties as required to meet field operations needs.

• Support field activities, such as trial coordination, rouging, disease and weed scouting, pollination, harvesting, threshing, drying, and delivery from grower to processing facility.
• Complete data validation and reports to support global and regional operations needs, comprising equipment run time and scheduling needs.
• Support Quality and HSE functions to drive key programs and targeted metrics.
• Cooperate with Field Quality and Production Research personnel to identify, develop, and implement projects to improve reliability, quality, and/or cost.

• A High School Diploma or equivalent.
• Enrollment in a Bachelor’s or advanced degree program in an applicable discipline (Agronomy, Agricultural Business, Plant Science/Biology, or another closely related major is preferred).

Desired Qualifications:

• Students with Sophomore or Junior class standing are highly encouraged to apply.
• Bilingual (English and Spanish) is ideal but not required.
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization.
• Self-motivated, go-getter with a strong results orientation.
• The ability to analyze crops and communicate information (written and spoken) is highly desired in this position.
• Trusted: Will need to make sound judgment calls regarding seed quality management that are in the best interest of the company.
• Excellent computer skills, such as proficiency in both Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word.
• Innovative: Always looking to improve work efficiency and field-related technologies.
• Detail/Accuracy-Oriented: All procedures and policies must be understood and followed.

· Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

· Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

· Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

· Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

· Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

· Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

· Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

· During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Pushing

· To move trays which are placed on dollies.

· A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

· Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

· Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

· During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

Stooping/Bending

· Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

· Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

· Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

· Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

· Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

· Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

· Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

· Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Driving

· Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Hand Tasks

· Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

· Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

· Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

· Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

· Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Driving Specific Job Duties

· Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

· Deliver flyers and door hangers.

Requires

· Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

· Access to insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

jobs.title: Staff or Senior Staff Geotechnical Engineer or Geologist
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Staff or Senior Staff-level Geotechnical Engineer or Geologist to support a wide range of geotechnical engineering projects. This role involves both field and office responsibilities, including geotechnical investigations, engineering analyses, construction observation, laboratory coordination, and report preparation.

Responsibilities

• Conduct geotechnical investigations and engineering analyses for commercial, residential, industrial, and public works projects.
• Plan and coordinate subsurface exploration programs, including boring layouts and utility clearance activities.

• Classify soils and geologic materials and prepare detailed logs of borings, test pits, and cores.

• Conduct floor level surveys and other site evaluations as required.
• Review project plans, specifications, and geotechnical data.
• Coordinate laboratory testing programs and evaluate test results.
• Perform geotechnical calculations and engineering analyses, including:Slope stability analysesLiquefaction evaluationsDynamic settlement analysesDeep foundation and pile design evaluations
• Prepare geotechnical reports, technical memoranda, letters, and engineering recommendations.

Required Qualifications

• Minimum of 1 year (Staff level) or 3 years (Senior Staff level) of geotechnical engineering experience; experience with a geotechnical consulting firm preferred.
• Strong understanding of soil mechanics, geotechnical engineering principles, and subsurface investigation methods.

jobs.title: Broker Direct Specialist (BDR/SDR)
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Broker Direct Specialist is responsible for proactively contacting approved mortgage brokers and loan officers to generate new lending opportunities, re-engage inactive relationships, and drive loan submissions. The role supports the existing sales organization by creating meaningful conversations, identifying viable loan opportunities, and completing warm handoffs to the Account Executive who owns the protected broker relationship.

This is a high-activity outbound sales position focused on relationship activation, lead development, and opportunity generation. The company will provide calling lists, targeted campaigns, and sales scripts based on the product or program being promoted.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Make 50-75 outbound calls per day to approved mortgage brokers and loan officers assigned through company-provided lead lists.
• Use the approved sales script for the product, program, or campaign being targeted.
• Engage loan officers in meaningful live conversations to identify interest, lending needs, and potential loan scenarios.
• Generate qualified opportunities and complete warm handoffs to the Account Executive assigned to the protected broker account.
• Ensure the ongoing broker and loan officer relationship is transitioned back to the protected Account Executive.
• Educate loan officers on company products, programs, technology, and value proposition.
• Meet established minimum talk-time expectations.
• Document every call, conversation, follow-up, and handoff accurately and promptly in the company CRM.
• Manage follow-up activities and maintain an organized pipeline of prospects and opportunities.
• Collaborate with Account Executives and sales leadership to support a seamless customer experience and effective opportunity transfer.
• Participate in product training, sales coaching, team meetings, and ongoing professional development.

Key Performance Indicators

Specific performance targets will be established by sales leadership. Performance will be measured using activity, engagement, and production results, including:

• Outbound calls completed
• Live conversations with loan officers
• Minimum talk time
• CRM documentation compliance
• New loan officers signed up per month
• Qualified handoffs to existing Account Executives
• Loan submissions generated
• Funded loans generated from Broker Direct activity

Qualifications

Required

• High school diploma or equivalent.
• Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
• Comfort with high-volume outbound calling and working toward measurable goals.
• Strong organization, follow-up, and time-management skills.
• Ability to learn mortgage products, sales concepts, and company systems.
• Basic computer skills and the ability to maintain accurate CRM records.
• Positive attitude, persistence, professionalism, and willingness to accept coaching.

Preferred

• Prior call center, telemarketing, customer service, or inside sales experience.
• Mortgage, lending, or financial services experience. Mortgage experience is helpful but not required.
• Experience working in a performance-driven sales environment.

Work Environment and Schedule

• In-office position, five days per week.
• Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM.
• 30-minute lunch.
• Regular and reliable in-office attendance is required.

Compensation

• Competitive base.
• Bonus opportunity based on performance.
• Specific compensation details will be communicated separately.

Career Growth Opportunity

The Broker Direct Specialist role is designed as a developmental sales position. After one year in the role, successful team members may be considered for career advancement based on performance, demonstrated readiness, and business needs.

What Success Looks Like

The successful Broker Direct Specialist is energetic, persistent, organized, and comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls. The individual consistently creates productive conversations, uncovers lending opportunities, maintains complete CRM records, and completes effective handoffs that help Account Executives convert opportunities into submissions and funded loans.

jobs.title: Soil Spectroscopy and Chemometrics Co-op
jobs.description:
At Syngenta, our goal is to build the most collaborative and trustworthy team in agriculture, providing top-quality seeds and innovative crop protection solutions that improve farmers' success. We invite you to help shape the future of agriculture and play a role in safely feeding the world while caring for our planet.

Syngenta's Seeds Research Portfolio and Project Management Team is seeking a Soil Spectroscopy and Chemometrics Co-op in Des Moines, IA. This internship role will work with our soil scientists and data scientists on projects that leverage Fourier-transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy and advanced chemometric and machine learning methods to rapidly characterize soil properties at scale.

As a co-op, you will work at the intersection of soil science, spectroscopy, and data science, developing and validating calibration models, exploring novel modeling approaches, and helping establish workflows that connect spectral data to actionable agronomic insights.

As part of Syngenta's Emerging Talent Program, you will gain hands-on experience, exposure to day-to-day business operations, and opportunities to apply your academic knowledge to real-world challenges while developing your professional skills.

Duration: May 2027 – August 2027

Accountabilities:

• Build, evaluate, and refine calibration models that predict soil physical and chemical properties (e.g., organic carbon, texture, pH, CEC, nutrients) from infrared spectra.
• Apply spectral preprocessing techniques (e.g., Savitzky-Golay derivatives, scatter correction, baseline correction) and evaluate their impact on model performance.
• Work with large soil spectral libraries, comprising instrument standardization and calibration transfer challenges.
• Develop and compare chemometric (PLSR) and machine learning (Random Forest, CNN, etc.) approaches for soil property prediction.
• Collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary team of soil scientists, agronomists, and data scientists.
• Communicate methods and results clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• The intern will operate in accordance with Syngenta Health, Safety, & Environmental (HSE) standards.

• Student must be currently pursuing a Ph.D. in Soil Science, Environmental Science, Chemometrics, Data Science, Agricultural Engineering, Analytical Chemistry, or a related field. Advanced Ph.D. students with existing spectroscopy or chemometrics research experience are strongly preferred.
• Must be a current student continuing their education upon completion of the co-op term (May 2027 through August 2027).
• All applicants must be eligible to work in the U.S.
• Demonstrated experience with vibrational spectroscopy data (MIR, NIR, and/or Vis-NIR), such as spectral preprocessing and multivariate calibration.
• Proficiency in one or more programming languages used in chemometrics and data science (R, Python).
• Experience accessing and working with soil spectral libraries (e.g., USDA KSSL, OSSL).
• Experience with chemometric methods (particularly Partial Least Squares Regression) and familiarity with machine learning approaches for spectral data (e.g., Random Forest, CNNs, transformer-based models).
• Understanding of soil science fundamentals, including soil properties, analytical methods, and the physical basis of spectral absorption features in soils.
• Scientific curiosity and passion for creative problem-solving.
• Ability to communicate complex ideas and results in a clear and actionable manner.
• Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.
• Familiarity with calibration transfer methods and multi-instrument workflows is a plus.

Salary for this position ranges between $20 - $45 hourly.

What We Offer:

• A culture that celebrates belonging and collaboration, promotes professional development and strives for a work-life balance that supports the team members.
• ⁠Competitive wages
• Ongoing career development resources
• The opportunity to work on meaningful, innovative projects that solve problems

Syngenta is committed to creating a culture that celebrates belonging and collaboration, promotes professional development, and strives for a work-life balance that supports the team members

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager (MA Only)
jobs.description:
Career Progression & Growth Potential

By mastering the workshop dynamics, competitive landscape, and requirement translation early on, you will support product ownership and take on strategic customer account responsibility (managing major aftermarket accounts and high-level commercial partnerships for Bosch).

Role Mission

The Sr Product Manager for PAD Product Area supports the growth, portfolio health, and roadmap execution for the North American aftermarket. We are looking for an inquisitive individual who aims for clarity and is deeply passionate about the automotive aftermarket, vehicle diagnostics, and hands-on vehicle repair.

You will help collect, structure and consolidate various inputs to VOC via workshop insights, strategic partner feedback, field issues and competitive benchmarking into clear JIRA requirements to support the development of the product platform. The goal is these insights ensure customer pain points are translated into highly actionable product improvements and enhancements that directly enable our product offering and roadmap.

The dual role of the Product Manager is also to serve as a Technical Account Manager to strategic accounts where you will represent the product management activities (roadmap and enhancement developments) with key customers for the PAD portfolio of Diagnostics, RDS, ADAS and Accessories.

Key Responsibilities & Tasks

Translating Insights to Requirements

• Translate Feedback to Requirements: Collect and aggregate various VOC feedback from Strategic Partners, workshop visits, field feedback to translate workshop pain points and competitive gaps into clear, logical product enhancement ideas.
• Draft JIRA Input: Enter and draft clear, well-structured user stories or tickets in JIRA. This ensures the customer’s voice is accurately documented, and drive these requirements through engineering.
• JIRA Alignment: Ensure all administrative tracking within requirements management tools is maintained and clean.

Technical Account Management

• You will be assigned key accounts where we offer customized diagnostic and RDS solutions
• Help design and drive customer specific solutions
• Develop, drive and communicate customer-specific roadmap internally and externally
• Be the one face to the customer from a perspective

PAD Portfolio & Database Management (Phase-In / Phase-Out)

• Execute System Phase-In & Phase-Out: Take primary responsibility for the database lifecycle of diagnostic products by coordinating the phase-in of new products and phase-out/EOL of legacy SKUs.

Competitor Benchmarking & Roadmap Enablement

• Execute Competitor Benchmarking: Conduct hands-on analysis of competitive aftermarket diagnostic tools (evaluating vehicle coverage, software updates, speed, UI/UX)
• Collect & Structure Insights: Compile and synthesize benchmarking data into highly organized summaries, tables, and reports.
• Enable the Product Offering: Evaluate data and evidence needed to make strategic portfolio decisions, validate business cases, and define the North American product strategy.

Workshop Research & Technician Pain Points

• Immerse in the Workshop: Actively engage with real-world technicians, shop owners, and diagnostic tool users in their environment to build a profound understanding of their daily workflows and struggles.
• Coordinate Focus Groups: Support and facilitate workshop focus groups, user panels, and surveys to capture qualitative and quantitative feedback.
• Ensure Pain Point Clarity: analyze technician feedback to get absolute clarity on why certain diagnostic features fail or succeed in the field, ensuring we have a true, unfiltered understanding of the customer’s needs.

• Bachelor’s degree in Automotive Technology, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or Business Administration with a strong technical background.
• 5+ years of professional experience, ideally within the automotive aftermarket, vehicle repair, or diagnostics software.
• Database & Portfolio Management : Strong attention to detail with experience or high capability in managing product master databases, SKUs, and product lifecycles (phase-in / phase-out).
• Technical Tools: Familiarity with JIRA or other requirement tracking tools is highly preferred.
• Analytical Translation: Strong capability to compile competitor benchmarking and qualitative user feedback into structured, clear data for the Product Manager.
• Customer Empathy: Exceptional ability to connect with workshop technicians, understand their pain points, and advocate for their needs.
• Domain Passion: A genuine interest in car repair, OBD diagnostics, and automotive aftermarket technology is highly preferred.
• Career Ambition: Highly motivated to learn the ropes of product management and eventually grow into a Product Manager / Senior PM with strategic customer account responsibility.
• Core Soft Skills: Proactive, inquisitive, naturally seeks clarity, and is comfortable multi-tasking across different portfolio and research tasks.

jobs.title: Sterling Subject Matter Expert
jobs.description:
At Precisely, we're not just building software — we're shaping the future of data integrity. As a global leader in data quality, data enrichment, and location intelligence, Precisely helps thousands of the world's most trusted brands make confident decisions with data they can rely on. We're an AI-first organization, which means artificial intelligence isn't a buzzword here — it's woven into how we build products, how we work, and how we think about solving complex problems for our customers. When you join Precisely, you join a team of curious, driven innovators who believe that better data makes the world run better. If you're ready to do meaningful work at the intersection of AI and data — and help define what's possible — we'd love for you to apply!

This position is 100% remote anywhere in the US

Overview:

Precisely is the leader in data integrity. We empower businesses to make more confident decisions based on trusted data through a unique combination of software, data enrichment products and strategic services. What does this mean to you? For starters, it means joining a company focused on delivering outstanding innovation and support that helps customers increase revenue, lower costs and reduce risk. In fact, Precisely powers better decisions for more than 12,000 global organizations, including 95 of the Fortune 100. Precisely's 2500 employees are unified by four company core values that are central to who we are and how we operate: Openness, Determination, Individuality, and Collaboration. We are committed to career development for our employees and offer opportunities for growth, learning and building community. With a "work from anywhere" culture, we celebrate diversity in a distributed environment with a presence in 30 countries as well as 20 offices in over 5 continents. Learn more about why it's an exciting time to join Precisely!

The Sterling SME reports to the Director of OEM Partnerships and works closely with Precisely Sterling Support, Engineering, and Professional Services, and across the IBM Sterling seller and delivery ecosystem to win, accelerate, and protect Sterling revenue. This is a remote position anywhere in the US.

What you will do:

• Serve as the technical bridge between IBM's Sterling ecosystem and Precisely's ability to win, accelerate, and protect Sterling revenue

• Own technical field enablement across the full IBM Sterling seller ecosystem, Technology Sellers, Expert Labs architects, Brand Sales Specialists, and Business Partners

• Qualify deals, assist with configurations, size environments, and run demos to advance IBM technology seller pipeline

• Train the trainers by building Sterling knowledge and deal readiness across IBM’s technical seller audiences

• Scope PS engagements pre-sale, hand off cleanly to the Precisely Sterling delivery team at close, and engage IBM Sterling Business Partners for post-sale delivery

• Develop and deliver technical pre-sales enablement content: prospecting guides, call scripts, competitive positioning, and objection-handling frameworks

• Deliver solution demonstrations and architecture discussions calibrated to audience, from C-suite briefings to engineering-level design sessions partnering with Precisely Product, Engineering, Support, and PS.

• Provide field feedback to Precisely Product, Engineering, Support, and PS teams to inform roadmaps and GTM priorities

• Serve as the advocate between Precisely and IBM's Sterling technology sellers to build awareness, advance pipeline, and close deals

What we are looking for:

• 7+ years in technical sales, pre-sales, sales engineering, or customer support with IBM Sterling B2Bi

• Demonstrated ability to engage technical practitioners and executive stakeholders across complex buyer and seller teams

• Proven experience scoping and positioning professional services engagements, delivery boundaries, SOW basics, and client expectation-setting

• Experience in OEM, reseller, or co-sell partner sales motions

• Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to develop technical sales and enablement content independently

• Willingness to travel 10–20% for field engagement (F2F enablement sessions, IBM offices, client sites, events)

• Deep Sterling B2Bi product expertise, hands-on across administration, configuration, development, support, and deployment

• Ability to juggle multiple concurrent sales cycles, enablement programs, and reporting obligations in a fast-paced partner environment

AI Skills / Knowledge

• Proficient in using AI tools (Copilot, Claude, or equivalent) to accelerate technical documentation, solution write-ups, cadence content, competitive analysis, and building and supporting demos using AI and Sterling AI agents

• Ability to engage IBM technical sellers, sellers, and clients on AI and Agentic trends, specifically how Precisely's AI expertise with Sterling AI agents supports IBM clients' Sterling transformation roadmaps

• Stays current on Sterling ecosystem dynamics and IBM GTM shifts using AI-assisted research, able to qualify and position Precisely's AI-ready data positioning without overpromising

Preferred Skills

• Experience working within or alongside Precisely or IBM Sterling related teams, Precisely Support, Professional Services, Technical Pre-Sales, or Engineering; or IBM Sales, Professional Services, or pre sales technical support roles

• Background in application integration, managed file transfer (MFT), electronic data interchange (EDI), and systems sizing and architecture

jobs.title: Executive Director
jobs.description:
Executive Director

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced, mission-driven Executive Director to provide overall leadership and operational oversight for our Teen Residential Facility in Castle Rock, Colorado. This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for bringing together clinical excellence, operational performance, regulatory compliance, financial results, and a strong employee culture.

Reporting to the VP of Operations - West, the Executive Director will lead an interdisciplinary leadership team and ensure all departments are aligned around a shared goal: delivering exceptional care and service. This role has a direct impact on the experience of our clients, employees, and families. It is an opportunity to shape the culture and performance of an entire facility while leading teams committed to delivering meaningful, high-quality care.

What You’ll Do

• Provide strategic and operational oversight across all departments including Clinical, Nursing, Behavioral Health Technicians, and Facilities.

• Lead and develop a high-performing interdisciplinary team.

• Drive facility performance across client outcomes, employee engagement, safety, compliance, and culture.

• Partner with clinical and operational leaders to ensure high-quality, safe, and effective client care.

• Maintain a strong culture of regulatory and accreditation readiness, ensuring compliance is embedded in day-to-day operations.

• Monitor key operational and financial metrics, identify opportunities for improvement, and translate organizational goals into actionable facility-level priorities.

• Identify operational challenges and lead sustainable solutions that improve both the client and employee experience.

• Serve as a visible, engaged leader within the facility and broader organization.

What We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate is a strategic and hands-on leader who can see the entire operation, connect the dots across departments, and turn organizational goals into measurable results. You are comfortable making decisions that make an impact, holding leaders accountable, and balancing business performance with quality, safety, and client care.

Qualifications

Education

• Master's degree in Behavioral Health, Social Work, Psychology, Counseling, Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Nursing, or a related field required.

• Independent clinical licensure beneficial (LCSW, LPC, LMFT, LAC, Psychologist, RN, or equivalent).

Experience & Training

• 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in behavioral healthcare, residential treatment, healthcare operations, or a related setting.

• 5+ years of experience leading managers and multidisciplinary teams.

• Experience overseeing residential treatment, withdrawal management, inpatient, or behavioral health programs strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated experience managing budgets, financial performance, and operational metrics.

• Experience leading accreditation, licensing, and regulatory compliance efforts.

• Strong understanding of trauma-informed and evidence-based treatment models.

• Proven ability to lead change, improve organizational performance, and build high-performing teams.

Other Requirements:

• Candidates applying for this position should be aware that an offer for employment in this position is contingent upon passing a comprehensive background check, encompassing criminal records and motor vehicle reports.

What We Offer

We believe our leaders should be supported both professionally and personally. In addition to a competitive base salary, this role offers a comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to support your health, wealth, and self.

• Competitive compensation with a salary range of $130,000-$150,000, based on experience and qualifications.

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage with rich employer contributions toward premiums.

• Access to high-quality behavioral health benefits designed to support whole-person wellbeing through two Employee Assistance Programs.

• 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching, helping you build toward your long-term financial goals.

• Unlimited Paid time off to recharge and take care of what matters outside of work.

• Dedicated Wellbeing Days to prioritize your physical, mental, and emotional wellbeing.

• Floating holiday hours for you to take time to celebrate the holidays that matter most to you.

• Opportunities for professional growth and leadership development within a growing organization.

• A meaningful opportunity to lead a team and make a direct impact on the clients, families, and communities we serve.

What to Expect: Our Interview Process

Here's an overview of what comes next:

• Application Review: We'll promptly review your application within one business day.

• Discovery Call: Expect a 30–45-minute discovery call with one of our recruiters.

• Onsite Interview: You'll have an onsite interview with our VP of Operations.

• Final Panel Interview: You'll have a final interview with our Executive Team.

• Offer: If all goes well, you'll receive an offer.

Expected Interview Timeline: The entire process typically takes 1-4 weeks dependent on candidate availability.

Application Deadline: Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. The posting may be closed at any time once a candidate has been selected.

Sandstone Care’s Commitment to Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion

At Sandstone Care, we are committed to fostering a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion that not only enriches the lives of our employees but also ensures the wellbeing and care of our clients, regardless of their race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, ability, or background. We believe that embracing diversity and promoting equity and inclusion are integral to our mission of providing high-quality behavioral health services.

Sandstone Care is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered.
