jobs.title: Creative Copywriting Senior Associate
jobs.description:
We are PMG

PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. With more than 1,000 employees, PMG partners with brands including Apple, Nike, Dropbox, Experian, Sephora, and Whole Foods. Our work has earned top industry honors, including Cannes Lions and Adweek’s Media Plan of the Year, and PMG has won 40+ workplace culture awards, including being the only company to rank among Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for 11 consecutive years.

Who You Will Be Working With

As a Creative Copywriting Senior Associate, you’ll be part of a creative team that cares deeply about craft—writers, designers, producers, and creative leads who like pushing ideas further while keeping the work grounded in what the audience actually feels and needs. You’ll partner closely with creative leadership to shape concepts, refine language, and bring strong copy to life across different formats and channels.

You’ll also collaborate with strategy and account teammates who help clarify the “why” behind the work—audience insight, brand goals, and the role each message plays in a bigger campaign. At times, you’ll work directly with clients, presenting copy directions, explaining your thinking, and helping teams land on language that feels true to the brand and clear to the customer.

What You Will Be Doing

• Write original, engaging copy across a range of projects—campaigns, brand storytelling, product and service messaging, and content systems.

• Adapt your voice quickly and thoughtfully, capturing the tone and personality of multiple brands without losing clarity or consistency.

• Take briefs from early concept to polished execution, exploring different angles and elevating ideas through strong language and structure.

• Present copy and creative concepts with confidence, explaining how the work supports both the creative vision and the business goal.

• Bring sharp attention to detail—tight edits, clean grammar, and wording that feels intentional in every headline, CTA, and long-form line.

• Spot content opportunities by paying attention to audience behavior, customer needs, and cultural moments that can make messaging feel more relevant.

• Stay current on trends in advertising, design, and culture, using what you learn to strengthen the work (not distract from it).

• Use available tools—including AI where helpful—to speed up exploration, sharpen drafts, and streamline workflows while keeping the final voice human and brand-true.

What You Will Bring

• 3+ years of experience in copywriting, ideally in an agency or high-growth brand environment

• Strong writing fundamentals and a clear point of view—your work is polished, purposeful, and easy to understand.

• Experience creating copy for integrated campaigns and performance channels.

• Proficiency in writing for digital platforms, especially paid social, video, and web.

• Range: you can shift tone, voice, and format depending on the brand, the channel, and the audience.

• Conceptual strength: you can generate ideas, not just lines—and you enjoy pushing beyond the first draft.

• Confidence presenting your work and taking feedback well, with the ability to improve copy without losing the original intent.

• A good instinct for what makes messaging effective, and curiosity about how creative connects to real customer action.

• Organization and follow-through: you manage revisions, deadlines, and details without the work feeling rushed.

• Comfort using modern tools to work efficiently, with good judgment about when AI helps and when it does not.

• A commitment to curiosity and adaptability as a Continual Learner, staying at the forefront of media innovation while prioritizing client success with a Customer-Focused mindset that seeks opportunities to deliver meaningful value.

• A dedication to People-Focused leadership, fostering collaboration, innovation, and professional growth by Leading by Example and nurturing strong relationships that empower others to excel.

What We Offer

• Professional Development: Take advantage of our learning and development programs, mentorship opportunities, and career advancement support.

• Generous Time Off: Enjoy generous paid time off and holiday allowances to recharge and spend time with loved ones.

• Parental Leave: We provide paid parental leave to support your family during important life events.

• Retirement & Pension Plans: Plan for your future with competitive retirement or pension programs, including contribution matching.

• Fertility and Family Support: Access fertility benefits for all team members and their spouses.

• Healthcare: Coverage and support for everyday medical expenses and routine care, tailored by geography.

• Pet Insurance: Protect your pet's health and your finances.

• Lifestyle Spending Accounts: Enjoy 100% company-funded accounts to promote healthy habits and well-being.

• Commuter Benefits: Access support for travel and commuting needs, where available.

• Annual Bonus: All employees are eligible for an annual bonus.

• Volunteering Opportunities: Receive 8 give-back hours to volunteer in your local communities.

• AI Enterprise License: Access AI Enterprise accounts and participate in weekly AI training sessions to empower and ensure AI safety.

Benefits vary by country, location, and geography to reflect local laws, norms, and expectations.

What Sets Us Apart

Being part of PMG means joining a company culture that’s unmatched in digital. We're dedicated to working hard to serve our employees and clients, delivering value, results, and innovation—which often requires true grit and agility. We believe in taking care of ourselves and each other to continuously improve in every way.

In alignment with our core values to be inclusive and always change for the better, PMG is committed to creating a more diverse and inclusive culture, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe that we only change for the better by bringing diverse perspectives to our company. PMG recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Architect
jobs.description:
Who we are...

Verra Mobility is a global leader in smart mobility. We develop technology-enabled solutions that help the world move safely and easily. We are fostering the development of safe cities, working with police departments and municipalities to install over 4,000 red-light, speed, and school bus stop arm safety cameras across North America. We are also creating smart roadways, serving the world's largest commercial fleets and rental car companies to manage tolling transactions and violations for over 8.5 million vehicles. And we are a leading provider of connected systems, processing nearly 165 million transactions each year across 50+ individual tolling authorities.

Culture

Verra Mobility Corporation is a dynamic, entrepreneurial company that operates with a people-first philosophy and approach. The company lives by its core values—Do What’s Right, Choose Courage Over Comfort, Win Together, and Own It—in everything it does for its customers and team members. The company seeks to grow, both organically and through acquisition, to continue to be the undisputed market leader with a bias for action, customer focus, teamwork, drive for results, and commitment to excellence.

Position Overview

The QA Architect owns the vision, strategy, and hands on execution of quality engineering across the Platform, Credential, and Violations portfolios, reporting to the Senior Enterprise Architect. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports: influence comes from technical credibility and direct partnership rather than organizational authority.

You will personally build automation frameworks, write and review test code, and work directly inside a squad when a team needs help, including training engineers, pairing on hard problems, and doing the work directly when that is what moves a team forward fastest.

Essential Responsibilities

Quality Strategy & Standards

• Own the QA Vision: Define and own the enterprise QA vision and long term automation strategy across Platform, Credential, and Violations, informed by the shift left principle.

• Establish the Testing Standard: Establish the testing pyramid and automation approach, spanning unit, integration, contract, end to end, performance, and non functional testing, as a consistent standard while allowing for legitimate portfolio differences.

• Extend Strategy to Asynchronous Systems: Extend the quality tooling roadmap to test and validation strategies for asynchronous, event driven, and message based integrations, not only synchronous request and response calls.

Hands On Execution

• Build Shared Frameworks: Personally build and maintain core automation frameworks and shared test libraries, and write and review test code, automation scripts, and test plans directly alongside squad engineers.

• Unblock Teams Directly: Step in directly when a team lacks the automation skill or capacity to implement the strategy, pairing with engineers, running training sessions, or writing the initial test suite to get a squad unstuck.

• Guide Non Functional Testing: Perform and guide non functional testing, including load, stress, performance, and basic security testing informed by OWASP principles, for services where the risk profile warrants it.

Cross Portfolio Partnership

• Partner Without Authority: Work directly with QA Leads and Tech Leads across Platform, Credential, and Violations to implement the QA strategy in each specific context, leading through technical standards, coaching, and hands on partnership rather than direct reporting lines.

• Resolve Cross Portfolio Dependencies: Identify and resolve cross portfolio testing dependencies, for example ensuring Credential and Violations squads can reliably test the integration points between eligibility, provisioning, and citation workflows.

• Represent QA in Architecture: Represent QA in the Architecture CoE, flagging where automation or quality standards need to evolve, and track quality metrics such as defect escape rate, automation coverage, test execution time, and change failure rate.

jobs.title: Member of Data Staff (Analytics Engineer)
jobs.description:
Perplexity is AI for people who expect more. On the data team, that means building the systems that make our data reliable, understandable, and usable by both humans and AI.

We're looking for an analytics engineer or data engineer who wants to build the foundation for an AI-native data organization. You'll design core data models, pipelines, semantic layers, data quality systems, governance practices, and warehouse workflows that power the entire company: helping teams make strategic decisions, operate the business, and move faster with trusted data. You'll also make sure those systems are secure, privacy-aware, and legible to AI agents, data scientists, and the rest of the company.

This role is for someone who can operate at the boundary of analytics engineering, data engineering, data governance, and internal product. You care about dimensional modeling, dbt standards, cost-aware warehouse design, access controls, privacy, and the details that make data trustworthy. You also believe AI should make the data stack faster, easier to maintain, and more accessible across the company without weakening security or governance.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build the core data foundation - design and maintain high-quality data models, marts, and pipelines that make analysis fast, reliable, and reusable.

 - Manage the data warehouse - help own warehouse architecture, environments, permissions, performance, cost, data lifecycle, and operational hygiene so the platform scales cleanly.

 - Make the warehouse AI-readable - own the documentation, semantic context, metadata, lineage, and retrieval patterns that AI systems depend on to understand and query Perplexity's data correctly.

 - Own data modeling standards - define and champion dbt patterns, dimensional modeling practices, naming conventions, tests, and review processes.

 - Lead data governance practices - define standards for access, ownership, lineage, documentation, retention, quality, and sensitive data handling across the analytical warehouse.

 - Build with security and privacy in mind - partner with engineering, security, legal, and finance where needed to ensure data access, sharing, and AI-enabled workflows are appropriate and controlled.

 - Automate data quality and maintenance - build AI-assisted workflows that detect issues, explain root causes, suggest fixes, generate tests, and reduce manual firefighting.

 - Improve data team productivity - automate repetitive workflows, improve tooling, streamline development, and make it easier for data scientists and stakeholders to answer questions.

 - Partner across the company - work closely with data scientists, engineering, product, finance, and GTM teams to translate analytical needs into durable data systems.

 - Shape tooling decisions - evaluate build-versus-buy tradeoffs, manage vendor relationships when needed, and choose tools that scale with the team.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 6+ years of experience as an analytics engineer, data engineer, data scientist, or closely related role.

 - Deep SQL expertise - you can reason about correctness, performance, joins, grain, and edge cases in complex warehouse queries.

 - Strong data modeling experience - you've worked hands-on with dbt (or a similar transformation framework) in production, and you understand dimensional modeling, data contracts, testing, and how analytical schemas should evolve.

 - Pipeline ownership - you've built, maintained, debugged, and improved production data pipelines.

 - Warehouse management experience - you've worked with warehouse administration, access patterns, permissions, performance tuning, cost management, or operational ownership.

 - Governance mindset - you think clearly about data ownership, access controls, privacy, retention, lineage, auditability, and the risks of making data too easy to access.

 - AI-native working style - you already use AI to speed up development, documentation, QA, exploration, and repetitive workflow automation.

 - Stakeholder fluency - you know how to turn messy analytical requirements into trusted models, metrics, and reusable data assets.

 - Autonomy and execution - you can take projects from ambiguous problem to production-quality system with minimal oversight.

 - Operational judgment - you care about reliability, governance, security, cost, and long-term maintainability.


BONUS

 - Snowflake administration, optimization, cost management, or warehouse performance tuning.

 - Experience with RBAC, PII handling, data classification, retention policies, audit workflows, or privacy/security reviews.

 - Experience with Databricks or other modern data infrastructure.

 - Experience building semantic layers, metrics layers, metadata systems, or data catalogs.

 - Python experience for data tooling, automation, orchestration, or quality checks.

 - Previous experience as an early analytics engineer or data engineer at a high-growth startup.


WHY THIS ROLE

 - Own the foundation - your work will determine how fast and confidently the company can use data.

 - Build for humans and AI - the next generation of data infrastructure needs to be understandable by agents as well as analysts.

 - High leverage - better models, pipelines, and tools multiply every data scientist and every stakeholder who depends on data.

 - Small team, broad scope - you'll have room to define standards, choose tools, and ship systems that become company-wide defaults.

jobs.title: Translational Genomics AI ML Scientist
jobs.description:
We are seeking an innovative and highly motivated Translational Genomics AI/ML Scientist based in Durham, NC, to develop next-generation computational capabilities that connect advanced genomics, machine learning, and biological interpretation to real-world crop research and breeding decisions. This role will transform large-scale genomic and phenotypic data into scientific insight, predictive models, and reusable digital tools that accelerate trait discovery, improve genomic prediction, and support innovation across Seeds R&D.

The successful candidate will work at the intersection of computational biology, AI/ML, bioinformatics, data science, and scientific product development. They will design methods for representing and learning from complex biological data, including genomic variation, gene annotations, expression data, pathways, phenotypes, and literature-derived evidence.

This position requires a strong scientific foundation and the ability to translate ambiguous research questions into scalable analytical approaches, validated models, and practical decision-support capabilities. The role will collaborate closely with geneticists, breeders, molecular biologists, data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to ensure that advanced computational methods are scientifically meaningful, technically robust, and adopted by research users.

The ideal candidate is a creative, hands-on scientist who combines deep expertise in genomics or computational biology with modern AI/ML skills and a passion for applying emerging technologies to high-impact biological problems. They can move fluidly between research innovation, method development, scalable implementation, stakeholder communication, and strategic scientific problem solving.

Accountabilities

• Lead the scientific design and delivery of AI/ML-enabled genomics capabilities that translate large-scale genomic, phenotypic, and biological datasets into actionable insights for trait discovery, genomic prediction, and breeding decisions.
• Develop, validate, and operationalize advanced computational methods, including graph machine learning, foundation models, knowledge graphs, and explainable AI approaches, ensuring they are scientifically rigorous, reproducible, and fit for research and product adoption.
• Build scalable bioinformatics and machine-learning workflows that integrate genomic variation, annotations, expression data, pathways, phenotypes, and literature-derived evidence across cloud and enterprise data platforms.
• Advance computational genomics approaches by creating scalable representations, feature-engineering strategies, and predictive models that capture biological complexity and support research decision-making.
• Partner with geneticists, breeders, molecular biologists, data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to translate complex biological questions into practical analytical solutions and reusable digital capabilities.
• Communicate methods, assumptions, results, limitations, and biological interpretation clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, enabling confident scientific decision-making.
• Drive innovation by identifying emerging AI/ML, genomics, and scientific-computing approaches that can accelerate discovery, improve predictive performance, and strengthen Syngenta’s digital genomics platforms.
• Ensure solutions follow good scientific, data governance, engineering, and reproducibility practices, including clear documentation, version control, model validation, and transparent handover to collaborators or product teams.

Required Qualifications

• PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Genetics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related discipline.
• Strong background in genomics, quantitative genetics, population genetics, or computational biology.
• Demonstrated expertise in machine learning and statistical modeling with proficiency in Python and scientific computing.
• Experience working with large-scale biological datasets.
• Strong publication or research track record in computational genomics, AI/ML, or a related field.
• Excellent communication and collaborative problem-solving skills.

Desired Qualifications

We’re especially interested in candidates who bring experience in one or more of the following areas:

• Genomics and graph-based genomic representations, including GNNs, GATs, graph embeddings, or network analytics.
• Foundation models, transformers, DNA language models, or biological large language models.
• Knowledge graphs, semantic technologies, biological ontologies, or AI-assisted scientific research workflows.
• Cloud computing and production AI environments, including AWS, SnowFlake, distributed computing, or MLOps.
• Plant genomics, breeding, crop science, or agricultural biotechnology.

• Authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship

What We Offer

• A culture that celebrates belonging and collaboration, promotes professional development and strives for a work-life balance that supports the team members. Offers flexible work options to support your work and personal needs.
• Full Benefit Package (Medical, Dental & Vision) that starts your first day.

jobs.title: Creative Technologist Lead
jobs.description:

PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. As a Creative Technologist Lead, you’ll play a key role in designing and delivering sophisticated dynamic creative, asset automation, and technology-enabled campaign solutions for some of the world’s leading brands. You’ll partner closely with Creative, Media, Strategy, Product, Analytics, and Engineering teams to translate creative and business objectives into scalable technical solutions.

You’ll serve as a technical lead across complex campaign implementations, helping establish development standards, solve technical challenges, evaluate emerging technologies, and guide other Creative Technologists. You’ll also work directly with our technology partners to advance PMG’s creative technology capabilities and identify new ways to improve how we build, automate, personalize, and deliver creative at scale.

• Define and audit functional and non-functional requirements across dynamic ad serving, data workflows, API and product-feed integrations, asset tracking and tagging, creative authoring tools, measurement, scalability, and quality assurance.

• Partner with Creative, Media, Strategy, Analytics, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure creative technology solutions are integrated effectively across the broader campaign ecosystem.

• Strong understanding of IAB standards, digital advertising formats, specifications, and creative QA requirements across display, video, social, and programmatic environments.

• Experience leading technically complex campaign implementations involving multiple internal teams, platforms, data sources, and external partners.

• Ability to balance technical quality, scalability, campaign objectives, and time-to-market requirements.

• Strong troubleshooting and quality assurance skills with the ability to diagnose technical issues across creative, data, platform, and ad-serving environments.

• Experience developing technical documentation, implementation requirements, best practices, and repeatable development processes.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience with automated QA, testing frameworks, or DevOps processes.

• Familiarity with AI-enabled development, creative automation, or generative technologies and their application within advertising workflows.

• Working knowledge of After Effects and motion-based digital creative production.

• Experience evaluating new technologies, conducting proofs of concept, and making recommendations on platform or technology adoption.

What We Offer

jobs.title: Director, People Technology
jobs.description:
At WD, we are transforming the way technology enables HR services and the employee experience. We are looking for a strategic and hands on Director, People Technology to lead a team of Business Systems Analysts responsible for delivering scalable, business focused technology solutions across People functions. This leader will mentor and grow a high performing business analysis team. This team is responsible for translating business needs into effective process and technology solutions across HR domains.

The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership, deep business analysis expertise, systems thinking, and a passion for developing talent. This role sits at the forefront of delivering high-quality outcomes across the People Technology portfolio.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES

Team Leadership

This role leads, mentors, and develops a team of Business Systems Analysts by fostering accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and user centric problem solving. The Director establishes clear expectations, creates meaningful development plans, and opens career growth opportunities for team members while defining the capabilities and skills required for a strong business systems analysis function. Just as importantly, this leader builds a culture of knowledge sharing, constructive challenge, innovation, and impact.

Technology Leadership

The Director is responsible for driving our HR technology vision, roadmap, and execution. They provide direction and oversight across the full tech lifecycle, including requirements discovery, process analysis, functional design, testing, implementation, and post-launch optimization. This leader ensures consistent standards for documentation, quality controls, and delivery methods across the team, while coaching analysts to translate complex business challenges into clear, scalable, and sustainable process and technology solutions. The role also requires functional and technical depth to evaluate tradeoffs, challenge solution approaches, and engage credibly with business and technology partners.

Stakeholder Partnership

This leader serves as a trusted advisor to the People team, our IT technology partners, and company cross-functional stakeholders. The Director owns strong relationships across the organization to understand strategy, clarify priorities, and identify opportunities for transformation and optimization. They facilitate complex discussions, resolve ambiguity, align stakeholders, and drive decisions on requirements and solution direction, while creating transparency around priorities, dependencies, risks, tradeoffs, and expected business outcomes.

Improvement & Innovation

This leader drives continuous improvement through process simplification, standardization, automation, and thoughtful technology enablement. They encourage the team to identify root causes, question legacy practices, and recommend solutions that improve employee experiences. They also champion responsible adoption of emerging capabilities and new ways of working to create measurable business value.

Required:

•  Proven experience leading and developing Business Systems Analysts/HRIS Analysts. Success building high performing teams, developing talent, and creating clear accountability for outcomes.

•  Deep expertise in business analysis practices, including requirements management, process design, functional solution design, testing, implementation, and optimization. Establishing and improving operating models, user enablement, and governance frameworks.

•  Strong understanding of enterprise HR technology, the HR domain, and its processes. The ability to connect company business priorities to HR programs and deliver meaningful, impactful outcomes.

•   Demonstrated experience with Workday HCM & ServiceNow specifically, and broader HR tech SaaS solutions in general. Familiarity with operating in shared models where configuration and administration is co-owned between HR and IT.

•   Expertise in modern SaaS HR systems architecture, integration principles, data quality practices, and emerging technologies such as AI.

•   Significant experience and ability in designing and then delivering multi-year roadmaps, balancing quick wins with longer term transformative work.

•  Exceptional communication, facilitation, influencing, stakeholder management, and problem solving skills.

About you:

•  The People Gardener. You elevate capability through clear expectations, candid coaching, meaningful opportunities, and active investment in team growth. You’re known for growing future leaders.

•  The Cartographer. You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and building as you go. If the map doesn’t exist you make it.

• The Dot Connector. You analyze processes, data, user experience, technology, and operating realities before recommending a path forward. You understand both technology and HR deeply enough to keep the focus on business outcomes and employee experience. You deliver user-centric holistic outcomes, not fragmented bodies of work.

•  The Smooth Operator. You know when to create repeatable structure and when to remain agile. You know when to slow down and when to speed up. You deliver amazing outcomes and build durable scale with just the right depth of structure and controls.

•  The Bridge Builder. You build credibility across functions, communicate clearly, and create alignment even when priorities or perspectives differ. You are viewed as a respected and trusted partner no matter the situation. You help stakeholders first envision and then move from current to future state.

Weekly: 20-29 hours

Interview Plan

Floor Leader

As a Floor Leader, you'll play a vital role in supporting the Store Management Team across all areas of the business. This includes everything from driving sales and opening/closing the store to analyzing sales results and leading training sessions. Together with your fellow leaders, you'll work to ensure that every aspect of the store is firing on all cylinders, creating an exceptional customer experience, a happy and motivated staff, and operational excellence that would make even the most detail-oriented among us proud.

Your day-to-day will be spent on the shop floor, where you'll lead and inspire a team of sales associates to achieve and surpass their goals. By fostering a culture of passion and positivity, you'll help create a work environment that's both productive and fun, resulting in happy customers and happy employees. The Floor Leader role is all about making the world a better place one soap at a time!

Responsibilities:

Sales & Customer Experience:

• Driving Sales: Utilize the StoreForce dashboard results to provide effective coaching and feedback to the sales team, and make necessary adjustments to the shop floor structure to meet and exceed sales goals. Take ownership for your results and actively work to grow the contribution of your segments to the store’s overall sales. Celebrate sales achievements with your team!

• Customer Experience: Lead by example in delivering a world-class customer experience on the shop floor, including product demonstrations. Observe and listen to consultations, collaborate with your team, and strive to exceed daily sales goals. By fostering a culture of excellence in customer service, you'll drive sales, create a loyal customer base, and build a positive reputation for your store.

• Building the Brand: Educate customers on Lush brand values, and articulate our position on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging in the shop and through community engagement, hosting store parties, and other traffic-driving initiatives.

• Product Passion: increase the depth of your product knowledge through constant learning and consistently make informed product recommendations for every need.

Team Involvement:

• Development: Train and coach Sales Ambassadors and peers on effective sales techniques and product knowledge to improve their performance, support the growth of your team, and to increase sales. Lead by example, take ownership of your development, assess your performance, and actively seek feedback, resources, and opportunities to improve and elevate your skills, knowledge and abilities.

• Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging: Encourage open communication and actively listen to team members perspectives related to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). Foster a sense of belonging by promoting teamwork, encouraging collaboration, and recognizing and valuing each employee's unique contributions.

Operational Excellence:

• Cash Handling and Store Opening/Closing: Manage cash handling, including customer transactions, opening/closing the register, reconciling cash drawers, preparing nightly deposits, and securing the store at the end of each day. As required at your store location, take deposits to the bank.

• Time and Attendance: Lead by example in terms of attendance and punctuality, and encourage the same from all employees. Monitor employee breaks to ensure they are taking their scheduled breaks, promoting a healthy work environment and improving employee wellbeing. Review daily communications, including store updates and task lists, to ensure that team members are informed and prepared for their shifts, promoting a culture of preparedness and organization.

• Visuals and Merchandising: Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store to enhance the customer's shopping experience and drive sales.

• Stock and Inventory: Train your team on inventory best practices and fresh standards, and support management with inventory tasks. Utilize Visual Merchandising guidelines to make real-time adjustments to product displays based on sales and improve the customer experience.

• Policies and Procedures: Support your management team to keep your store compliant and ensure your staff are practicing company standards for opening and closing, product integrity, respectful workplace, and health and safety.

Qualifications:

Required:

• Minimum 1 year of experience in:

• customer service and sales

• cash handling and opening/closing procedures

• supervisory experience involving coaching, feedback, and training

• problem-solving issues related to customer service in day-to-day operations

• a fast-paced team environment

• Knowledge and passion for skincare, natural beauty, and ethical business

• Flexible schedule to accommodate store needs, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

Preferred:

• Experience with consultation-based customer service models

• Experience analyzing sales metrics

• Experience working in skincare or cosmetics

• Experience in cross cultural collaboration and DEIB or social justice training

• Fluency in Spanish, French or other languages

jobs.title: Lead Accountant
jobs.description:
Role Summary

As a Lead Accountant at inKind, you will play a critical role in strengthening the technical accounting, financial reporting, and accounting operations that support our continued growth.

This is a senior individual contributor role designed for an experienced accountant who combines a strong public accounting / Big 4 foundation with the ability to operate hands-on in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You will serve as a technical accounting resource across the Finance organization, helping evaluate complex transactions, establish accounting treatment and policies, strengthen controls, and ensure our financial reporting remains accurate, scalable, and GAAP compliant.

You will work closely with the Controller and broader Finance team while partnering across Legal, Operations, Product, and other areas of the business. The ideal candidate can move comfortably between researching a complex accounting issue, preparing technical accounting documentation, reviewing financial statements, supporting an audit, and improving the underlying processes and systems that produce our financial information.

This is an opportunity to bring the rigor and technical foundation of public accounting into a growing fintech and hospitality technology business where you can have significant ownership and impact.

Who You Are

• You have a strong foundation in technical accounting and U.S. GAAP, ideally developed within a Big 4 or other leading public accounting firm.

• You enjoy solving complex accounting questions and can translate technical guidance into practical recommendations for the business.

• You are comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor and taking ownership of complex accounting matters from research through implementation.

• You combine technical rigor with commercial judgment and understand that accounting needs to support a rapidly evolving business.

• You are highly analytical, process-oriented, and exceptionally detail-focused.

• You are comfortable challenging existing processes and identifying opportunities to improve controls, reporting, systems, and automation.

• You can communicate complex accounting concepts clearly to both Finance and non-Finance stakeholders.

• You thrive in an environment where priorities evolve quickly and where you are expected to independently identify and solve problems.

Responsibilities / Essential Functions

• Serve as a key technical accounting resource for the Finance organization, researching and evaluating complex accounting matters under U.S. GAAP.

• Assess the accounting implications of new products, contracts, partnerships, financing arrangements, investments, acquisitions, and other complex or non-routine transactions.

• Prepare clear, well-supported technical accounting memoranda and position papers, documenting conclusions and recommendations for management and external auditors.

• Develop, maintain, and improve accounting policies and procedures as the organization and its products continue to scale.

• Support the preparation and review of timely and accurate financial statements, including balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements, and supporting schedules.

• Lead and review complex areas of the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close, ensuring balances and transactions are appropriately recorded, supported, and reconciled.

• Review general ledger activity and account reconciliations, investigate unusual or complex transactions, and ensure appropriate accounting treatment.

• Partner with the Controller on complex accounting areas including revenue recognition, leases, equity and stock-based compensation, debt and financing arrangements, business combinations, consolidations, and other applicable accounting matters.

• Play a key role in external audits, including preparing supporting documentation, responding to technical accounting questions, coordinating audit requests, and resolving issues with external auditors.

• Strengthen the company's financial reporting environment through improved internal controls, documentation, reconciliation processes, and accounting procedures.

• Identify opportunities to improve and automate accounting workflows, reducing manual processes while increasing accuracy, consistency, and scalability.

• Partner with FP&A and other Finance team members to ensure consistency between accounting results, management reporting, forecasting, and financial analysis.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Operations, Product, Technology, and other teams to understand new business initiatives and proactively identify their accounting implications.

• Provide technical accounting guidance and mentorship to other members of the Accounting and Finance team.

• Support tax filings, financial due diligence, financing activities, and other strategic Finance initiatives as required.

• Help build the accounting infrastructure, policies, and controls necessary to support inKind as the business continues to grow in scale and complexity.

Required Skills / Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• CPA strongly preferred.

• 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, including meaningful experience within a Big 4 or other nationally recognized public accounting firm.

• Strong technical knowledge of U.S. GAAP and experience researching and documenting complex accounting matters.

• Experience preparing or reviewing technical accounting memoranda and supporting accounting conclusions with authoritative guidance.

jobs.title: Salesforce Developer
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Salesforce Developer to join our team. This role is responsible for customizing and building applications on our Salesforce platform that keep CEA's flagship programs running smoothly and enable the wider team to achieve ambitious growth goals, expanding EA’s talent pipelines and scaling our impact. This is an individual contributor position on our Salesforce Team, reporting to the Salesforce Engineer, Ari Elkhatib, and collaborating closely with the Events, Online, Groups, and Community Health Teams.




ABOUT CEA

The Centre for Effective Altruism (CEA) stewards the movement of people putting effective altruism principles into practice to solve the world's most pressing problems. We’re working to build a flourishing future by applying evidence, reason, and compassion to challenges like global poverty, animal suffering, and risks from transformative AI.

Our work centers on growing and supporting a global community of people who rigorously analyze where they can do the most good – and take action on those insights. Current strategic priorities include increasing understanding of effective altruism and its principles, growing the number of people who are motivated by EA principles to take significant action to address pressing problems, and diversifying funding sources for high-impact work.

We had significant success in 2025, building momentum within CEA. Our headcount grew from 42 to 66 core staff. Program participation (e.g., events, courses, groups) grew https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/NKrpEdg7wAgcoHNRG/cea-is-growing-again-25-more-people-engaged-with-our-1 by 20-25% year over year. We merged https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/BLvTcMMEQGFYsh6Jw/ea-funds-and-cea-are-merging with EA Funds https://funds.effectivealtruism.org/ and are rapidly scaling up our capacity for grantmaking and associated fundraising.

In 2026, we’ve maintained ambitious momentum https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/Dy4iGHbAkKAQ4t2Dw/building-sustainable-momentum-progress-report-on-cea-s-2025 while building the foundations for a step-change in the wider EA ecosystem’s growth trajectory from 2027 onwards. We’re in the midst of the best fundraising year in CEA’s history and are looking for the right talent to help us take advantage of the many opportunities in front of us.




ABOUT THE SALESFORCE TEAM

The Salesforce Team builds and maintains CEA's CRM infrastructure, covering the systems that power event registration, grants tracking, virtual program management, and community engagement. You will be part of a nimble team, reporting into the Salesforce Engineer and working closely with a Salesforce administrator. The Salesforce Team with internal teams including Events, Online, Groups and Community Health to translate operational needs into scalable, reliable systems, and act as the organizational steward for contact and activity data across CEA.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Salesforce Developer to develop and maintain our Salesforce environment, enhance its user experience and data capabilities, and help the team effectively leverage the system. You will help our flagship programs (including events https://www.effectivealtruism.org/ea-global, online courses https://www.effectivealtruism.org/courses, EA groups https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/groups, and the EA Forum) https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/ run smoothly, amplifying their impact and improving cost-effectiveness. Ultimately, you will enable the wider CEA team to achieve ambitious growth goals, expanding EA’s talent pipelines and scaling our impact.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

 - Designing and building efficient Salesforce solutions tailored to user needs, including enhancing CEA's data collection and management capabilities

 - Developing and maintaining integrations between Salesforce and internal or third-party systems

 - Managing and enhancing Salesforce Experience Cloud Sites, which host custom-built application forms (using screen flows and custom code) integrated with our Salesforce org

 - Thoroughly testing all functionality before launch, and quickly resolving any post-launch issues or bugs

 - Troubleshooting and debugging issues with custom code, automations, integrations, and platform functionality

 - Ensuring custom development follows best practices on security and performance

 - Maintaining technical documentation and driving continuous improvement


RISK & COMPLIANCE MANAGEMENT

 - Ensuring adherence to compliance, data security, and governance policies

 - Identifying risks and collaborating with team members to develop mitigation strategies for Salesforce-related programs


STAKEHOLDER COORDINATION

 - Identifying and understanding user requirements for each project

 - Coordinating with the Salesforce Engineer on all Salesforce projects to maintain context and manage support requests

 - Supporting day-to-day user requests




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

For this role, we’re looking for someone with an active Salesforce Platform Developer I Certification.

You might be a great fit for this role if you also:

 - Are proficient in Apex and SOQL.

 - Have excellent attention to detail to ensure data accuracy, reliability, and compliance with best practices and Salesforce releases.

 - Demonstrate strong team spirit and a collaborative mindset to work effectively with cross-functional teams on support requests and coordinate on Salesforce projects.

 - Are highly adaptable, willing to learn new technologies and tools, and adopt best practices to continuously improve the Salesforce environment and user experience.

 - Have strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively coordinate with stakeholders, build relationships and understand user requirements, and ensure clear documentation.

Bonus:

 - An active Salesforce Platform App Builder Certification

 - Experience in Lightning Web Components and Visualforce

 - Experience with Nonprofit Success Pack (NPSP)

 - Experience with FormAssembly

 - Experience with Data Cloud (Data 360)




OTHER INFORMATION

 - This is a full-time, remote position. We prefer applicants who are able to work in time zones between US Pacific Time and CET.

 - Start date: We’d ideally have you start in January 2027, but can be flexible for the right candidate.

 - Reports to: Ari Elkhatib, Salesforce Engineer

 - Compensation: For this position we offer a total compensation package of $115,834 USD comprising a base salary of $105,304 USD and a 10% unconditional 401(k) contribution.
   
   - Other locations: For candidates outside the US, compensation is based on the US structure and is adjusted for the cost of employment and fixed local benefit costs to create an equivalent package.
   
   - Benefits globally include private health insurance, flexible work hours, a $6,000 annual professional development allowance, a $6,000 mental health support allowance, extended parental leave, ergonomic equipment, 25 days of paid vacation, and more.

 - This role will involve travel. There are likely 2 trips annually including some international travel.

We are committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and encourage individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences to apply. We especially encourage applications from self-identified women and people of colour who are excited about contributing to our mission. The Centre for Effective Altruism is an equal opportunity employer. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, or have any other questions about applying, please contact jobs@centreforeffectivealtruism.org.

CEA participates in E-Verify for US employees.

We are committed to protecting your data. See our privacy policy https://www.centreforeffectivealtruism.org/privacy for more information.




EVALUATION PLAN

jobs.title: Partner Operations Data Analyst (Remote Eligible - Costa Rica)
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

This isn't a role that waits for data to break and then cleans it up. You will help design the governance standards this data runs on, in close partnership with Partner Operations leadership and our Partner Systems lead, and you will help design how partner data flows into Salesforce as our single source of truth.

The bigger opportunity: clean, well-structured partner data is what makes AI actually trustworthy to build on. You will help envision and build how AI, including tools like Claude, makes partner data visible and usable for our Partner Account Managers (PAMs), from AI-assisted dashboards to forecasting support. This is a long-term, foundation-building function meant to compound in value over time. Done well, it directly shapes how leadership sees revenue, gives Partner Sales the visibility to manage pipeline and partner health proactively, and informs how we make partner program decisions.

You will report to the Head of Partner Programs & Operations in the US . This role is eligible for remote work within Costa Rica. You must reside in Costa Rica.

You Will

Partner Attribution & Pipeline Health

• Maintain partner attribution logic, data quality, and cross-system reconciliation across Salesforce and other partner systems, ensuring MDF campaigns, marketing activities, and partner directory leads are properly captured and attributed to pipeline.

• Validate that partner opportunity data, including deal registration for partner-sourced deals, is accurate and properly tagged, reconciling Salesforce against the partner portal.

• Build and maintain visibility into partner health, pipeline health, and bookings results, so partner leadership and PAMs can proactively manage their book of business rather than react to it.

Data Architecture & Governance

• Design and execute structured data cleanup across Salesforce and the partner portal (account, opportunity, and territory records), helping set the governance standards this work runs on in collaboration with Partner Programs leadership and our Partner Systems lead.

• Partner with the Systems team on field-level access governance, so the right people, and only the right people, can update partner data.

• Drive the definition and documentation of partner active and inactive status logic, running the annual review that applies it across the partner base.

• Maintain the team's partner data dictionary and definitions documentation as attribution logic, tiering rules, and reporting definitions evolve.

• Keep a clear change log on your own record updates so changes are traceable: what changed, why, and when.

Data Systems & AI Enablement

• Design how partner data flows into Salesforce as our single source of truth, partnering closely with our Partner Systems lead to get ahead of conflicts before multiple teams touch the same record.

• Envision and help build how AI, including tools like Claude, makes partner data visible and usable for our Partner Account Managers, from AI-assisted dashboards to forecasting support.

• Serve as the long-term steward of the data quality and structure that our AI and forecasting initiatives depend on.

Commission, Incentives & Tier Administration

• Own the accuracy of partner commission and payout validation for partner-sourced opportunities and deal registrations, giving Finance clean, timely data ahead of processing.

• Administer end-of-year partner rebates: identify amounts due, validate that partners have met the requirements, and partner with Finance to ensure accurate, timely payment.

• Support end-of-year partner re-tiering, validating partner performance against tier requirements and driving the resulting account updates.

• Deliver a structured quarterly tier-progression report for PAMs and/or partners, showing exactly where each partner stands on maintaining their current tier or advancing to the next, so both sides have time to close gaps before year-end re-tiering.

Reporting & Forecasting Support

• Support the ongoing accuracy of recurring PAM and regional performance and forecasting reporting, keeping source data clean and current as the reporting cadence evolves.

• Proactively identify data issues before they surface downstream, and drive structured UAT whenever enhancements roll out to internal or partner-facing reporting and dashboards.

• Partner with cross-functional project owners, including active PMO or operations initiatives, on data cleanup and reporting workstreams, executing the data-side tasks those initiatives require.

Partner Portal & Systems Collaboration

• Partner closely with our Partner Systems lead on the data side of the partner portal and our Crossbeam instance: flagging data issues, validating outputs, and representing the data and attribution perspective in system and configuration decisions.

• Support territory management by working with Regional Partner leadership whenever territory or account assignments change, ensuring the resulting record updates are made accurately.

• Provide input on what partner data is exposed in the portal and how partners can request changes.

Cross-Functional Alignment

• Drive alignment with our broader data governance and Finance teams on data update policies and processes.

• Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for data questions from PAMs and Regional Partner leadership, escalating policy-level questions to Partner Programs leadership.

You Have

• Minimum of 3 years in partner operations, channel operations, revenue operations, or sales operations, with hands-on Salesforce experience.

• Deep, hands-on expertise working with data, from cleaning and structuring large, messy datasets to building the reports and models that turn them into something usable.

• Experience in a SaaS environment, with comfort navigating the data structures common to that world, from CRM-driven pipeline to multi-tier partner segmentation and usage-based metrics.

• Strong Excel or Google Sheet skills and comfort reconciling and validating data across multiple systems.

• Excellent attention to detail and a bias toward flagging issues before they compound.

• A builder's mindset: comfortable proposing and shaping data governance standards in partnership with Partner Programs leadership and our Systems team, not just following standards someone else wrote.

• Genuine excitement about using AI tools, including Claude, not just to speed up your own work, but to help design how partner data gets surfaced and used by others.

• A systems-thinking approach: comfortable mapping how data moves across Salesforce, the partner portal, and Crossbeam, and spotting where structure breaks down before it becomes a bigger problem.

• Strong cross-functional communication skills. You will work closely with Systems, Finance, and Regional Partner leadership without formal authority over any of them, so influence and clarity matter more than title.

Nice to have

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Gold Growth
jobs.location: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

Robinhood Gold is our premium membership and one of the most important businesses at Robinhood. For one monthly fee, Gold members unlock a bundle of benefits, including boosted APY on uninvested cash, an IRA match, lower margin rates, professional research, access to the Robinhood Gold Card, and more. The Gold Growth team is responsible for growing that membership: how customers discover Gold, why they start a trial, what convinces them to become paying members, and what keeps them subscribed. Because Gold touches nearly every product at Robinhood, we reach customers across the entire app, and our work directly drives subscription revenue and how much of their financial lives customers choose to bring to Robinhood.

As Senior Product Manager, Gold Growth, you will own key levers of the Gold growth funnel and be accountable for business outcomes, not just feature metrics. You will decide where to invest across acquisition, trial-to-paid conversion, engagement, and retention, make clear trade-offs between growth, member value, and unit economics, and partner closely with data science to run high-velocity experiments, and read results with rigor. You will work hand in hand with design to craft simple, compelling consumer experiences, and you will operate with a high degree of autonomy: taking ambiguous problems, forming a point of view, and driving them to launch with little day-to-day guidance.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you'll do

• Own the strategy and roadmap for Gold growth across the full member lifecycle, from discovery and trial to paid conversion, activation of benefits, and long-term retention.

• Drive business impact end to end, including new member growth, trial-to-paid conversion, churn reduction, and member lifetime value. Tie every product bet to the outcomes that matter for the business, not just the next metric on a dashboard.

• Build and run a high-velocity experimentation program with data science: generate hypotheses, size opportunities, design A/B tests, and turn results into decisions you scale or kill quickly.

• Make hard trade-off decisions across growth, member experience, and economics (for example, offers and pricing versus long-term profitability), back them with clear reasoning and data, and bring stakeholders along with you.

• Work hand in hand with design and engineering to build intuitive, persuasive consumer experiences, sweating the details of the entry points, paywalls, onboarding flows, copy, and UI that shape how millions of customers experience Gold.

• Operate as the owner of your area: find the highest-leverage growth opportunities, write the plan, rally partners across engineering, design, marketing, finance, legal, and compliance, and ship with minimal oversight.

What you bring

• You have 4+ years of product management experience, including at least 2 years building consumer-facing products where you owned the end-to-end UI/UX alongside design partners.

• You have a track record of driving measurable business outcomes in a growth context (acquisition, paid conversion, retention, revenue, or unit economics) and can clearly explain how your product decisions moved them.

• You have strong product judgment and are comfortable making trade-offs under ambiguity. You form opinionated recommendations, defend them with data, and change course when the evidence says so.

• You are analytically fluent and have partnered closely with data scientists on experimentation, funnel analysis, opportunity sizing, and impact measurement. Comfort digging into the data yourself is a plus.

• You hold a high bar for consumer craft. You care about the details of a great experience and can articulate why one design converts better than another.

• You are a self-starter who executes independently, creates clarity for others, and needs little guidance to take a problem from idea to shipped product.

What we offer

• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career

• Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching

• Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents

• Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not

• Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more

• Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits

• Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

• Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. jobs.title: Business Supervisor
jobs.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are seeking a Business Supervisor to support our Eli Lilly business, helping bring culturally relevant creative work to life for brands that impact people’s health. This role is hybrid and requires 4 days a week in our Brooklyn office, with 1 day remote.

Position Summary

The Business Supervisor (BS) is the day-to-day client partnership lead, responsible for managing client communication, translating business needs into actionable direction, and ensuring clarity across internal teams. Serving as the critical connection point between Business Leadership and Program Management, the Business Supervisor helps create exceptional client experiences while enabling efficient delivery.

This role operates with guidance while independently managing day-to-day client relationships and workstreams. Business Supervisors build trusted client partnerships, drive alignment across disciplines, proactively manage expectations, and help ensure every engagement is strategically grounded and executionally set up for success.

What You'll Do

Client Partnership & Communication

• Own day-to-day client relationships and communication across assigned workstreams.

• Lead routine client meetings, status calls, working sessions, and follow-up communications.

• Build trust through proactive communication, responsiveness, and thoughtful partnership.

• Ensure every client interaction is organized, productive, and aligned against business objectives.

Translation & Alignment

• Translate client needs, feedback, and business objectives into clear direction for internal teams.

• Partner closely with Strategy, Context, Creative, and Business Directors to develop and refine creative briefs.

• Ensure cross-functional teams understand priorities, expectations, success metrics, and next steps.

• Create alignment between client goals and agency recommendations throughout the life of a project.

• Build a working understanding of the client’s brands, patient audiences, competitive landscape, and business priorities to inform day-to-day client partnership and internal direction.

Creative Development Support

• Prepare clients for presentations and key decision-making moments.

• Help articulate strategic and creative rationale in a clear, compelling, and client-ready manner.

• Anticipate client feedback and guide internal teams on effective responses.

• Support creative development by ensuring work remains aligned to client objectives, approved strategy, and client-provided medical, legal, and regulatory guidance.

Risk & Expectation Management

• Proactively identify risks, ambiguities, or changing client needs before they become issues.

• Manage client expectations through transparent communication and thoughtful problem solving.

• Resolve day-to-day challenges independently, escalating only when appropriate.

• Ensure alignment between what clients expect and what teams are prepared to deliver.

Team Contribution & Development

• Mentor junior Business Leadership team members in client communication, relationship management, and presentation skills.

• Support Business Directors in strengthening client relationships and identifying opportunities for organic growth.

• Foster a collaborative, accountable, and positive team environment across disciplines.

• Model strong judgment, professionalism, and ownership in client-facing situations.

Partnership with Program Management

• Partner closely with Program Management to ensure alignment between client expectations and delivery plans.

• Support scope definition by helping clarify client objectives, priorities, and desired outcomes.

• Maintain awareness of timelines, budgets, and executional progress while allowing Program Management to lead delivery.

• Work collaboratively to ensure clients receive a seamless experience from strategy through execution.

• Partner with Program Management and client stakeholders to clarify review requirements, consolidate feedback, and ensure teams understand approval decisions and their implications.

Minimum Qualifications

• 4+ years of experience in advertising, marketing, consulting, or related client leadership roles.

• Demonstrated ability to build trusted client relationships and manage day-to-day business communications.

• Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Strategy, Creative, Production, Context, and Program Management.

• Ability to balance multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional organization and attention to detail.

• Experience mentoring junior team members and contributing to a collaborative team culture.

• Strong understanding of integrated marketing, creative development, and client service best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field preferred.

• Experience supporting healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other regulated brands is a plus, but not required. Curiosity about the category and an eagerness to learn are valued.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $83,000 - $100,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

jobs.title: Regional Leader of Restaurants - Cleveland, OH
jobs.description:
Your Role at Raising Cane’s:

The Regional Leader of Restaurants (RLR) is a field-based leader responsible for directing and operating restaurants within an assigned region, while leveraging, directing and collaborating with the Regional Business Unit team. This role is fully accountable for all restaurants within their region including new restaurant growth, revenue and sales growth, profitability, and human capital management. The physical work environment includes working in a fast-paced kitchen environment (which requires extended periods of physical exertion, such as walking, standing, lifting and bending) and interacting with customers. It also includes both inside and outside work in varied temperatures, working with and around food products, common allergens, industrial equipment, commercial cleaning products that require the use of personal protective equipment and physical activities necessary to complete the responsibilities of the job.

Your Impact and Responsibilities:

Restaurant Support

• Delivers high-performing and best-in class operations by leading and inspiring all restaurant crewmembers, identifying areas of opportunity, holding accountability, and celebrating successes in the restaurants
• Ensures company restaurant activities and operations are aligned to Raising Cane’s vision, mission, core values, and non-negotiables

• Assesses and develops plans to build and retain high performing leaders and teams with an emphasis on strategic analysis, critical thinking, problem solving, and business acumen

Requirements for Success:

• 6+ years’ experience in the restaurant industry with multi-unit leadership experience
• Retail or restaurant experience in operations for multiple units
• Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities that may be constantly changing
• Excellence in organizational management with the ability to coach & develop senior leaders
• Strong decision-making capabilities and able to deliver within tight deadlines
• Self-driven, flexible, and highly energetic with strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills
• Ability to work effectively and efficiently both independently and collaboratively
• Action and results orientated with a strong commitment to quality and date-driven results
• Able to work a varied schedule related to business needs including days, evenings, and weekends
• Required to live within assigned region and ability to travel as needed
• Microsoft Proficient: Word, Excel & Power Point
• High school diploma or equivalent; Bachelor’s in related field preferred
• Possess a valid driver’s license

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Privacy Policy

jobs.title: Corporate Health Senior Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.



Corporate Health Manager

HSE · New York, NY, Austin, TX or San Francisco, CA · Full-Time

How We Operate

 - Extreme ownership. Full autonomy. Own things end to end often taking on scope outside your core role without being asked to get things done.

 - Velocity. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - First principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

The HSE Team

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Build the sustainability program for one of the largest compute buildouts in history, from zero. The first GHG inventory, the first disclosures, the first water strategy, all written here while the company adds gigawatts.

 - Make our carbon and water numbers hold up to the most demanding audience in tech. Hyperscaler customers, auditors, and regulators will test every figure, so the accounting gets built right the first time.

 - Keep environmental compliance ahead of the fastest build in the industry. Behind-the-meter generation spans multiple states, each with its own air permit conditions, runtime limits, and reporting deadlines, and the company adds sites faster than any manual compliance model can keep up with.

Role Scope

 - Own the workers compensation program across every business unit: data center operations, construction, manufacturing, and corporate, from carrier and TPA selection through claim reserves, reviews, and closure.

 - Run case management for every work-related injury and illness end to end, from first report through treatment, fitness-for-duty, and full-duty return, with an occupational medicine and clinic network stood up in each state we operate in.

 - Build the return-to-work program so injured employees are back on modified or full duty in days, with transitional duty defined ahead of time for shift-based field roles.

 - Stand up the industrial hygiene and ergonomics programs for high-energy sites and the manufacturing facility: exposure assessments, sampling, heat, noise, and fatigue controls, ergonomic risk reduction for shift-based field work, and medical surveillance where exposures require it.

 - Own injury and illness recordkeeping across all sites so OSHA 300, 300A, and 301 logs, electronic submissions, and state filings are accurate, current, and defensible on inspection.

 - Turn claims, near-miss, and clinic data into a single view of injury trends and cost drivers that leadership and site HSE teams act on before the next claim, not after.

What We’re Looking For

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don’t fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 - You’ve personally managed a multi-state workers compensation program for a workforce of thousands, including carrier and TPA relationships, reserve reviews, and premium and experience-mod outcomes you can point to.

 - You’ve run case management for high-severity injuries in construction, manufacturing, or heavy industry, and your former employer’s return-to-work numbers moved because of you.

 - You’ve built a return-to-work or transitional duty program from nothing and gotten field supervisors and union or contractor workforces to use it.

 - You’ve led industrial hygiene and ergonomics work in the field: written the exposure assessments, pulled the samples, redesigned a task that was producing injuries, and stood up medical surveillance for a real hazard.

 - You’ve owned OSHA recordkeeping across many sites and been through an inspection or audit where the logs held up.

 - You work directly with carriers, adjusters, defense counsel, occupational physicians, HR on leave and accommodation interplay, and injured employees in the same week, and each of them gets a clear answer and a next step from you.

 - You build the program from data: you’ve pulled claims and clinic data into a trend view a COO would read and changed a control because of what it showed.

 - Bonus: Industrial hygiene or safety credentials (CIH, CSP). Case management or disability management credentials (CCM, CPDM, occupational health RN). Self-insured or high-deductible workers compensation programs and captive structures. Multi-state compliance in the states where we build (Texas non-subscriber rules, New York, Indiana, Louisiana). Claims and injury analytics tooling (Origami, Riskonnect, Intelex).



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.
