jobs.title: Senior Scheduler
jobs.description:
About Valar Atomics

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

The Team

The Construction and Infrastructure organization delivers the facilities, infrastructure, and construction projects required to support Valar's mission. The team manages planning, execution, and delivery of complex capital projects while ensuring quality, safety, and operational readiness.

The Role

Valar Atomics is seeking an experienced Senior Scheduler to develop, maintain, and coordinate schedules across manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, and program activities. The Scheduler will be responsible for translating project and production requirements into actionable schedules, tracking progress, identifying constraints and risks, and working cross-functionally to keep critical activities on schedule.

The ideal candidate has 5–7 years of experience in production scheduling, project scheduling, manufacturing planning, or project controls and is comfortable working in a fast-moving, high-mix manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain detailed production, manufacturing, and project schedules.

• Coordinate schedules across Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Procurement, and Operations.

• Establish activity sequences, dependencies, milestones, durations, and resource requirements.

• Track actual progress against baseline schedules and identify schedule variances.

• Monitor critical-path activities and proactively identify potential delays and constraints.

• Work with manufacturing and engineering teams to understand capacity, labor, equipment, material, and technical constraints.

• Develop short-term look-ahead schedules and longer-term production plans.

• Coordinate material availability and supplier commitments with the production schedule.

• Identify schedule conflicts and work with stakeholders to develop mitigation and recovery plans.

• Maintain accurate schedule data and provide regular status updates to project and functional leadership.

• Support production planning for prototype, development, and production hardware.

• Incorporate engineering changes, procurement status, manufacturing readiness, and quality requirements into schedules.

• Participate in cross-functional planning and production meetings.

• Develop schedule reports, dashboards, forecasts, and performance metrics for leadership.

• Support what-if analysis and scenario planning to evaluate schedule impacts.

• Maintain schedule integrity and ensure changes are properly documented and communicated.

• Help establish scalable scheduling processes and standards as the organization grows.

• Identify opportunities to improve planning, scheduling, and cross-functional coordination processes.

Basic Qualifications

• 5–7 years of experience in scheduling, production planning, project controls, manufacturing planning, or a related field.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Construction Management, Business, or a related discipline; equivalent experience may be considered.

• Strong understanding of scheduling concepts, dependencies, critical paths, milestones, and schedule forecasting.

• Experience working in a manufacturing, engineering, aerospace, energy, industrial, or other complex technical environment.

• Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and scheduling/planning tools.

• Ability to analyze large amounts of information and translate it into clear schedules and actionable priorities.

• Excellent communication and coordination skills.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a rapidly changing environment.

• Ability to work effectively with engineers, technicians, manufacturing personnel, supply chain teams, and leadership.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Experience with Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or similar scheduling platforms.

• Experience with ERP/MRP systems and production planning.

• Experience in high-mix, low-volume manufacturing.

• Experience scheduling complex assemblies, hardware, or engineered products.

• Knowledge of capacity planning, material requirements, and resource-loaded scheduling.

• Experience with critical-path analysis and schedule recovery planning.

• Experience working with engineering change orders and configuration-controlled products.

• Experience in aerospace, nuclear, energy, defense, advanced manufacturing, or another highly regulated technical environment.

• PMP, PMI-SP, AACE, or other relevant certification is a plus.

What We Offer

• Competitive base salary

• Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company

• Comprehensive medical benefits

• Unlimited PTO

• Free daily lunch

• Generous PPE stipend

• High-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy

• Opportunities for rapid career growth and internal advancement

• Direct collaboration with experienced operators, engineers, and industry leaders

• The opportunity to help build and scale transformative energy technology from the ground up

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Valar Atomics is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

We are committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment and will provide reasonable accommodation as required by law.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (green card holder).

jobs.title: Mission Support Engineer, EW
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) Business Line builds next-generation electronic warfare platforms that integrate with the broader Anduril Lattice ecosystem. The Mission Support team is responsible for ensuring these systems are operationally ready, successfully deployed, and continuously-supported.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Mission Support Engineer, you will be instrumental in keeping Anduril's EW systems running at peak performance. Our products are designed to provide real-time radio frequency (RF) spectrum awareness, threat detection, and electronic mitigation capabilities at the tactical edge. End users and deployed Anduril personnel will rely on your critical thinking and diligence.

You will be the critical link between fielded systems and engineering -- feeding data, insights, and operational requirements directly back to development teams to drive product improvements. You will thrive in this position if you have a passion for teamwork and solving complicated software, hardware, and RF systems issues. You must be quick to learn, adopt, and execute complex technical functions. You will be expected to take extreme ownership of your work and support deployed systems across multiple operational environments. Everything you do will be leveraged to shape the future of Anduril systems.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own the operational performance of deployed EW systems across multiple theaters, serving as the primary technical interface between field operations and engineering

• Investigate and resolve system anomalies end-to-end — from initial detection through root cause isolation, corrective action, and post-incident documentation

• Contribute to the validation and fielding of new EW software builds, including pre-deployment verification and operational acceptance testing

• Leverage Linux diagnostics, log analysis, and command-line tooling to drive resolution and deploy cutting edge software solutions

• Partner with engineering and product teams to continuously enhance fleet-wide monitoring, alerting, and health telemetry for EW assets

• Aggregate and interpret field performance data to identify failure patterns, inform preventive maintenance strategies, and guide engineering investment decisions

• Serve as a trusted point of contact for customers, managing technical issues with clear communication, defined timelines, and follow-through from identification to closure

• Translate operational feedback and mission requirements into actionable input for product development, advocating for capability improvements grounded in real-world employment

• Develop and maintain deep technical fluency across the EW product portfolio, enabling effective communication between operators, engineers, and program stakeholders

• Orchestrate cross-functional responses to complex sustainment challenges, aligning business operations, engineering, and field support teams to optimize system availability

• Provide structured mission insights and deployment lessons-learned to software and hardware engineering teams, shaping roadmap priorities and informing design decisions

• Travel to field sites, if desired and opportunities arise – not required

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 3+ years’ defense industry, USG, or DoD/DoW experience performing technical operations

• Experience working with and/or deploying complex software solutions

• Experience with distributed communication networks and system-of-systems architectures

• Ability to quickly understand and navigate disaggregated networking systems

• A desire to perform high-stakes, critical, and time-sensitive functions with real-world impact

• A bias for action, extreme ownership, and self-driving motivation to see projects through

• Experience supporting incident-driven workflows

• Excellent written, visual, and verbal communication skills

• Ability to work non-standard hours and weekends, as needed

• Ability to obtain and maintain SECRET security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• BS in STEM discipline, preferably in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, information technology, or similar

• Industry networking certifications, such as CompTIA Sec+/Net+, CCNA, Linux+, or similar

• Experience supporting or operating EW systems, software defined radios, or RF sensors as a DoD/DoW employee, contractor, or end-user

• Familiarity with RF and EW applications, power, antenna concepts, and spectrum analysis

• Experience building, deploying, or testing autonomous systems or software in real-world operational environments

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and release management processes

• Experience with containerized deployments (Kubernetes, Docker, etc.)

• Experience with observability tooling such as DataDog, Grafana, and Victor Ops; exposure to software development tooling such as Git and Jira

• Experience with Nix/NixOS

• Experience performing trend analysis to inform business decisions

• Experience with military systems and operational tactics

• Active SECRET or TOP SECRET security clearance

US Salary Range

$146,000—$194,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Investor Solutions
jobs.description:
At Similarweb, we are revolutionizing the way businesses interact with the digital world by revealing to them everything that happens online.

Our unique data and solutions empower over 6,000 customers globally, including industry giants like Google, Meta, and OpenAI, to make game-changing decisions that drive their digital strategies. In 2021, we went public on the New York Stock Exchange, and we continue to reach new heights! Come work alongside Similarwebbers across the globe who are bright, curious, practical, and good people.

We're looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to design, build and deliver the data products that power Similarweb's Investor Solutions products, alternative data structured for investment research, serving hedge funds, asset managers, and PE/VC firms.

This role will report to the VP, Investor Solutions.

Why is this role so important at Similarweb?
The Senior Technical PM bridges between our investor clients - quant researchers and fundamental analysts and the datasets built to serve them. Their expertise in data, alongside their finance domain knowledge, makes them the right product professional to translate how funds evaluate, test and use alternative data into scalable data products that clients backtest and trade on.

We are looking for a builder first - someone who prototypes and gets his hands dirty, comfortable with raw data, is skeptical by default, and is comfortable with ambiguity: the alt-data-in-the-AI-era playbook is still being written.

You will directly impact and steer the work of data scientists, data engineers and analysts by defining what ships, validating it against the raw data, and owning how it reaches clients. You will not hand specs to someone else and wait.

To achieve this, you will engage in:

• Own investor facing data products end-to-end: Defining the datasets, signals and metrics we sell - from raw assets and pipelines to datasets design, delivery and how clients will extract value..

• Own the investor data products strategy and roadmap, identify opportunities, plan them and execute.

• Data Quality: Owning coverage, accuracy and freshness as first-class product requirements.

• Schema and Delivery Design: Designing schemas and delivery specs for datasets and datafeeds (S3/Snowflake), APIs, and MCP tools.

• Hands-on Validation: Working in Python/SQL against raw data to validate hypotheses before committing engineering.

• Client Engagement: Working closely with funds, quant researchers and analysts; translating feedback into a roadmap.

• Data-backed Prioritization: Deciding what ships based on usage, backtest results and deal feedback.

• Guiding Data Development: Working closely with our data science and engineering team to develop the necessary data structures and production datasets based on the roadmap.

• Collaborating with Stakeholders: Writing clear requirements, presenting to leadership, and aligning DS/DE/GTM/Analysts on what ships and when.

You will have fun and be successful in this role if you have the following:

Must have experience:

• 3+ years in product or data product roles where the product was the data.

• Finance domain: you've worked at or sold to hedge funds / asset managers and understand how alternative data is evaluated, tested and used in an investment process.

• Proven product ownership: you've driven discovery → definition → delivery → iteration with cross-functional teams.

• Recent experience shipping data products (datasets, datafeeds, APIs) involving diverse data entities and dependencies.

Skills:

• Builder-first, hands-on approach.

• Team-oriented mindset with the ability to work effectively with clients, quant researchers, data-sourcing teams, PMs, analysts, DS/DE, GTM and executives.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills - verbal and written.

• Ability to influence cross-functional teams and align them on what ships and when.

• Based in New York (hybrid, flexible).

Technical and Analytical Requirements:

• Strong data skills - data analysis, dataset building - from schema definition to data pipelines

• Experience building and analyzing data with AI tools and agents

• Hands-on Python, comfortable working with big datasets and financial data.

• Alternative data experience — vendor side, buy-side data team, or data-sourcing role — is an advantage.

• Familiarity with backtesting workflows, factor research, or earnings-preview research is an advantage.

• API / MCP / AI-era product experience is an advantage.

*Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.*

**At Similarweb, collaborating with our colleagues in the office creates a more connected, unified culture. Our best work is a product of our face-to-face collaboration, with the ability to work partially from home.**

The base salary range for this position in the New York City area is $145,000 to $195,000, plus benefits, including: medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401K plan, potential equity, employee stock purchase plan, and paid sick and parental leave.

The base salary range above is for the New York City area, and could vary for candidates in other locations.

Why you’ll love being a Similarwebber:

You’ll actually love the product you work with: Our customers aren’t our only raving fans. When we asked our employees why they chose to come work at Similarweb, 99% of them said “the product.” Imagine how exciting your job is when you get to work with the most powerful digital intelligence platform in the world.

You’ll find a home for your big ideas:  We encourage an open dialogue and empower employees to bring their ideas to the table. You’ll find the resources you need to take initiative and create meaningful change within the organization.

We offer competitive perks & benefits: We take your well-being seriously, and offer competitive compensation packages to all employees. We also put a strong emphasis on community, with regular team outings and happy hours.

You can grow your career in any direction you choose: Interested in becoming a VP or want to transition into a different department? Whether it’s Career Week, personalized coaching, or our ongoing learning solutions, you’ll find all the tools and opportunities you need to develop your career right here.

Diversity isn’t just a buzzword: People want to work in a place where they can be themselves. We strive to create a workplace that is reflective of the communities we serve, where everyone is empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work. We are committed to inclusivity across race, gender, ethnicity, culture, sexual orientation, age, religion, spirituality, identity and experience. We believe our culture of equality and mutual respect also helps us better understand and serve our customers in a world that is becoming more global, more diverse, and more digital every day.

jobs.description:
Fairstead is a purpose-driven real estate firm dedicated to building affordable communities across the country. Headquartered in New York, with offices in Colorado, Florida, and Washington DC, Fairstead owns and manages a portfolio of more than 30,000 apartments, including pipeline, across 28 states. As an integrated owner, operator, and innovator, Fairstead brings development, construction, and property management under one unified platform to deliver high-quality affordable housing that serves our residents at scale.

At Fairstead, we believe affordable housing should be thoughtfully designed, professionally managed, and responsibly operated. We seek to create and preserve housing that serves residents while delivering long-term value to communities, partners, and stakeholders.

Fairstead challenges industry norms through our tech-forward, entrepreneurial approach to affordable housing. In addition to core real estate capabilities, we operate innovative service lines designed to improve resident outcomes, strengthen communities, and drive operational efficiency. We embrace digital transformation, data-driven decision-making, and emerging technologies, including AI, to build scalable systems that support sustainable growth, grounded in a culture of entrepreneurship, innovation, partnership, dedication, and integrity.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Source & Engage

• Proactively source and screen candidates for porter, maintenance technician, and other site-level roles across the portfolio.

• Conduct high-volume candidate outreach via job boards, and sourcing tools to keep a steady, healthy pipeline for fast-turnover roles.

• Write and post job listings and respond promptly to inbound applicants to keep response times fast.

• Partner with site and regional hiring managers to understand staffing needs and priority openings.

• Ability to travel to multiple locations to host onsite job fairs.

Schedule & Coordinate

• Own interview scheduling and coordination between candidates and hiring managers, often across multiple sites and time zones at once.

• Manage a high volume of candidates and requisitions simultaneously without losing track of where each one stands.

• Keep the ATS current and accurate — candidate status, notes, and next steps — so pipeline health is always visible.

• Follow up quickly with candidates and hiring managers to keep the process moving and minimize drop-off.

• Assist with running background and reference checks and coordinate with IT to set up new hires ahead of their start date.

• Open and close requisitions in the ATS, post roles to job boards, and pull weekly pipeline and headcount reports for the Talent Acquisition Manager.

• Handle offer logistics: generate offer letters, track signatures, and confirm start dates with site managers.

Candidate Experience & Support

• Serve as a candidate's first point of contact: answer questions, set expectations, and keep communication clear and timely given the pace of hiring.

• Flag bottlenecks, ghosting, or process issues to the Talent Acquisition Manager and suggest fixes.

• Support the broader recruiting team on additional non-manager searches as volume requires.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

• Fast, consistent turnaround on scheduling and candidate follow-up, even with a high number of open roles at once.

• Strong, steady pipeline volume for porter, maintenance, and other site-level roles, with low candidate drop-off.

• Accurate, up-to-date ATS records that give an honest picture of pipeline health at a glance.

• Hiring managers who feel supported and kept in the loop, even during high-volume stretches.

• Positive candidate feedback on communication and the overall hiring experience.

QUALIFICATIONS

• 2 - 3 years of recruiting, sourcing, or recruiting-coordination experience, ideally in a high-volume or fast-paced environment.

• Comfortable managing a large number of open roles and candidates at once without losing organization or accuracy.

• Hands-on experience with an ATS (Greenhouse experience a strong plus) and comfort learning sourcing and scheduling tools.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills — clear, prompt, and professional with candidates and hiring managers alike.

• Excellent organization and time-management skills; able to prioritize on the fly as needs shift.

• A proactive, hands-on attitude — comfortable doing outreach, not just posting and waiting.

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience recruiting for property management, maintenance, trades, hospitality, retail, or other high-volume, front-line industries.

• Experience with AI-powered sourcing, screening, or scheduling tools.

• Bilingual (English/Spanish) a plus given our site-level candidate population.

• Experience recruiting across multiple markets or locations at once.

jobs.title: Facilities and Workplace Sr. Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You & the Role

Zipline’s Test sites, Operations, and Maintenance Hub teams need safe, reliable facilities to build and operate autonomous delivery systems. As Facilities and Workplace Sr. Coordinator you will own day-to-day facilities execution for the sites outside of South San Francisco, reducing preventable downtime and keeping spaces ready for engineering, logistics, manufacturing, and workplace use.

You will set maintenance priorities, coordinate technicians where applicable, and hold service providers accountable for scope, quality, cost, and schedule. You will own facilities execution and maintenance-program improvements while partnering with internal stakeholders, contractors, and consultants on site needs and capital improvements.

What You’ll Do

• Prioritize repairs and maintenance across building systems, grounds, and site infrastructure based on safety, operational impact, reliability, cost, and urgency.

• Coordinate technicians where applicable and external vendors; define work scope, track service KPIs, and address quality, schedule, or performance gaps.

• Manage facilities, custodial, grounds, catering, valet, and workplace-service contracts, including purchasing, invoice reconciliation, service quality, and cost control.

• Assess facility and infrastructure risks and improve preventive and corrective maintenance programs to protect site readiness and reduce avoidable disruption.

• Coordinate materials, equipment, and service providers for repairs, maintenance, and upgrades to interior, exterior, and grounds systems.

• With EHS oversight, supervise hazardous materials and hazardous waste compliance programs, maintaining required records and adherence to applicable safety and environmental regulations.

• Coordinate facilities portions of capital improvements with internal partners: IT/Finance/Production/Finance etc and external partners like contractors and consultants; maintain drawings, permits, project records, and documentation for current and future facilities.

• Ability to provide occasional after-hours support, including responding to facilities emergencies, urgent operational needs, and other time-sensitive issues as required.

What You’ll Bring

• 5+ years of facilities management experience in a light-industrial, commercial, aviation/drone, or technology environment.

• Hands-on experience coordinating repairs, maintenance, and upgrades for building systems, grounds, and site infrastructure.

• Experience delivering or supporting facility capital improvement projects, including contractor coordination, documentation, permits, and project records.

• Experience managing service vendors or contractors, including scope definition, performance evaluation, cost control, and issue resolution.

• Working knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance programs, facilities safety practices, and hazardous materials or hazardous waste compliance.

• Ability to make sound maintenance-priority decisions across competing operational needs with minimal guidance in a multi-site or operationally complex environment.

Agility’s commercially deployed humanoids operate alongside teams in warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and distribution centers—tackling physically demanding and repetitive tasks while enabling workers to focus on higher-value work. With industry-leading safety standards and years of proven deployment data, we're pioneering a new era of automation that enhances human potential.

The Director of Fleet Applications  will leverage multiple teams of full-stack, front-end and cloud services developers to deliver Arc to our customers. Arc is a cloud SaaS platform that handles software distribution, device configuration and status, data lakehousing, and task workflow management for  deployed Digit fleets and their ecosystem devices. It enables supervisors to inspect metrics, manage workflows and workcells, and administer robot and device assets. Additionally, you will also drive the product vision for our Robot Operations Center and deliver applications focused on customer support, remote issue resolution and service.

The Director will work with Product partners, Principal Architects and TPMs, to define and deliver the product vision. This is an execution focused  role, ensuring speedy delivery into production and data-driven continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:

• Delivery of Arc Platform. Crafting the technical roadmap and commit to dates based on product and customer targets. Lead resource and staffing planning accordingly.

• Multiple teams, one roadmap. A UI team building the on-robot interfaces and the web and mobile experiences, and a cloud services team owning workflow orchestration, resource management, and fleet data aggregation from the edge. Your job is to make them feel like one organization with one set of commitments.

• Technical roadmaps & decision making. Achieve team buy-in and consensus on OSS selection, language and framework choices, service boundaries, API contracts. You bring a point of view, you invite the Principal Architect to disagree with it, and you close the decision so the teams can move.

• Requirements on your upstream dependencies. SOC 2 readiness and the multi-cell and single-tenant deployment architectures come from the Cloud Platform team. You need enough depth to write the requirements they build against and to review their proposals critically, not to accept them on faith.

• New surfaces for the fleet. Applications that let our support engineers diagnose and resolve customer-raised issues remotely, and mobile experiences that let a site leader check on their Digit fleet without sitting at a desk.

• The team itself. Hiring, leveling, performance, and growth for a fully distributed engineering organization.

Required Qualifications

• You have led multiple engineering teams (managing managers and senior ICs) towards product delivery on a committed timeline, and you can describe what slipped and what you did about it.

• You have taken a product from bespoke or single-customer delivery to a multi-tenant SaaS offering — or done the reverse, standing up single-tenant deployments for enterprise customers who demanded isolation.

• You are technical enough to review an architecture proposal, argue about a language, OSS or tech stack choice on the merits.

• You have worked with mature CI/CD pipelines and Release Engineering teams and processes to accelerate ship cadence as well as software quality for your teams.

• You have managed distributed teams of remote ICs.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Data Management - DATS
jobs.description:
We are global private markets specialists delivering tailored investment solutions, advisory services, and impactful, data driven insights to the world’s investors. Leveraging the power of our platform and our peerless intelligence across sectors, strategies, and geographies, we help identify the advantages and the answers our clients need to succeed.

Position Overview:
Data Analytics & Technology Solutions (DATS) is StepStone’s unified data analytics and technology department. We build SPI by StepStone, the proprietary technology platform our clients use to navigate private markets, and we deliver the data solutions, automation, and analytics that teams across the firm use every day. The integrity of everything DATS produces depends on the data management processes that sit underneath it.

This role is responsible for the collection, ingestion, validation, and mapping of private markets data across a defined and growing set of business processes within the firm. In private markets, data rarely arrives in a format that is ready to use. This role will be responsible for data processes based on unstructured fund manager documents, structured data in formats that need to be translated into different formats, and direct data collection campaigns. Further, the role will also oversee the consolidation and mapping of data records contained within the proprietary and third-party platforms used across the firm. This individual will maintain an intimate relationship with the data to establish and modernize processes through the strategic use of technology and AI, partnering with engineering, analytics, and product teams across DATS to replace manual effort with scalable, automated workflows while maintaining appropriate human-in-the-loop oversight. The role carries direct management responsibility for a team of data management professionals and oversight of offshore and vendor capacity.

Essential Job Functions:

• Owns the end-to-end design, execution, and quality of data management workflows within the team’s scope, from intake and extraction through validation, mapping, and release to downstream systems and clients

• Establishes the control framework for data quality: accuracy and completeness standards, automated checks and exception queues, and accountability to defined SLAs

• Leads the application of AI and automation across its data management processes, including data extraction, classification, entity resolution, and mapping, while evaluating technologies, designing human-in-the-loop workflows, and measuring accuracy gains and efficiency improvements against manual processes

• Assesses current-state workflows to find the root causes of rework and error, and delivers redesigned processes with documented procedures, controls, and measurable throughput gains

• Governs the data mapping framework that connects source data to StepStone’s enterprise data model, including taxonomies, entity hierarchies, identifiers, and the processes for proposing, approving, versioning, and maintaining mapping rules

• Manages and develops a team across onshore, offshore, and vendor resources. Sets priorities and capacity plans and builds training and quality review programs

• Partners with DATS engineering, analytics, and product teams to translate recurring operational pain into platform capability, writing clear requirements and following through to adoption

• Serves as the escalation point for data quality issues raised across investment, finance, reporting, and client-facing teams, driving resolution to root cause rather than symptom

• Defines, tracks, and reports operational KPIs across volume, cycle time, quality, cost, and automation, using performance trends to determine where the team should focus its next investments and improvement efforts

Education and/or Work Experience Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field

• 5 to 8+ years in data management, investment operations, or a comparable data-intensive function, preferably within private markets or alternative asset management

• Demonstrated experience designing and implementing data workflows at scale, with a track record of specific processes automated and the gains that resulted

• Direct people management experience, including managing offshore or vendor delivery

• Hands-on experience applying technology (and ideally AI) to operational data problems, including document extraction, data classification, mapping, and quality controls to ensure reliability

• Working knowledge of private markets data, including fund structures, cash flows, performance reporting, and portfolio company financials

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

• Process design skills, including the ability to look at a manual workflow, see the version that should exist, and build the plan to get there

• Genuine technical fluency with the ability to read and write SQL, reason about data models and APIs, work with modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Power BI, Power Platform), and hold a credible conversation with engineers

• Practical command of the current AI tooling landscape and honest judgment about where it is reliable enough to put in front of client-facing data

• Exceptional attention to detail, paired with the discipline to build controls that catch errors systematically rather than relying on individual vigilance

• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills; able to structure ambiguous problems and cut through to root causes

• Clear written and interpersonal communication, with the ability to represent the function credibly with senior stakeholders

• Ability to work independently and perform under deadlines in a dynamic environment

Salary: $130,000

jobs.title: Mentor, Claude Corps (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.

We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.

We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

About the Role

Location: Remote, United States

Role-Type: Part-Time, W2 Employee

Reports To: Senior Manager of AI Practice, Claude Corps

Compensation: $110,000 to $124,500 per year

Start Date: September 21st, ahead of the October 19th cohort launch

Together with Anthropic, CodePath launched Claude Corps in June 2026, a national fellowship program with a $150 million commitment to place 1,000 AI-trained fellows at nonprofits across America. A fellowship is only as good as the engineer riding alongside the fellow when something breaks at midnight. As a CodePath Mentor, that engineer is you.

You are the full-time technical coach for a portfolio of roughly ten pods: about 20 fellows across 8-12 host organizations, from pre-Basecamp through the final day of the program. You are the coach that develops the fellow: you have first eyes on every pull request, you catch the patterns when something is off, and you proactively resolve any roadblocks that come up. The host org directs the fellow's day-to-day work, the curriculum team owns what they learn, and your Sr. Manager of AI Practice is the manager of record who holds the performance bar. Your job is to make each fellow better at the work.

The work is mostly written and asynchronous: code review on pull requests, feedback on roadmap drafts and quarterly business reviews, weekly office hours, and a few synchronous deep dives when something needs more than text. You will not be the deepest expert in the room for every fellow, and we are honest about that. You carry the throughline: you know your pods end to end, see patterns nobody else sees, and pull in deeper expertise the moment a single fellow needs it.

This role is built for engineers who would rather coach 20 engineers through real production work than ship one feature themselves. You are a few years further down the road than the fellows: enough professional reps to read code with judgment, a real coaching instinct, and the AI-native practice fellows are being trained to build.

Key Responsibilities

Coach your pods

• Carry roughly 10 pods (about 20 fellows across 8 to 12 host organizations) full-time from pre-Basecamp through final day, calibrating your time across the portfolio rather than sinking into one pod

• Have first eyes on every fellow's pull request, and give structured written feedback on their real work (PRs, roadmap drafts, architecture proposals, QBR deliverables) at the cohort's pace, not your inbox's

• Facilitate weekly 1:1s with all of the Fellows that report to you and document their progress, challenges, and successes using the tooling that Claude Corps operates on

• Lead each fellow's Day 30/90/180/270 milestone review; you own the fellow-level synthesis and hand it up to your Sr. Manager of AI Practice, who owns the roll-up and the performance call

Deliver the curriculum in your pods

• Deliver the just-in-time modules the curriculum team designs; author lane- or pod-specific content when they commission it, because you have seen the gap from closer in

• Frame and debrief the cohort-wide all-hands your Sr. Manager of AI Practice runs, and the sessions where the curriculum team or a guest teaches your fellows directly

• Co-lead the Basecamp practical assessment alongside Anthropic's instructors; it is your first calibration on each cohort

Keep the program honest

• When the same problem shows up across three fellows, raise it to the right owner: the Claude Corps leadership team for program efficacy, the curriculum team for curriculum, partner experts for technical depth, host-org managers for a host issue, or your Sr. Manager of AI Practice for a delivery or performance issue

• Be the first stop when a fellow's technical work is at risk; surface it to your Sr. Manager of AI Practice, who owns the escalation

• Work AI-natively: Claude is core to your coaching loop for code review, pattern-spotting, and feedback at scale, and fellows should see you working the way they are being asked to work

Key Success Metrics

• You have surfaced the top three cohort-wide technical patterns to your Sr. Manager of AI Practice and the curriculum team

• 100% of host-org managers you've worked with in the last 30 days can produce one concrete example of your impact

• Every Day 30 review is done and documented, handed up to your Sr. Manager of AI Practice, with a plan for any fellow whose work is at risk or ready for the next challenge

Qualifications

Required

• 2 to 4 years of professional software engineering on a real team: long enough to have opinions about code, short enough to remember being the most junior engineer in the room

• Real coaching or mentorship reps, formal or not: an intern you saw through a summer, a teammate you onboarded, a bootcamp you TA'd. We are hiring the instinct, not a management title

• You can read a pull request you didn't write, in a stack you don't use every day, and give feedback that is specific and useful

• You have shipped production work with AI-assisted development tools and can describe specifically how your workflow changed; you have to be ahead of the fellows on this curve

• You are comfortable as a generalist coach: you find the answer or the right person quickly, and you trust partner experts to carry the depth you don't

• Strong written communication; most of your feedback is asynchronous, read by people who don't speak your stack

• Comfortable with remote, synchronous obligations across US time zones and about two evenings a month for cohort sessions and milestone reviews

Preferred

• TA, bootcamp coach, fellowship mentor, or instructor experience in a cohort program, even informally

• Experience at a small or scrappy organization where engineering meant translating business context into technical decisions

• Comfort across at least two of: web full-stack, data/AI engineering, ML, infra/devops

Compensation

CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position's level, no matter where you live. For this role, we're hiring for an Individual Contributor level position at an annual salary of $110,000 to $124,500. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process.

Full-Time Employee Benefits

This is a 100% remote position—work from anywhere in the U.S.! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

• Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program

• Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection

• Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)

• Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support

• ​​Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt

• Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings

Pay range

$110,000—$124,500 USD

jobs.title: G&A Recruiter
jobs.description:
ABOUT MERCOR



Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a G&A Recruiter at Mercor, you’ll own full-cycle hiring for critical roles across a variety of Finance, Legal, Marketing and People. You would be Mercor's first dedicated G&A recruiter, partnering with senior leadership and C-Suites to not only make critical hires for the business, but to lay the foundation for how G&A recruiting will operate at Mercor moving forward. 




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own full-cycle recruiting (sourcing → close) across a variety of organizations such as marketing, finance, legal and people ops

 - Partner directly with C-Suite Leadership to map out needs and implement continual process improvements

 - Build top-of-funnel using creative outbound, talent intelligence, and Mercor’s own product (structured screens, automated work samples, and calibrated rubrics)

 - Coach hiring managers and interviewers on structured interviewing, leveling, and decision hygiene

 - Operationalize hiring systems: track and optimize key funnel metrics (pass-through rates, time-in-stage, source yield)

 - Champion speed and quality: drive SLAs for same-day debriefs, fast offers, and strong candidate experience

 - Build brand: campaigns, referrals, and events that attract top engineers and operators

 - Represent Mercor externally, you’ll be a face of the brand for an exceptionally competitive talent market

 - Collaborate on dashboards, metrics, and process automation within Ashby and other recruiting systems

 - Refinement of technical recruiting motion as the Ops org shifts to hire more frequently from technical backgrounds
   
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years experience with full-cycle recruiting across IC and leadership roles

 - Proven success hiring across a range of roles and departments, with the ability to context switch across departments with ease

 - Ability to build and scale hiring systems, identify key metrics, and make data-driven decisions

 - Strong communication skills; able to work efficiently with General Managers, Strategic Project Leads and Mercor’s President

 - Confident representing the Mercor brand to top candidates

 - Familiarity with Ashby or ability to quickly adopt new tools and systems
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience as a founding recruiter or early-stage startup builder

 - Interest in the human data / AGI space

 - Prior experience leveraging Ashby as an ATS
   
   


IDEAL QUALITIES

 - Agility / Adaptability - ability to move fast, pivot with business shifts, and maintain best-in-class outcomes

 - Operational Rigor - ability to bring order to an unstructured environment

 - Growth Mindset - You don’t need to be an expert on AI, but you do need to have a strong desire to learn and continue learning in a rapidly evolving, frontier industry

 - Commitment to the Outcome - Ownership mentality; will hold themselves accountable to an extremely high standard of work

 - Love for the Craft - we are building a zero to one motion; this hire will bring a low ego attitude to the table with a genuine love for building a best-in-class talent acquisition organization
   
   


BENEFITS

 - $15K relocation bonus (for moving to the Bay Area)

 - $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

 - $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

 - Free Equinox membership

 - $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

 - $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

 - Health, Dental, Vision insurance

 - 401(k) with company match

UBP is an operating partner of Strongpoint Partners, a leading tech-enabled financial services retirement platform backed by Shore Capital Partners (SCP).

Position Summary:

United Benefit Pensions, (UBP), a Strongpoint Partner, is seeking a skilled Retirement Plan Administrator who will take full ownership of a caseload of defined contribution retirement plans. The right candidate will be confident in administering 401(k) and cross-tested plans from start to finish, have a strong command of compliance testing, and possess a detail-oriented, client-focused approach. This position offers an excellent opportunity for a self-starter who thrives in a remote work environment and is excited to grow with a firm that values innovation and excellence in client service.

At UBP, you’ll join a team that values flexibility, trust, and balance just as much as technical excellence. We operate in a relaxed, supportive environment where you’re treated like a professional - able to manage your schedule, step out for life’s appointments, and still wrap up the day at 4 PM right along with the rest of us. If you enjoy collaborating with colleagues, partnering with clients, and contributing to a team that truly respects your time and expertise, you’ll feel right at home here.

PLEASE NOTE: This role is based in UBP's office in Melville, NY and ideally follows a hybrid work model; however, full remote work will be considered for the right candidate.

Key Responsibilities:

• Administer full-cycle (A-Z) plan operations for a book of 401(k) and cross-tested retirement plans.

• Knowledge of ERISA regulations.

• Proficient in Datair/CalcAir software, (preferred).

jobs.title: Data analytics engineer
jobs.description:
Hybrid working one day per week in our London, Edinburgh or Bath office.




ABOUT US

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

 

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

 

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

 

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

 

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

 

Check out the Seccl website https://seccl.tech/ to see what we’re building and read more about our mission https://seccl.tech/about/ to shape the future of investments.

 




THE ROLE

Seccl is growing fast, and so is the opportunity to make better use of our data. Our Data Engineering team has built strong foundations for reliable, scalable data delivery, and we’re now expanding our capabilities to make that data more accessible, actionable, and valuable to our teams and clients.



As a Data Analytics Engineer, you’ll sit at the intersection of data engineering and analytics. You’ll use strong software engineering and data modelling practices to develop production-quality datasets, while working closely with stakeholders to understand how data can help solve real business problems.



You’ll also help us evolve how data moves through our platform, including opportunities to work with streaming and event-driven technologies as we move towards more timely and incremental data processing.



 


ON A TYPICAL DAY YOU WILL BE…

 - Designing, building, and maintaining robust data models using SQL and DBT, transforming complex source data into clear, reusable datasets for analytics and downstream consumers

 - Working with Product managers, Engineers, Operations, and client-facing teams to understand requirements, clarify business logic, and translate problems into scalable data solutions

 - Helping define and maintain consistent metrics, modelling standards, and analytical best practices across the business

 - Supporting our journey towards more real-time and incremental data processing, including working with technologies such as MongoDB change streams, Kafka, and AWS MSK

 - Helping teams become more self-sufficient with data by making datasets understandable, well documented, and easy to consume



You’ll be successful in this role if you…

 - Have strong SQL and data modelling skills and are comfortable transforming large, complex datasets into reliable, reusable analytical models

 - Have experience with Python and modern analytics engineering tooling such as DBT, including testing, documentation, version control, and CI/CD practices

 - Are familiar with both relational and non-relational database architecture

 - Understand dimensional modelling and how to design datasets that are intuitive and effective for analytics, BI, and downstream data products

 - Have experience working with cloud data platforms and services, ideally within AWS

 - Ideally have experience with event-driven or streaming data architectures, particularly Kafka/AWS MSK, MongoDB change streams, CDC, or similar technologies

 - Have hands on experience working with an orchestration tool such as Airflow

 - Thrive in cross-functional collaboration, working effectively with Product managers, Engineers, Operations, analysts, and client facing teams 

 - Communicate clearly and can explain technical concepts and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Take ownership of problems end-to-end, from understanding the requirement and designing the solution through to implementation, validation, documentation, and adoption




THIS ROLE ISN’T FOR YOU IF:

 - You rely on heavily on top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a freedom and ownership early on – it’s up to you to shape your growth and deliver outcomes

 - You’re uncomfortable in a fast-paced environment. Our ability to move quickly and scale effectively is key to our success – we need people who can adapt and think on their feet

 - You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who not only think big, but also deliver

 - You resist change. We’re growing quickly, and the environment can be ambiguous – you’ll thrive here if you see change as an opportunity rather than a hurdle




WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU…

We offer a generous blend of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including:

💰A salary between £55,000 and £75,000 – dependant on experience + reviewed annually

🌴27 days holiday + bank holidays (some can be flexible) + day off on your birthday + three days (full time) per year for Dependant leave

💙 Two volunteering days per year

🏅 Length of service award – one month paid sabbatical at eight years

✅ 6% employer pension contribution, and life assurance

🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

👪 Enhanced Parental leave

💻 MacBook and up to £500 home office set up budget

📖 £750 per person learning budget

🌎 Option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

🌻 Health and wellbeing initiatives including free therapy via Wellness Cloud, mental health support via Headspace

🌱 Strong financial wellbeing focus including access to Octopus Money https://octopusmoney.com/, Octopus Share Incentive Plan, will writing offering via Octopus Legacy and Seccl invest (our own platform for you to manage your investments)

🎁 Perkbox https://www.perkbox.com/uk – Flexi-points giving you a range of discounts and perks including free weekly coffee, gym and retail discounts.

🚲 Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing




OUR CULTURE

We're proud to put people first, creating a culture where we truly listen to what matters most to them. Our transparent and inclusive environment encourages diversity of thought, challenge and experimentation.



Check out our Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Reviews/Seccl-Reviews-E3185313.htm page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/11050304/admin/ for company updates and insights from the team.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

Interviewing is a two-way thing, and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you. Our interviews are conversational, so come with questions and be curious. In general, you can expect the interview process to look a bit like this:

 - Talent screen - 30 mins

 - First round - 40 mins

 - Second round - 60 mins

 - Bar raiser - 40 mins



⏳ We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out and you should expect to hear back from us within one to two weeks of applying.



🌈 Our aim is to build a diverse and inclusive company of awesome people, with unique skills, passions and experiences. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.



If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Ink Technician (3rd Shift)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Flexographic Prep & Ink Technician to provide vital staging,

setup, and material preparation for our production press teams. In this role, you will lead ink

formulations, plate mounting, and roller preparation to ensure smooth, efficient job changeovers.

Your work directly minimizes machine downtime (makeready), maintains high print quality

standards, and drives overall manufacturing efficiency. If you have a strong mechanical

background, keen visual accuracy, and enjoy hands-on technical support in a fast-paced

environment, this role offers an exceptional opportunity to make an immediate impact.

Essential Job Functions

• Precision-mount flexographic printing plates onto cylinders to ensure accurate register during printing.
• Prepare, clean, and inspect anilox rollers before and after production runs.
• Mount gears, handles, and hardware onto plate cylinders and anilox rollers.
• Utilize anilox scopes to measure cell volume and assess roller condition for quality control.
• Maintain inventory of molded plates, ordering replacements as needed to avoid production delays.
• Inspect, prep, and coordinate the shipping of worn cylinders or rollers for off-site reconditioning.
• Receive, stage, and distribute inks directly to press lines
• Collaborate with press operators to streamline setup procedures and execute additional operational tasks as assigned.

Key Qualifications & Skills

• Proven experience or strong mechanical skills working with industrial tooling, machinery, or complex mechanical setups. Ability to read and interpret technical drawings or blueprints.
• Outstanding visual accuracy and high attention to detail for precise color matching, viscosity testing, and plate mounting alignment.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks, meet tight deadlines, and adapt quickly to shifting production needs.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills to coordinate effectively across pressroom staff, inventory control, and management.
• Ability to work productively both independently and in a collaborative team setting, taking initiative to solve problems and improve pressroom workflows.
• Comfort working in an active manufacturing environment – including standing, walking, bending, stooping and reaching on concrete floors throughout the shift.
• Frequent manual lifting, pushing, pulling, and carrying of items weighing up to 35 lbs (such as ink buckets, chemical pails and plate cylinders).

This is a 3rd shift position, Monday through Friday from 11:00 P.M. to 7:00 A.M., rotating Saturdays as needed, in a climate controlled environment.

Disclosure Statement:

The pay range for this role at the noted location is $19.50 to $31.00 per hour. The actual rate of pay offered may vary based upon, but not limited to: education, skills, experience, proficiency, performance, shift, and location. In addition to base salary, depending on the role, the total compensation package may also include overtime, shift differential, call-in, and stand-by pay. RRD offers benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, disability insurance, 401(k) with match, life insurance and other voluntary supplemental insurance coverages, plus tuition assistance, maternity leave, adoption assistance, and employer/partner discounts.

RRD is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/veterans

We appreciate your cooperation as we work to maintain a transparent and equitable hiring process.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Recruiter
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

We are seeking a Principal Technical Recruiter to join our Global Talent Acquisition organization, reporting directly to the Director of Talent Acquisition — Product, IT & Strategy. This is a high-impact, full-cycle recruiting role designed for a seasoned talent professional who operates at the intersection of strategic advisor, delivery expert, and transformation leader.

As a Principal-level contributor, you will own the end-to-end recruitment experience for some of WD's most critical and complex technical disciplines—including Product Management, Software Engineering, Data & Analytics, IT Infrastructure, Corporate Strategy, and New Business Ventures. You will be expected to not only close requisitions, but to elevate how we recruit through data intelligence, stakeholder influence, and innovative program ownership.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

1. Full-Cycle Talent Delivery

• Own the complete recruitment lifecycle—from intake and sourcing strategy through offer negotiation and close—for mid to senior-level technical and strategic roles across Product, IT & Strategy.
• Partner deeply with hiring managers, HRBPs, and business leaders to develop tailored hiring strategies aligned to approved headcount plans and workforce priorities
• Maintain a high bar for candidate quality and experience, ensuring every interaction reflects WD's employer brand and values
• Proactively manage requisition loads with urgency and precision, consistently meeting or exceeding time-to-fill, offer acceptance, and quality-of-hire benchmarks
• Navigate ambiguous, fast-moving, and highly specialized talent markets with confidence and adaptability

2. Market Intelligence & Data-Driven Recruiting

• Serve as the subject matter expert on talent supply and demand dynamics for your assigned business units, including compensation benchmarking, competitor talent mapping, and skills availability analysis
• Leverage labor market data platforms (LinkedIn Talent Insights, Lightcast, Radford/Mercer) to deliver actionable intelligence to hiring managers and HR partners
• Use data to identify pipeline gaps, forecast hiring outcomes, and drive accountability across the funnel
• Present structured, data-backed hiring updates and market insights to business leaders and TA leadership on a regular cadence

3. Strategic Talent Advisor

• Function as a trusted advisor and thought partner to senior business stakeholders—including VPs and Directors—on hiring strategy, workforce planning, and talent market realities
• Challenge and influence hiring decisions through consultative dialogue, including calibrating role requirements, leveling discussions, and competitive positioning
• Partner with HRBPs and Total Rewards to build compelling, competitive offer packages that win in the current market
• Develop and champion proactive talent pipelines for critical capability areas, reducing dependency on reactive hiring cycles
• Represent TA in business planning conversations and contribute to longer-term workforce strategy initiatives

4. Program Management & TA Transformation

• Identify, design, and own recruitment programs and process improvement initiatives that elevate the effectiveness and scalability of the Global TA function
• Lead or co-lead projects such as: hiring manager enablement programs, structured interviewing frameworks, diversity sourcing strategies, candidate experience improvements, or new role intake process design
• Apply project management discipline to TA initiatives—defining scope, milestones, stakeholders, and success metrics—and drive cross-functional execution from ideation to adoption
• Serve as an internal champion for TA innovation, bringing external best practices inside and advocating for changes that improve speed, quality, and equity in hiring
• Document and socialize process improvements to ensure scalability and knowledge transfer across the TA team

5. Tools, Technology & AI Integration

• Demonstrate fluency across the modern recruiting technology stack, including ATS platforms, CRM tools, sourcing platforms, and productivity suites
• Actively incorporate AI-powered tools into daily recruiting workflows—including candidate sourcing and outreach personalization, resume screening, market research, job description drafting, and pipeline analytics
• Evaluate and pilot emerging TA technologies; provide structured feedback and recommendations to TA leadership on adoption and integration
• Mentor peers on effective and ethical use of AI and automation in recruiting workflows
• Stay current on developments in recruiting technology, generative AI, and people analytics as they apply to talent acquisition

This Role Is For You If...

• You have 8+ years of full-cycle technical recruiting experience and a proven track record placing talent across product, material science, hardware, firmware, software, IT, or corporate strategy disciplines
• You are energized by owning the room with senior leaders—presenting market data, pushing back on unrealistic expectations, and earning a seat at the strategic table
• You see data as your first language—you're not guessing on compensation, pipeline health, or market availability; you're pulling the numbers and telling the story
• You've gone beyond your requisition list to build programs, fix broken processes, or launch initiatives that made your TA team better
• You live in the tools—Workday, LinkedIn Recruiter, sourcing platforms, and AI-assisted workflows are part of your daily rhythm, not occasional experiments
• You thrive in complex, matrixed, global environments where ambiguity is the norm and self-direction is required
• You bring a consultative mindset to every search—understanding the business context behind every hire, not just the job description in front of you

You're Probably Not a Fit If...

• You'd rather take orders than give counsel—this role requires you to challenge, advise, and influence, not just execute what you're told
• You treat data as someone else's job—if you can't build a pipeline report, benchmark a comp package, or speak to talent market dynamics, this isn't the right seat for you
• You've spent your career working reqs and nothing else—we need someone who sees program ownership and process transformation as core to the role, not a distraction from it
• You're still figuring out what AI tools exist, let alone how to use them—this team moves fast and expects fluency, not curiosity from scratch
• You need a fully defined playbook to operate effectively—ambiguity, shifting priorities, and white-space problem solving are features here, not bugs
• You get uncomfortable pushing back on a VP or a hiring manager—if you default to agreement to avoid conflict, the strategic impact of this role won't be realized
• You think candidate experience ends at the offer—we care deeply about the full arc of every interaction, from first outreach to close, and so should you

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience recruiting within the semiconductor, data storage, hardware, or enterprise technology sectors
• Prior agency or executive search background combined with in-house corporate experience
• Exposure to workforce planning, organizational design, or HR business partnering conversations
• Proficiency with platforms such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Beamery, SeekOut, Gem, Tableau, or Power BI

jobs.title: Practice Lead | Dynatrace/Observability (Remote)
jobs.description:

Ready to discover the possibilities that live in technology?

Come Join Us!

We “bring the weather” by exhibiting positive leadership and solution-focused thinking. We hug people in their trials, struggles, and failures – not just their success. We appreciate the individuality of the people around us.

Role Summary
Trace3 is seeking a senior observability leader to serve as technical lead for our Dynatrace practice. This individual will guide delivery quality across the practice, mentor recently certified consultants, and lead customer-facing observability strategy engagements. The role is positioned to grow into leadership of the broader Observability Services group.

Required Qualifications

Dynatrace Technical Leadership
