jobs.title: Team Lead, OpenADMET
jobs.description:
COMPANY

Octant is a clinical-stage drug discovery company developing correctors for protein misfolding diseases with active programs in rare diseases and oncology. Octant’s platform, The Navigator, combines high-throughput synthetic biology, generative chemistry, and AI/ML to discover and develop therapeutics against complex cellular mechanisms in human cells.

JOB DESCRIPTION

We are seeking a team lead to head Octant’s OpenADMET team. OpenADMET is a multi-institution open science consortium, spanning Octant, UCSF, and the Open Molecular Software Foundation (OMSF), on a mission to solve ADMET prediction and make ADMET a design challenge. Octant leads assay development and data generation for the consortium, including the data behind OpenADMET’s public blind challenges.

You will lead strategy and execution for Octant’s role in OpenADMET, working across consortium partners, funders, and the broader community. Internally, you will be the thought leader on how OpenADMET assays, data, and workflows are built into the Octant Navigator platform and put to work in our drug discovery programs. You view ADME through a molecular lens, operate comfortably at both the strategic and execution layers, and have a track record of leading complex, cross-functional projects. You are motivated by Octant’s mission and have a team-first mindset. You bring excellent communication skills and an ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

• Lead the strategy and execution of Octant’s contributions to OpenADMET, coordinating closely with partners at UCSF and OMSF

• Build long-term relationships with funders, provide regular progress updates, and scope out the next stages of funding

• Grow community across the OpenADMET ecosystem, including blind challenge participants and others working on ADMET prediction

• Decide which ADMET assays Octant builds and onboards, and ensure they run robustly and reproducibly at high throughput

• Connect our in-house high-throughput synthesis capabilities with ADMET assays in a closed design-make-test loop, including technology development in microscale synthesis and quantification

• Lead and grow a team, working hand-in-hand with machine learning scientists, software engineers, biologists, chemists, and automation engineers

THIS JOB MIGHT BE GREAT FOR YOU IF YOU HAVE:

• A PhD in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience

• 8-10+ years of experience in small molecule drug discovery, including leading large, cross-functional projects and teams. Industry experience strongly preferred.

• Experience spanning ADME/DMPK and medicinal chemistry, with the medchem intuition to reason about ADME through structure–property relationships

• A track record of building platforms or other enabling technology, such as new assays, high-throughput workflows, or data and automation infrastructure

• Computational fluency: you don’t need to be a data scientist or computational chemist, but you are comfortable working with data and AI tools and building workflows

• The ability to move between strategy and execution, and to communicate clearly with funders, collaborators, and internal teams

• Excitement about open science: much of this work is public-facing through OpenADMET, a rare opportunity in drug discovery

• Flexibility to rapidly changing priorities and project needs, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Comfortable with ambiguity and able to pivot strategies as needed to meet project goals.

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a proactive approach to anticipating potential issues and addressing them before they become critical.

• A drive to build a successful company in your role as a team lead and beyond.

The expected annual salary for this role is in the range of $195,000 to $230,000, depending on experience level. We offer health benefits (medical, dental, vision), equity, and 401(k) matching.

Octant is located in Emeryville, California and we work onsite.

Octant is an equal opportunity company that values applicants of all backgrounds. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive work environment. We value less traditional backgrounds, and may consider an equivalent combination of knowledge, skills, education, and experience to meet minimum qualifications. We know that confidence-gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

OCTANT’S NAVIGATOR PLATFORM:

Octant’s Platform, “The Navigator,” accelerates the design, build, test, & learn iterations across chemistry and biology to build drugs against cellular mechanisms. The Navigator is an expanding set of drug discovery and development capabilities with three interwoven components that operate together:

• Generative Biology – Multiplexed measurements from engineered sensors in human cells to understand cellular mechanisms

• Generative Chemistry – Nanoliter-scale chemical synthesis for rapid exploration of local & targeted chemical space

• Generative AI – ML/AI ingests large-scale biological and chemical datasets and drives iteration of experiments to build better molecules faster

Together, the Navigator platform drives week-to-week progress on our drug programs, generating 3M+ readouts each week across multiple therapeutic areas.

jobs.title: NAND Strategist
jobs.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Step into a highly strategic Director-level role as the company’s NAND Industry Subject Matter Expert. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining a deep, forward-looking view of the NAND industry and using that expertise to help shape the company’s five-year NAND strategy.

Working closely with our Sourcing organization and Business Units, you will connect external NAND industry dynamics with our product, technology, supply, cost, and growth requirements. Your perspective will help determine where the industry is heading, how supplier strategies are evolving, and what actions we should take today to secure the right technology, capacity, cost position, and supply resiliency over the next five years.

This role requires someone who has deep credibility in the NAND industry and can serve as the go-to expert for senior leadership on NAND technology, suppliers, economics, capacity, and market dynamics.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Serve as the company’s NAND industry subject matter expert, providing a deep and differentiated perspective on NAND technology, suppliers, industry economics, supply/demand, capacity, pricing, and competitive dynamics.

• Help develop the five-year NAND strategy in partnership with Sourcing and the Business Units, translating industry trends and supplier roadmaps into long-term technology, capacity, sourcing, and product strategies.

• Develop a forward-looking view of the NAND industry, including technology transitions, wafer and bit capacity, layer scaling, TLC/QLC adoption, cost curves, supplier investment plans, industry consolidation, and major changes in supply and demand.

• Assess NAND suppliers and their strategic direction, including technology roadmaps, manufacturing capabilities, capacity expansion, investment priorities, financial position, customer allocation strategies, and competitive behavior.

• Partner with Sourcing to inform long-term supplier strategy, including supplier selection, diversification, capacity commitments, strategic relationships, commercial models, and negotiation strategy.

• Partner with Business Units and Product Management to understand long-range product requirements and ensure the five-year NAND strategy aligns with anticipated customer demand, product roadmaps, performance requirements, and business growth.

• Build market and scenario models to evaluate alternative industry and business outcomes, including changes in supply, demand, technology, pricing, capacity, and supplier behavior.

• Identify emerging opportunities and risks early, providing senior leadership with a clear view of structural changes in the NAND industry and their potential impact on the business.

• Provide executive-level insight and recommendations, distilling complex industry information into a clear view of what matters, what is changing, and what strategic actions should be considered.

• We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

• Expert-level knowledge of the NAND flash memory industry with a deep understanding of the major suppliers, technologies, manufacturing economics, capacity, technology roadmaps, and competitive landscape.

• Strong understanding of NAND industry economics, including wafer capacity, bit growth, technology transitions, cost structures, utilization, supply/demand cycles, pricing dynamics, and supplier investment decisions.

• Deep knowledge of the major NAND suppliers, including their technology roadmaps, manufacturing strategies, capacity plans, financial drivers, and strategic priorities.

• Ability to see around corners—connecting technology, supplier, market, geopolitical, and economic trends to anticipate how the NAND industry may evolve over a five-year horizon.

• Strategic thinking and analytical rigor, with the ability to build market models, evaluate scenarios, challenge assumptions, and translate industry intelligence into strategic implications.

• Strong cross-functional influence, with experience working across Sourcing, Business Units, Product Management, Engineering, Finance, and Operations to develop and align long-range strategies.

• Executive communication skills, with the ability to explain highly complex NAND industry dynamics clearly and credibly to senior leadership.

• Established industry network and external perspective across NAND suppliers, semiconductor companies, technology partners, analysts, and other industry participants.

• 12+ years of relevant experience in NAND, semiconductors, storage, or a closely related technology industry. Direct NAND industry experience is strongly preferred.

#LI-ONSITE

Salary ranges are determined based on role, level and location. For positions open to candidates in multiple geographical locations, the base salary range is reflective of the labor market across the applicable locations.

This role may be eligible for incentive pay and/or equity.

There is no application deadline and we accept applications on an ongoing basis until the job is filled.

$162,000—$243,000 USD

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

• Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.

• Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!

• Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.

OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.

Join us and bring your best.

jobs.title: Technology Product Owner, Sales Technology - Contract
jobs.description:
The Technology Product Owner , Sales Technology is responsible for the strategy, roadmap, delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement of technology products that enable Commercial Operations, Sales Enablement, Marketing, and the Field Sales Organization across specialty groups.

This role serves as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technology teams, ensuring sales representatives, managers, and commercial leaders have the tools, processes, insights, and data necessary to drive growth, improve customer engagement, and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

The successful candidate will lead a portfolio of capabilities spanning Salesforce CRM, opportunity management, physician intelligence, sales enablement, territory planning, forecasting, customer engagement, digital field tools, analytics, AI-driven insights, and commercial process automation. The role combines product strategy, business process transformation, Agile delivery leadership, and deep partnership with commercial stakeholders to drive measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Portfolio Management

• Own the product vision, roadmap, and value realization strategy for the specialty Sales Technology portfolio.
• Translate commercial objectives, field feedback, customer needs, and business priorities into actionable product roadmaps and investment plans.
• Partner with Commercial Operations, Sales Leadership, Marketing, Professional Education, and Sales Enablement teams to identify opportunities that improve field effectiveness and customer engagement.
• Define and track success metrics, KPIs, and business outcomes including seller productivity, CRM adoption, pipeline visibility, forecast accuracy, customer engagement, and revenue enablement.
• Prioritize investments across products and platforms based on strategic value, business impact, technical feasibility, and organizational readiness.

Commercial Technology Delivery

• Lead the end-to-end delivery of technology capabilities supporting Commercial Operations and Sales Enablement.
• Partner with engineering teams, architects, analysts, and delivery partners to execute roadmaps and deliver business value.
• Manage product backlogs, feature prioritization, user story development, sprint planning, and release execution.
• Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
• Drive technology adoption through change management, training, communications, and feedback mechanisms.

Salesforce CRM & Commercial Platforms

• Serve as product leader for Salesforce CRM and supporting commercial technology platforms.
• Drive optimization of account management, contact management, opportunity management, territory management, forecasting, case management, and commercial workflows.
• Partner with business stakeholders to improve data quality, business processes, reporting, and user experiences.
• Evaluate and prioritize platform enhancements that increase field efficiency and reduce administrative burden.
• Collaborate with enterprise platform teams to maximize value from Salesforce, AI, analytics, and other commercial technologies.

Sales Effectiveness & Enablement

• Champion initiatives that improve seller productivity and streamline field execution.
• Partner with Sales Enablement teams to deliver solutions that support onboarding, training, coaching, and ongoing field effectiveness.
• Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and enhance customer-facing workflows.
• Leverage user research, field engagement, and customer feedback to continuously improve digital experiences.
• Ensure technology solutions align with evolving field sales processes and customer engagement strategies.

AI, Analytics & Innovation

• Identify and champion opportunities to leverage Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, automation, predictive analytics, and data-driven decision-making.
• Drive the adoption of innovative solutions that improve customer insights, opportunity identification, pipeline management, and commercial execution.
• Partner with data and analytics teams to enable actionable reporting, dashboards, and commercial intelligence capabilities.
• Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to ensure the organization remains at the forefront of commercial technology innovation.

Agile Product Operating Model

• Serve as a champion of the business's operating model.
• Foster a culture of user-centricity, experimentation, transparency, continuous learning, and outcome-based delivery.
• Lead Agile ceremonies and product governance activities.
• Promote data-driven prioritization and evidence-based decision-making.
• Continuously measure and improve team performance, delivery effectiveness, and business value realization.

Business Partnership & Stakeholder Management

• Build strong partnerships with Commercial Operations, Sales Leadership, Marketing, Professional Education, Finance, Data & Analytics, and Technology organizations.
• Facilitate alignment across cross-functional teams regarding priorities, investments, timelines, and expected outcomes.
• Lead discovery activities, process mapping, journey mapping, and business capability assessments.
• Communicate product strategy, roadmap decisions, risks, and tradeoffs effectively to stakeholders at all levels.
• Influence and drive organizational alignment without direct authority.

Leadership Skills & Behaviors

• Demonstrate strong product management and business transformation leadership.
• Apply user-centered design principles to understand and solve complex business challenges.
• Think strategically while maintaining strong execution focus.
• Lead through influence, collaboration, and servant leadership.
• Foster innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
• Exhibit strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making capabilities.
• Build trusted partnerships across business and technology functions.
• Communicate effectively with field teams, executive leadership, and technical teams.
• Promote an inclusive and high-performing team environment.

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Technology, Commercial Operations, Sales Technology, CRM, or related disciplines.
• 5+ years of experience delivering technology solutions supporting commercial, sales, or customer-facing organizations.
• Experience managing complex product portfolios and technology roadmaps.
• Experience working in Agile product delivery environments.
• Strong understanding of CRM platforms, sales processes, customer engagement, and commercial operations.
• Exceptional stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills.
• Proven ability to translate business strategy into technology solutions and measurable outcomes.

Preferred

• Salesforce CRM platform experience, including Sales Cloud and related commercial applications.
• Experience supporting highly regulated industries.
• Experience with commercial analytics, physician intelligence, territory planning, forecasting, or sales enablement solutions.
• Experience leveraging AI, Generative AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve commercial outcomes.
• Product Management certifications (SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, Scrum Product Owner, Pragmatic Institute, or equivalent).
• MBA or advanced degree preferred.

Preferred Attributes

• Passion for advancing healthcare through technology and innovation.
• Strong customer-first and field-first mindset.
• Demonstrated ability to simplify complex business challenges.
• Highly collaborative and relationship-oriented.
• Strategic thinker with a bias for action and execution.
• Data-driven decision-maker with strong business acumen.
• Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Additional Information

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS

Patient Minded - I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight - I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action - I am empowered and hold myself accountable.

Grow Talent - I own my development and invest in the development of others.

Win Together - I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Communication Matters - I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful, and timely dialogue.

Embrace Diversity - I create an environment of awareness and respect.

jobs.title: Attorney, Personal Injury
jobs.description:

Johnson Law Group (JLG) is a fast-paced, high-volume plaintiffs’ law firm headquartered in Houston, Texas, with a growing national presence. We are passionate about advocating for our clients and achieving meaningful results in their cases. Our team thrives in a collaborative and supportive environment where attorneys and staff work together to compassionately resolve claims and guide clients through difficult times.

Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Personal Injury Attorney to join our team in Houston, Texas. The ideal candidate will bring strong litigation skills, the ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously, and the professionalism to provide excellent client service. This role requires occasional travel to our Houston headquarters (approximately once per quarter) and offers the opportunity to work alongside a dynamic team in a firm that is expanding nationwide.

Responsibilities

• Represent clients throughout all phases of pre-litigation and litigation, from intake to resolution

• Draft and review pleadings, complaints, motions, and discovery responses

• Direct and monitor the probate process in coordination with docket managers

• Review, analyze, and summarize medical records and case-related documentation

• Communicate with clients regularly to provide updates, explain processes, and resolve issues with empathy and professionalism

• Collaborate with co-counsel, opposing counsel, and other law firms involved in litigation

• Participate in depositions, mediations, and hearings as needed

• Contribute to process improvements by following and refining documented procedures

• Provide assistance with overflow tasks and special projects as required

Qualifications

• Juris Doctor (JD) degree and active Texas State Bar membership required

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in personal injury litigation or probate; mass tort or probate experience a plus

• Proven ability to handle depositions, hearings, and mediations preferred

• Strong client-facing communication skills and ability to build rapport with clients

• Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

• Strong writing, research, and analytical skills

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; PACER and Excel experience helpful

What You’ll Get

• Opportunity to join a growing national plaintiffs’ law firm with a strong reputation in personal injury and mass tort litigation

• Hands-on courtroom and litigation experience with support from a dedicated team of paralegals and docket managers

• A collaborative and supportive work culture where attorneys share knowledge and resources

• Professional development and mentorship opportunities as the firm continues to expand nationwide

• Competitive compensation and benefits package (details to be shared during the interview process)

• Quarterly travel to Houston headquarters to connect with the broader team and leadership

*This job description is not an all-inclusive list of duties and responsibilities. It is intended to describe the general nature of the role and may be subject to change as business needs evolve.

Incentive Compensation:

• Lead strategy with VPs on strategic direction of the brand, ensuring IC is motivating, clearly defined, aligned with forecasting

jobs.description:
This role is based in our Irving, Texas office.

The Comms Planner – Attendee Marketing is responsible for developing and refining messaging frameworks, creating creative briefs, and ensuring visual alignment with campaign strategies. This role also manages the campaign calendar and supports the development of the master brief, ensuring timely execution of communication sub-briefing activities based on the Campaign Manager’s strategy and plan.

The Comms Planner collaborates closely with the Product Marketing Manager and Campaign Manager, reporting directly to the Director of Attendee Marketing, to ensure that all communication plans are strategically aligned, visually cohesive, and optimized for maximum impact. By embedding agile ways of working, the Comms Planner ensures iterative collaboration and adaptability to changing priorities and performance insights.

Role Accountability and Duties:

Messaging Strategy Development

• Develop and refine communication frameworks that align with the attendee value proposition, audience personas, and campaign objectives.
• Create messaging strategies that resonate with target audiences and key persona segments, ensuring consistency across all channels and touchpoints.
• Embed industry trends within the portfolio and collaborate with stakeholders within the team to increase relevance and engagement across communication channels.

Creative Briefs and Visual Planning

• Develop creative briefs that outline messaging, visual direction, and audience insights for creative teams.
• Collaborate with designers and content creators to ensure visuals align with messaging frameworks and campaign objectives.

Campaign Calendar Management

Agile Ways of Working

Performance Monitoring and Reporting

• Establish and monitor messaging KPIs, including engagement rates, conversion rates, and audience sentiment metrics.

QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

jobs.title: Practice Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Bluebird Kids Health

Position: Operations Coordinator

Department: Florida-Shared

Reports To:  Florida General Manager

Location: Florida

Travel: Frequent travel throughout Florida, including onsite support for new-practice and new-market launches

Position Summary

The Clinical Operations Coordinator supports high-performing operations across Bluebird Kids Health’s Florida practices. This role serves as a key resource for operational workflow standardization, oversight of regulatory processes within the practices—including the Vaccines for Children (VFC) Program, Lead Program, and Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA)—support of new-practice launches, and provider scheduling infrastructure.

The Clinical Operations Coordinator partners closely with Market Leaders, Site Supervisors, providers, receptionists, medical assistants, and centralized support teams to establish reliable operational processes, identify performance and compliance gaps, provide hands-on training and support, and promote consistency across practices.

This role also supports the infrastructure and standardization of provider scheduling, including templates, paid time off (PTO) tracking, on-call schedules, Saturday coverage, holiday schedules, and provider onboarding and offboarding. The Coordinator is responsible for maintaining the systems and processes that support reliable execution while partnering with Market Leaders and local practice leadership on implementation.

Key Responsibilities

New-Practice and New-Market Launch Support

• Assist with and provide training for new-practice staff based on market needs, available resources, onsite team experience, and local training support.

• Provide approximately one week of pre-launch support and one week of post-launch support when appropriate, with additional onsite support based on market needs, team experience, or operational complexity.

• Provide hands-on support with staff training, workflow implementation, laboratory setup, scheduling infrastructure, and competency validation.

• Assist with rooming workflows, vaccine operations, laboratory procedures, point-of-care testing, clinical supplies, medication processes, equipment setup, and emergency-readiness processes.

• Observe operations following launch and address workflow, training, compliance, or execution gaps in real time.

Vaccine Operations and VFC Oversight

• Monitor compliance with VFC, Florida SHOTS, private vaccine, and organizational vaccine requirements in partnership with Market Leaders and practice leadership.

• Support vaccine storage and handling training, temperature-monitoring processes, emergency planning, documentation, and inspection readiness.

• Monitor vaccine inventory trends and identify risks related to stockouts, excess inventory, expiration, or waste.

• Facilitate vaccine ordering and inventory-reconciliation processes to support reliable vaccine availability and accountability.

• Audit vaccine operations and recommend corrective actions to address workflow, documentation, inventory, or compliance gaps.

• Partner with Market Leaders and Site Supervisors to support local implementation of corrective actions and maintain readiness for VFC inspections and vaccine-related reviews.

Lead-Screening Compliance

• Monitor lead-screening completion, submission status, rejected or incomplete results, and overdue submissions across practices.

• Track exceptions and ensure required submissions are completed within established timelines, including accurate patient, provider, facility, and testing information.

• Audit lead-screening documentation, reporting processes, and submission workflows to identify recurring workflow or compliance gaps.

• Recommend workflow or process improvements to strengthen lead-screening compliance and reporting reliability.

• Partner with Market Leaders and Site Supervisors to reinforce training, support local corrective actions, and maintain ongoing compliance with the established process.

• Escalate unresolved or recurring compliance concerns and support resolution of significant compliance issues at the practice or market level.

Laboratory and CLIA Operations

• Provide training and oversight of standardized laboratory and point-of-care testing workflows across practices, ensuring compliance with applicable CLIA requirements and organizational laboratory policies.

• Assist with laboratory readiness, documentation, quality-control processes, specimen handling, equipment requirements, and testing workflows.

• Support practice leaders in preparing for applicable laboratory or CLIA reviews and inspections.

New Equipment and Medication Request Evaluation

• Coordinate the operational evaluation of requests for new clinical equipment, supplies, medications, or related services.

• Assess requests for operational need, workflow impact, practice readiness, training requirements, standardization opportunities, and implementation considerations.

• Coordinate input from clinical, operational, finance, procurement, compliance, and other stakeholders as appropriate.

• Support approved implementations by developing workflows, training materials, readiness plans, and ongoing monitoring processes.

• Help ensure new equipment and medication processes are consistently implemented across applicable practices.

Provider Schedule Management and Infrastructure

• Maintain standardized processes that support reliable provider scheduling across Florida markets.

• Partner with Market Leaders and practice leadership to ensure scheduling processes and infrastructure are consistently maintained.

• Coordinate provider template setup and approved template changes.

• Support development and maintenance of provider on-call schedules.

• Coordinate standardized Saturday coverage schedules.

• Coordinate and maintain holiday coverage schedules.

• Maintain provider PTO tracking and support visibility into planned provider availability and coverage needs.

• Identify scheduling inconsistencies, gaps, or process breakdowns and partner with Market Leaders to resolve them.

Provider Onboarding and Offboarding

• Coordinate operational components of provider onboarding and offboarding in partnership with Market Leaders and centralized support teams.

• Maintain standardized onboarding and offboarding checklists, timelines, and ownership expectations.

• Support provider schedule and template setup as part of onboarding.

• Coordinate operational-readiness activities, including clinical workflows, equipment, practice orientation, scheduling, and applicable training.

• Support schedule, template, and operational changes associated with provider departures.

• Track outstanding onboarding and offboarding items and escalate delays or gaps that may affect practice operations.

Other Duties as Assigned

Perform other duties as assigned to support practice, market, and organizational operations.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree required; MHA, MBA, or a related degree preferred.

• At least three years of operations experience in an ambulatory healthcare setting.

• Experience training, coaching, precepting, or supporting team members.

• Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, and follow-up items simultaneously.

• Strong communication, coaching, problem-solving, and relationship-management skills.

• Ability to identify operational issues, determine root causes, and support sustainable solutions.

• Ability to travel frequently throughout Florida and remain onsite for extended periods during new-practice or new-market launches.

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with business intelligence and data-visualization tools such as Metabase, Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.

• Experience supporting basic process-improvement or performance-improvement initiatives, including identifying root causes and tracking improvement measures.

• Ability to translate data into clear, actionable information for operational leaders and frontline teams.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to validate data for accuracy and completeness.

• Comfort working with data from multiple sources and organizing information into standardized reporting formats.

• Experience tracking key performance indicators, productivity measures, quality metrics, compliance measures, or other operational performance indicators.

jobs.title: Product Manager | Procurement
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE 

Buying something for a business should not require finance teams to piece together requests, purchase orders, receipts, and invoices across disconnected systems. Ramp is building a procurement experience that helps employees get what they need, gives finance teams control over commitments, and helps businesses pay for what they actually received.

As a Product Manager for Ramp’s Procurement offering, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Ramp’s core procurement capabilities, including sourcing, requisition, approval workflows, renewals, purchase orders, receiving, two- and three-way matching, and inventory management. You will work with Engineering, Design, and Data to turn complex purchasing and accounting requirements into products that are easy to start using and reliable as customers grow.

AI creates an opportunity to rethink this work: build agentic buying experiences for employees, automate work for approvers and stakeholders, and businesses make better purchasing decisions. You will decide where automation can take work off a customer’s plate, where a direct workflow is faster, and where a person needs to review or approve an action. Success means customers get value quickly, adopt the product in their everyday work, and spend less time chasing information and correcting errors.

This role requires working in person at our NYC or SF office at least two days per week.

Please note that this role requires in-person presence at our NYC or SF office at least 2 days/week.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the strategy and roadmap for Ramp’s Procurement pod. Make clear choices about which customer problems to solve, how the capabilities fit together, and what to build next.

 - Build connected workflows across sourcing, requisition, approvals, renewals, purchase orders, receiving, invoice matching, and inventory management. Partner with Bill Pay, Accounting, and platform teams so purchasing records and decisions carry through to payment and customers’ ERP systems.

 - Spend time with finance teams, procurement leaders, purchasing operators, and employees. Turn observed friction into simpler experiences for first-time customers and powerful workflows for complex organizations.

 - Build AI-powered experiences that complete useful work, such as finding new vendors, managing a renewal, drafting a request from a contract, or helping resolve a receipt and invoice discrepancy. Prototype with customers and decide what should be automated, suggested, or handled through direct user controls.

 - Make automation dependable. Partner with Engineering and Data to define quality measures, test realistic customer scenarios, learn from corrections, and provide clear explanations, approval boundaries, audit trails, and recovery when something goes wrong.

 - Own outcomes beyond launch. Define and improve activation, repeat usage, time to complete purchasing work, and the accuracy of matching and exception resolution. Use data and customer research to choose the next iteration.

 - Lead execution with engineers and designers, make scope and sequencing tradeoffs, and align partner teams on dependencies. Work with Sales, Implementation, and Customer Experience to turn customer commitments into repeatable product capabilities and support successful adoption.




WHAT YOU NEED

 - At least three years of product management or equivalent product-building experience, with evidence of owning a product area from customer discovery through launch and measurable adoption.

 - Strong product judgment and systems thinking. You can simplify complex workflows while preserving the controls and flexibility customers need.

 - Hands-on AI fluency, demonstrated through products, prototypes, or meaningful projects. You can reason about model quality, latency, cost, and user control, and choose where AI improves the experience.

 - Technical and analytical fluency, developed through a technical or analytical degree or equivalent practical experience. You can work with engineers on data models and integrations, use data to investigate problems, and build prototypes to test ideas.

 - Deep customer curiosity and strong design judgment. You can learn unfamiliar purchasing and finance workflows, distinguish recurring needs from one-off requests, and make the product easier to use.

 - A track record of leading cross-functional teams, setting priorities, making difficult tradeoffs, and delivering outcomes through others.

 - Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain a product direction, a complex workflow, and the reasoning behind a decision to technical and non-technical audiences.




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience with procurement, purchasing, inventory management, accounts payable, or accounting software, including purchase orders, receiving, matching, and exception handling.

 - Experience shipping AI-powered products used in production, including document understanding, agent workflows, and evaluation systems.

 - Experience with ERP integrations, multi-entity businesses, or enterprise approval and permission models.

 - Experience building products where accuracy and trust matter, with meaningful auditability, user controls, and recovery paths.

 - Experience at a high-growth startup, taking new products from initial concept to sustained use or scaling an existing product.




BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Health and wellness stipend

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend




UNITED STATES

 - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

 - One Medical annual membership

 - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

 - Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

 - Pet insurance

 - In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

 - Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)
   
   


CANADA

 - Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

 - Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

 - Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

 - Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

 - Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health




UNITED KINGDOM

 - Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

 - Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

 - Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay




REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 


OTHER NOTICES

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com http://Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Sr Sales Executive - Enterprise
jobs.description:
Paychex is reimagining how businesses manage their workforce by bringing payroll, HR, benefits, and advisory services together into a single connected HCM platform. As Paychex and Paycor come together, we're combining innovative technology, data-driven insights, AI, and human expertise to help organizations work smarter, support their people, and achieve better business outcomes. This is an exciting time to join our team as we continue to invest in innovation, simplify client experiences, and shape the future of work. At Paychex, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, make a meaningful impact, and be part of something bigger as One Paychex.

Overview

Where Complexity Meets Structure and Top Performers Win

There is a reason enterprise buyers are moving to Paycor. We built something no one else in the market can replicate: AI-enabled enterprise technology backed by the deepest operational expertise in the HCM industry. Our platform is purpose-built for how enterprise HR and finance actually work. When you sell for Paycor, you are not asking buyers to take a leap of faith. You are bringing them the answer the market has been waiting for.

Enterprise Sales at Paycor is built for experienced sellers who want to operate at a higher level. You’ll partner with organizations of 100+ employees, helping them solve complex workforce challenges through a modern, end-to-end HCM platform and service experience.

This is a true new-logo, advisory services role, focused on building a pipeline, running disciplined sales cycles, and closing high-impact deals. You’ll work within a structured selling environment with defined territories, clear go-to-market plays, integrated sales support tools, and opportunities to develop Centers of Influence (COI) partnerships and expand your professional network—so you can focus on what matters most: winning.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

• Hunt and close net-new enterprise business with organizations 100 to 5,000+ employees across defined territories
• Run disciplined full-cycle sales from executive-level prospecting through multi-stakeholder discovery, demo, and close
• Build high-value solution bundles or standalone solutions across the full One Paychex Portfolio, including PEO, HR Solutions, Managed Payroll, Benefits, Retirement, Merchant Services, and more, while earning accelerators on every module you attach.
• Partner with Solutions Engineers, RevOps, and a world-class channel ecosystem, including 700+ active broker relationships and financial services firms in a GTM team-selling environment, so you are never building alone.
• Own your pipeline with rigorous forecasting, disciplined front-end prospecting, and deal control through the close.

What It Takes to Win

• 5+ years of quota-carrying experience or complex B2B sales with a verifiable track record of hunting, building a pipeline, and closing
• Proven ability to engage economic buyers at the C-level and navigate multi-stakeholder engagement
• Experience selling into organizations of 100+ employees
• High accountability, resilience, and ownership of results because this team sets high expectations and meets them

Why This Role

• Unlimited earning potential tied to performance and results with a focus on career development
• World-Class Club Experiences for Top Performers
• Access to larger, more strategic deals with real business impact
• More ways to win! We offer a broad portfolio of products and services beyond tech to increase deal size
• An AI-Powered Platform That Closes Deals Faster
• A Commission Plan Engineered for Top Performers

This Role Is for You If...

You have been closing at a high level, and you are ready for a bigger stage. You want a platform you can believe in, a comp plan that actually rewards your performance, and leaders who will develop you rather than just measure you. You want to be part of something still being built, where the work you put in this year shapes what this enterprise organization looks like in three.

Qualifications

• H.S. Diploma - Required
• Bachelor's Degree - Preferred
• 5 years of experience in relevant professional sales.
• 3 years of experience in HCM industry.
• Driver's License - Required
• Sales - Preferred
• Assertiveness - Preferred
• Business Acumen - Preferred
• Strong Work Ethic - Preferred
• Time Management - Preferred
• Sales Prospecting - Preferred
• Enterprise Sales - Preferred
• Sales Strategy - Preferred
• Customer Relationship Management - Preferred
• Selling Techniques - Preferred
• Closing (Sales) - Preferred
• Go-to-Market Strategy - Preferred
• Business To Business - Preferred
• Market Share - Preferred
• Cold Calling - Preferred

Compensation

In the spirit of pay transparency, we are excited to share that the compensation range for this position is typically between $80k- 175k. This range includes base pay plus commissions but does not consider other components that make up the total rewards package for the position. If you are hired at Paychex, your overall compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience which may result in total compensation outside of this range.

Live the Paychex Values

• Act with uncompromising integrity.
• Provide outstanding service and build trusted relationships.
• Drive innovation in our products and services and continually improve our processes.
• Work in partnership and support each other.
• Be personally accountable and deliver on commitments.
• Treat each other with respect and dignity.

What's in it for you?

• We value your well-being: We provide over 21 comprehensive rewards, including medical coverage, virtual wellness classes, tuition reimbursement, 401(k) + employer match, adoption assistance, financial assistance, and much more.
• We value your time: From paid time off to company holidays, culture days, and comprehensive work-life balance programs, we will ensure you have the flexibility you need to be your best.
• We value your development: Our award-winning training and development programs empower our employees with ongoing learning opportunities to give you the building blocks to grow your career.
• We value your perspective: Our company culture reflects the diversity of our employees. We want you to be you and your voice to be heard.
• We value our communities: We offer paid time off for volunteerism and promote many company-wide and local initiatives that benefit organizations you care about.

Note: The benefits described apply to full-time employees. Benefits for part-time, contract, and intern roles may vary.

Not sure if you meet every requirement?

At Paychex, we know that great talent comes in many forms. If you're passionate about the role but don't check every box, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the right fit - either for this position or another opportunity with us.

jobs.title: Senior Community Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Community Manager



ABOUT EXPERIENCE BY INDUSTRIOUS

Experience by Industrious is a workplace hospitality brand launched by CBRE — built on the idea that where you work should actually feel like somewhere worth showing up to. We combine CBRE's real estate scale with Industrious' operating model to run dedicated experience teams across office assets, enterprise headquarters, healthcare facilities, and logistics centers worldwide.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You're the reason tenants feel like they belong to something. Not just a building, but a community — one with its own energy, its own rituals, and a sense that someone actually cares about how their days go.

As a Senior Community Manager, you design and oversee the full tenant programming experience: from the annual event calendar to day-of execution, from building communications to the tenant app. You lead the team that brings it all to life, and you're accountable for the engagement numbers that show it's working.

This role requires the creativity to design programs people actually want to attend, the operational discipline to run them well, and the relationship skills to make tenants feel personally connected to the building. The programming is the vehicle. The feeling is the product.

At buildings where this role works well, tenants renew leases partly because of what you've built. That's the bar.

WINNING IN THIS ROLE MEANS

• Tenants show up. Event attendance is strong, app engagement is growing, and the building has a reputation for actually doing things worth coming to.

• Tenant relationships feel personal. People know your name, tell you things, and trust that you'll follow through.

• Building communications are consistent, on-brand, and actually read. The app, signage, and newsletter work together as one voice.

• NPS and tenant satisfaction scores are trending upward, and you can trace them back to specific programs and decisions.



YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE AND SUCCEED AT IT IF

• You get energy from making people feel seen and connected. It's not just about organizing events. It's about noticing who's new, who needs an introduction, who's been having a rough week — and doing something about it.

• You're equally comfortable with strategy and execution. You can think through a quarterly programming calendar and then personally staff a Thursday afternoon activation. Both feel important to you.

• You understand that community doesn't happen by accident. You've built programs that worked and ones that didn't, and you learned from both. You have a framework for what drives engagement and why.

• You lead through relationships, not authority. Your direct reports work hard because they want to, not because you've told them to. You invest in people and it shows.

• You're genuinely curious about your tenants. You know what companies are in your building, what they're working on, what they care about. That knowledge makes your programming better and your relationships stickier.



NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF

• You'd rather stay behind the scenes than be the face of a program. This role requires daily visibility and genuine warmth in person.

• You find the detail work (signage, supply checks, survey follow-up) more frustrating than fulfilling.

• Predictable routines appeal to you more than dynamic, fast-moving days.

• People management (coaching, feedback, performance conversations) feels like a distraction from your real work. Here, it is part of your real work.

• You don't see community programming as central to building value. Here, it's one of the primary drivers of tenant retention.



WHAT YOU OWN

Community programming and building communications:

• Design and execute a dynamic calendar of tenant events focused on values that build community and engagement.

• Manage all aspects of community events including budgeting, vendor management, onsite execution, and reporting.

• Manage event marketing including updating the tenant app, digital and physical signage, and the building newsletter.

• Own the tenant experience app: content creation, audience management, timely building notices, adoption strategy, and negotiating local perks and partnerships.



Amenity management:

• Oversee ordering, restocking, receiving, and inventory of amenity supplies.

• Keep all amenity spaces spotless at all times.

• Document and escalate maintenance and facilities issues through proper channels.

• Maintain clean, organized supply closets.

• Support leasing teams in showcasing building amenities.



Tenant relationships:

• Build strong bonds with occupiers so their days feel personalized and productive.

• Meet with tenant leads at least once a year.

• Build relationships proactively outside of common space interactions.

• Execute in-suite activations when appropriate.

• Own the tenant onboarding process so new occupants know what's available.

• Deliver on Surprise and Delight and monthly interaction standards.

• Deploy customer sentiment surveys and create action plans for any detractors.



Service culture:

• Champion Industrious service standards and hospitality principles.

• Model and deliver on any new hospitality standards.

• Communicate and resolve issues confidently, empathetically, and professionally.



WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE



We hire for skills over pedigree, but the strongest candidates will have:

• Experience. 5–7 years in community programming, hospitality, or tenant engagement.

• Community programming or hospitality experience. You've designed and delivered tenant or community programs at scale. You know what drives engagement and what doesn't.

• People leadership. You've managed at least one direct report: set goals, given feedback, and helped someone grow in their role.

• Communications fluency. You write clearly and on-brand. You've managed a content calendar, a newsletter, or a social/app presence in a professional context.

• Organizational discipline. You manage multiple programs simultaneously and don't let details fall through the cracks under pressure.

• Tenant relationship skills. You build trust quickly, follow through consistently, and know how to make people feel genuinely cared for.



COMPENSATION

The base salary range for this role is $105,000 – $115,000, depending on experience.

You'll also be eligible for a 10% annual performance bonus.



Candidate Notice

Experience by Industrious is a CBRE business. These roles are employed by CBRE. We're posting here on the Industrious careers page to reach the right candidates, but your application will be reviewed by the Experience by Industrious hiring team at CBRE and any offer will come from CBRE.

By applying, you consent to your details being shared with CBRE for the purposes of this recruitment process should you be progressed beyond initial review.

jobs.title: Director, FP&A - Corporate
jobs.description:
At Front Row, we partner with leading brands to accelerate their ecommerce growth. We leverage our capabilities and proprietary technology to design, market, distribute and accelerate brands on a global scale. We’re continually cultivating functional areas of expertise and retaining the highest caliber of talent — while sharing knowledge and data, creating efficiencies, and looking at every aspect of our client’s business from a 360 perspective. We work effectively to give every client the hands-on support, niche knowledge, and first-access they need to win in the world’s most competitive commerce markets and make each of our six capabilities the first to act on the next big things.

We live for the exchange of energy between brands and audiences, you should too, and we’ve made it our mission to expand every brand’s market share and heart share. Because we believe every transaction has the potential to be transformational.

We leverage data-driven insights from Catapult, our proprietary technology, and our deep understanding of marketplaces like Amazon, Walmart.com, TikTok Shop, to craft strategies unique to each brand we work with while protecting their pricing and channel strategies at every lifecycle stage and in any global market.

We are hiring a Director of FP&A to own financial planning and performance for Front Row’s largest division, which drives the majority of the company’s profitability. Reporting to the SVP of Strategy & Finance, this role partners closely with commercial and operations leaders to forecast the business and turn brand- and SKU-level insight into margin improvement and value creation. • Drive margin savings initiatives and the processes to track and sustain them (e.g., marketplace fees, fulfillment, advertising efficiency, COGS)

Background includes:

• 1+ years managing and developing analysts

• Proven track record running FP&A processes end-to-end, including budget, forecast, and monthly performance reporting
• Experience driving measurable margin or pricing improvements

jobs.title: Editorial Lead (Fractional)
jobs.description:
Since 2015, Mejuri has reimagined what fine jewelry can be in a modern world—shifting it from a traditional gift to to a personal choice rooted in self-expression.

Founded by third-generation jeweller Noura Sakkijha, the brand was built on a simple idea: fine jewelry shouldn’t require a special occasion, and it should never come with guilt. It’s about celebrating yourself—your style, your life, your everyday.

Mejuri meets customers where they are—online, in app, and through a growing global retail footprint of 58+ stores worldwide. Mejuri is also deeply committed to doing things the right way, with responsible sourcing, sustainable practices, and philanthropic initiatives that reflect our values and long-term vision.

Job Overview

Mejuri is looking for a seasoned editorial leader to partner with our Creative team in a fractional, advisory capacity. This isn't a day-to-day role. You'll join us on a recurring cadence, flexing with the needs of the business. In each session you'll mentor our writers, help shape the story arcs behind upcoming campaigns and launches, and give senior editorial review on slated content.

You bring an outside perspective and a sharp editorial eye, grounded in deep experience building brand voices in fashion, jewelry, beauty or lifestyle. You know how to walk into a room, understand where the work is headed, and leave the team with clearer ideas, stronger craft and more confidence than when you arrived

What you'll do

• Act as a voice sounding board. Help the team pressure-test how the Mejuri voice is evolving across channels and markets, and where it could be sharper or more distinctive.

• Bring an outside lens. Share what you're seeing in fashion, culture, language and media, and what that means for how Mejuri shows up.

• Shape story arcs. Partner with the team on the narrative direction for upcoming campaigns, collection launches, collaborations and seasonal moments, so each story holds together from first idea to final execution.

• Strengthen messaging hierarchy. Help the team turn brand and business priorities into clear messaging structures that connect our positioning to what the customer cares about.

• Guide product storytelling and naming. Advise on narratives and names for key collections, signature pieces and launches, bringing craft, materials, design and wearability to life.

• Coach concepting from the brief. Work with writers to find several strong creative routes to a single brief, building the habit of iterating before landing on an answer.

• Review slated content. Give senior editorial review on upcoming high-visibility work across campaigns, site, CRM, social and retail. Push for integrated ideas where copy and visuals work as one, and give clear direction on how to elevate the work.

• Balance brand and performance. Help the team read customer and performance insights alongside the work, so they can apply what's resonating without diluting the voice.

• Mentor the Copy team. Run recurring working sessions with our writers, give candid feedback, and build their capability in concepting, storytelling, editing and voice.

• Strengthen the tools. Contribute to voice guidelines, messaging frameworks and naming principles so the team has what it needs between sessions.

• Advise on process. Share perspective with Creative Operations on briefing and review practices that help the team run efficiently at volume.

• Stay flexible. Adjust the cadence and focus of engagements around business priorities, including heavier involvement during peak moments like BFCM and holiday if needed.

What you'll bring to the team

• 10+ years in copywriting, editorial or brand creative roles, including senior leadership of a brand's voice. Fashion, jewelry, beauty, lifestyle or editorial experience is strongly preferred.

• Proven experience mentoring and developing writers at different stages of their careers.

• Strong narrative instincts: the ability to build story arcs across campaigns, launches and channels.

• A sharp, generous editorial eye, with feedback that is direct, specific and actionable.

• A portfolio showing exceptional writing, concepting, product storytelling and brand-building work.

• A strong grasp of fashion, retail, culture and the customer, and of how brand building and commercial results work together.

• Experience working in a fractional, consulting or advisory capacity, with a track record of driving impact without being embedded day to day.

• The ability to get up to speed quickly, build trust with a team, and make the most of limited time together

• We're building an AI-fluent organization. We welcome candidates at all stages of their AI journey — what matters is curiosity, a willingness to learn, and an openness to working alongside AI tools as part of how we do our best work.

Location
New York, NY
205 Hudson Street
Hybrid, 3 days in office 2 days remote

Salary/ hourly rate to be discussed

At Mejuri, we use AI-assisted tools as part of our recruitment process to help screen and assess candidate applications. All hiring decisions involve human review, and our Talent team remains responsible for evaluating candidates and making final decisions throughout the process.

#LI-Onsite

At Mejuri our success is driven by a strong commitment to our Purpose and Values. They're the foundation of our operations, defining how we show up, solve problems, and accomplish incredible things—together.

Our strength comes from each team member's dedication to embracing and embodying these Values daily. This isn't merely a duty; it's a passion that defines us. They guide us in providing extraordinary experiences for our customers and fostering an innovative environment. Success, for us, means living our values relentlessly.

Our values are:

RAISE THE BAR | Stay Curious, Share/Seek Feedback, and Strive for Excellence

CUSTOMER OBSESSED | Get close to the customer and prioritize them in our decisions

EMPOWERED OWNERS | Treat the company like your own, take initiative

FIND A WAY | Seek simple, creative solutions, and act fast

DRIVE RESULTS | Be clear on your goals and be relentless in achieving them

TEAM FIRST | Value team success over personal ego

Mejuri does not discriminate in hiring or terms and conditions of employment because of an individual’s race, ancestry, colour, place of origin, religion, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, age, disability, sexual orientation, family status or marital status, or any other protected category recognized by provincial or federal laws.

Should you require any accommodation, please inform us and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs. For any accessibility-related assistance, requests for information in accessible alternative formats or to report any accessibility problems, please share in your application.

jobs.title: Senior Agency Development Lead – LinkedIn Marketing Solutions
jobs.description:
This role will be based in New York.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

Key Responsibilities

• Own sustainable growth across a defined agency portfolio, with accountability for commercial outcomes, product adoption, and customer value.
• Diagnose the largest growth opportunities and translate LinkedIn Marketing Solutions priorities into focused agency and account plans.
• Convert strategy into execution through clear priorities, owners, milestones, measures, and follow-through.
• Build trusted, multi-threaded agency relationships and executive advocacy that drive alignment and commitment to shared growth priorities.
• Partner with Field Sales and cross-functional teams to activate agency influence, accelerate priority accounts, and remove barriers to growth.
• Build agency capabilities, programs, and repeatable motions that scale impact beyond individual engagements.

Growth Strategy and Execution

• Build strategic growth plans that align agency insight, customer priorities, commercial opportunity, and LinkedIn’s strategic priorities into clear outcomes and choices.
• Build executive sponsorship and multi-threaded relationships to secure commitments, navigate complexity, resolve trade-offs, and accelerate growth priorities.
• Lead plans from opportunity identification through activation and measurement, driving sustainable growth.
• Establish an effective operating rhythm across the customer portfolio.
• Move quickly from discussion to action, testing practical interventions and adapting plans based on evidence.
• Maintain high standards of execution and follow-through, ensuring commitments translate into measurable outcomes.
• Develop and activate Joint Partnership Plans that unlock shared growth priorities.
• Mobilize Product, Marketing, Insights & Measurement, Video, Field Sales, Agency Development, and other partners in support of shared outcomes.

Field Sales Partnership and Account Acceleration

• Partner with Field Sales to identify priority agency-influenced growth opportunities and determine where Agency Development can have the greatest impact.
• Co-create account-level agency strategies that broaden stakeholder coverage, move engagement upstream, and connect agency influence to customer decisions.
• Activate the right agency stakeholders across planning, investment, strategy, measurement, analytics, creative, and leadership functions.
• Support full-funnel growth, video adoption, measurement activation, transformational programs, and commercial partnerships aligned to customer opportunity.
• Represent agency insight internally while maintaining accountability for turning insight into action and commercial progress.

Agency Capability and Education

• Diagnose capability gaps that limit adoption or customer value and design focused interventions to address them.
• Develop and implement education, business reviews, product updates, strategic workshops, and other programs tied to specific growth outcomes.
• Adapt narratives and solutions to agency business models, workflows, and decision-making processes.
• Identify successful practices, codify them into reusable playbooks, and drive adoption across agencies and internal teams.
• Use AI to synthesize insights, strengthen customer narratives, improve planning, and increase execution speed and quality.

Industry Leadership and LinkedIn Product Expertise

• Maintain strong knowledge of agency economics, operating models, industry trends, and LinkedIn solutions.
• Translate market and agency intelligence into practical recommendations, growth plays, and go-to-market improvements.
• Bring a credible point of view to senior agency conversations, connecting LinkedIn capabilities to agency strategic and commercial priorities.
• Identify emerging use cases and growth opportunities, testing and scaling those with the strongest potential impact.
• Contribute an agency perspective to internal strategy, product, and commercial discussions.

Success Measures

• Sustainable revenue growth and increased adoption of priority LinkedIn Marketing Solutions across the assigned agency portfolio.
• Progress against Joint Business Plans, Agency Level Agreements, commercial frameworks, and priority growth programs.
• Demonstrable contribution to Field Sales opportunities, including agency-influenced pipeline, deal acceleration, and customer outcomes.
• Strong multi-threaded relationships and executive advocacy that drive alignment and execution.
• Operational excellence across account planning, pipeline management, measurement, stakeholder mobilization, and reporting.

Basic qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in marketing, agency, advertising, ad sales, business development, partnerships or a related commercial discipline.
• 5+ years of experience building and executing strategic customer, agency or commercial growth plans.

Preferred qualifications

• Proven track record of owning and delivering commercial growth across a complex matrix of customers
• Strong digital advertising, video, social media, B2B marketing and agency ecosystem expertise.
• Experience building and implementing Joint Business Plans, Agency Level Partnerships, Commercial Agreements or comparable growth frameworks.
• Demonstrated ability to prioritise opportunities, construct executable plans, mobilise stakeholders and maintain momentum through delivery.
• Ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
• Experience building executive advocacy and using it effectively to align stakeholders and advance shared growth priorities.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including business case development, concise decision documents and senior stakeholder presentations.
• High degree of judgement, accountability, customer focus, collaboration and operational discipline.

Suggested Skills

• Commercial growth leadership
• Strategic Planning
• Disciplined execution
• Collaboration and Influence
• Executive Relationship building

LinkedIn is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The pay range for this role is $308,000 to $470,000 OTE. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor.

The total compensation package for this position may also include annual performance bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans. For more information, visit https://careers.linkedin.com/benefits.
