We foster a collaborative environment with opportunities for growth and encourage our associates to live our values: Do good. Be good. Make good.

Role Summary

This position is part of the Life & Annuity Solutions team, which is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing our life and annuity products. The team is at the forefront of delivering innovative solutions that enhance customer experience and drive business growth.

This role contributes individually, in the design, implementation, and support of life insurance and annuity products. The role uses technical expertise and product knowledge to oversee the design and execution of actuarial components within policy administration, illustration, and ancillary systems for life and annuity products and riders.

A successful candidate brings strong technical and business acumen to product implementation and inforce administration. The role requires the ability to apply product knowledge and sound judgement to complex situations, balance multiple priorities, contribute to cross-functional problem solving, and help ensure product accuracy and system readiness in a dynamic environment.

This role is an opportunity to impact the future of life and annuity solutions, collaborate across teams, and help National Life Group keep its promises.

This position currently offers an onsite work schedule, with the expectation that you will be in the office four (4) days per week during onsite core days.  Our current onsite core days are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.  The work schedule type and core days are subject to change with advance notification and manager discretion.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Responsible for the design, implementation, validation, and ongoing support of actuarial components for life insurance and annuity products across policy administration, illustration, and ancillary systems. The role applies product knowledge, technical expertise, and sound judgement to complex product and systems issues and may lead peers on specific initiatives.

Responsibilities include:

• Apply business, product, and systems knowledge to identify, define, and resolve complex product and systems issues related to product implementation and inforce administration. Apply underlying product principles to unfamiliar and complex situations, considering business objectives, downstream impacts and the perspectives of affected functions when developing recommendations.

• Coordinate work across projects and initiatives, including assigning and tracking tasks as appropriate and collaborating with other analysts and project partners to manage testing timelines and deliverables. May assist management with near-term roadmap and resource planning.

• Oversee testing and validation activities for life and annuity products, including the development and maintenance of test strategies, test plans, test tools, testing capabilities, and related documentation used to validate product rates, calculations, values, and systems behavior.

• Develop and provide training and guidance to staff to increase product, systems, and testing knowledge and experience. Contribute to shared training resources and partner with management to align assignments, development opportunities, and project needs.

• Use sound judgement when evaluating opportunities to improve or automate work, considering accuracy, efficiency, maintainability, product understanding, downstream impacts, and the team’s ability to support the resulting process or solution over time.

• Build and strengthen cross-functional partnerships with other business units and teams throughout the organization. Communicate complex calculations, product behavior, problems, tradeoffs, and solutions effectively to technical and nontechnical audiences.

• Serve as a subject matter expert in product setup, policy mechanics, calculations, and systems behavior in at least one primary system, while maintaining strong working knowledge across additional systems used in the sale and administration of life insurance and annuity contracts. Use that expertise to help ensure products are implemented and administered accurately and consistently.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• 6 - 10 years of experience in a systems, systems support, product implementation, or related role in the financial services industry.

• Demonstrated understanding of life and/or annuity product mechanics and calculations.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively, build effective relationships and manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

• Strong mathematical, analytical, problem-solving, verbal, and written communication skills.

• Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including very strong Excel skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Finance or related field.

• Experience with a wide range of life insurance and annuity products with a demonstrated understanding of product mechanics and calculations, including development of UL, IUL, whole life cash value and death benefit calculations, definition of life insurance and modified endowment calculations, interest theory, and other related actuarial product benefit calculations.

• Experience with life insurance and/or annuity policy administration or illustration systems.

• Experience with additional tools such as SQL, Alteryx, or actuarial modeling software is a plus.

AI Proficiency Expectations

At National Life Group, we view AI as an enabler of human potential. We use AI to help us work smarter, serve more clients, and keep our promises, while remaining a relationship-driven business where our people are our greatest strength.

All applicants are expected to:

• Leverage approved AI tools, where appropriate, to improve the efficiency, quality, and impact of their work.

• Stay curious and open to new AI-enabled ways of working.

• Exercise sound judgment by reviewing and validating AI-generated content.

• Maintain accountability for the accuracy, quality, fairness, and integrity of work products by adhering to National Life’s AI guiding principles.

• Use AI responsibly and in accordance with company policies related to confidentiality, data privacy, security, compliance, retention and intellectual property.

jobs.title: Maintenance Supervisor
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Facilities and Maintenance Leader, you will oversee the operations, maintenance, and safety of Base Factory 1. The key responsibilities will be the support of building infrastructure, coordination of full-time or contract support resources for facilities upkeep or upgrades, along with creating the equipment maintenance organization to support production operations. This individual will help build our preventative maintenance systems and develop strategies to ensure reliable operation of our manufacturing equipment.



What You’ll Do

 - Plan, schedule, and oversee preventative maintenance and corrective repairs on mechanical, control, and infrastructure systems

 - Support general facility maintenance needs, prioritize service requests, and allocate resources to meet evolving operational requirements

 - Equipment Operation Availability / % OEE improvement: System development to track current shop conditions and identification of key areas of improvement

 - Develop and implement PM/TPM activities for production and facilities equipment

 - Manage the spares system and identify critical spares inventory

 - Establish and communicate direction and priorities for the maintenance team

 - Drive the maintenance and reliability initiative focused on preventive and predictive maintenance rather than reactive maintenance

 - Set and maintain departmental goals and KPI’s, monitor line efficiencies, labor cost, and other department expenses

 - Partner cross-functionally to manage, maintain and establish maintenance procedures for production lines to ensure production meets or exceeds the targets

 - Provide training and continuous development to both direct and indirect reports



What You’ll Bring

 - 5+ years of experience in industrial or facility maintenance

 - Associate Degree, technical certification, or completion of a trade school program preferred

 - Strong technical expertise in HVAC systems, mechanical repairs, and infrastructure operations, with knowledge of relevant codes, regulations, and safety standards

 - Strong preventive maintenance development experience and spare inventory management

 - Able to manage multiple tasks with competing priorities, establish and achieve goals

 - Able to work a night schedule, including weekday and weekend overtime

 - Familiarity with electrical and hydraulics/pneumatics troubleshooting using prints

 - PLC: troubleshooting with, or programming Allen Bradley or Siemens

 - Ability to work 1st shift: 7am-3:30pm or 2nd shift: 3:30pm-12am

 

About the Team

The Facilities and Maintenance team is responsible for keeping Base Factory 1 running safely, reliably, and efficiently every hour of every shift. As Base scales production of home battery systems, this team builds the maintenance programs, reliability systems, and facility infrastructure that prevent downtime before it happens and enable manufacturing to meet growing customer demand. You'll have the opportunity to establish the foundation for a world-class maintenance organization—from preventive maintenance and spare parts strategy to equipment reliability and facility operations—rather than inheriting legacy systems. If you're excited by the challenge of building systems from the ground up, solving complex operational problems, and seeing the direct impact of your work on production output, quality, and company growth, this is a rare opportunity to shape the future of a rapidly scaling factory.





Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

Career Team is a leading workforce development organization on a mission to transform lives.  We blend cutting-edge technology with compassionate, high-touch services to drive real, measurable outcomes in the lives of job seekers across the country.  At Career Team, we’re solving today’s unemployment challenges with smart software, world-class trainers, dedicated case managers, dynamic job developers, and innovative partners. RESEA participants are referred if they are receiving unemployment benefits. You will support RESEA participants as they seek employment, training, or education in order to become financially stable and employed.

Your Impact On Career Team’s Success:

Career Team collects and uses Personal Information for human resources, employment, benefits administration, health and safety, and business-related purposes and to be in legal compliance. jobs.title: Sr. Partner Relationship Manager, Agencies
jobs.description:
What is Contentstack?

Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.

While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.

Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.

Learn more at www.contentstack.com.

Who Are We?

At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let’s go!

What Are We Looking For?

• We’re looking for an experienced, commercially-minded Senior Partner Manager to build and own Contentstack’s global agency partner motion.

• This is a senior-level individual contributor role with significant ownership and influence. You’ll shape the agency partner strategy, build strategic relationships, create new go-to-market opportunities, and drive measurable pipeline and revenue impact.

• Contentstack is an AI-forward company, and we bring practical experience using AI tools and technologies to improve how we work, learn, solve problems, and drive impact.

• If you’re excited by the opportunity to build a partner motion from the ground up, shape how we compete in the market, and make a measurable commercial impact, we’d love to hear from you! Here’s what you’ll be doing:

• Own the agency go-to-market strategy end to end — including target partner profile, messaging, offerings, and growth plans — across a portfolio of global agencies such as Code & Theory, Omnicom, WPP, Dentsu/Merkle, Razorfish, and Monks.

• Build and grow strategic agency relationships, expanding Contentstack’s footprint across existing partners and turning opportunistic, project-by-project relationships into long-term partnerships.

• Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, with a focus on larger enterprise opportunities and increasing the mix of AXP-scale work.

• Build the agency go-to-market messaging and offering, positioning Contentstack for marketing leaders and CMOs and helping agencies see where we can compete alongside — and against — enterprise suites like Adobe and Optimizely.

• Partner with key ISVs to create a compelling better-together story and establish a mutual playbook around the Content Lifecycle demo and vision.

• Represent Contentstack with agency leadership and their clients through joint activations, executive briefings, live demos, ContentCon, and other market-facing opportunities.

• Help shape the broader partner organization by serving as a strategic resource on agency motions, messaging, and best practices.

What Really Gets Us Excited About You?

• 8-12 years of experience in partner, alliances, or channel roles within enterprise SaaS, including at least 4 years working directly with global agencies or agency holding companies. Deep agency experience is critical.

• Demonstrated experience selling with global agencies, not simply alongside them, and building agency-specific go-to-market motions. You understand why agency partnerships require a different play than GSI partnerships.

• Proven experience turning opportunistic, project-by-project partner relationships into strategic, agreement-backed partnerships.

• A balance of partner sales, product marketing, and strategy. You can build the relationship, develop the approach with the resources available, and articulate what we need next.

• The ability to present a partner go-to-market plan and pitch Contentstack live and unscripted without relying on a Sales Engineer. This will be part of the interview process.

• A track record of selling to and influencing CMOs and marketing leaders, not only technical buyers.

• Experience positioning against enterprise suite incumbents such as Adobe and Optimizely, with the ability to apply lessons from both wins and losses.

• Comfort operating without a finished playbook. You’ve built partner programs, messaging, and enablement from the ground up.

• Strong communication, executive presence, and influence skills, with the ability to work effectively with senior leaders across Partnerships, Sales, Marketing, and the executive team.

• Additional experience with headless CMS, DXP, DAM, retail/commerce, content operations, or partner marketing is a plus.

• You’re comfortable with occasional travel.

• You value a collaborative, innovative, and fun culture!

Salary for this role ranges between $145,000-165,000 based on skill set and experience

What Do We Offer?

Interesting Work | We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the “challenge yourself” role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you’re doing it.

Tribe Vibe | We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict “no a**hole policy” and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.

Bragging Rights | We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!

One Team One Dream | This is one of our values, and it shows. We don’t believe in artificial hierarchies. If you’re part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it’s a great time to be joining…

To review our Privacy Policy, please click here.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.

Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.

Role Overview

The Senior Technical Project Manager position carries significant responsibility for directing, coordinating, and supervising cross-functional and cross-departmental projects of varying complexity.  The incumbent will serve as an authority in the methodologies and procedures employed for managing these technical projects and their associated production release and will be instrumental in facilitating these endeavors. This role necessitates close collaboration with multiple teams concerning schedules and deliverables while ensuring strict adherence to our design controls process. The individual is expected to possess the requisite background to operate with a strategic perspective across multiple complex projects and at the release level, concentrating primarily on these large-scale project initiatives within the department. Furthermore, this role encompasses guiding release activities and providing direction and mentorship across teams.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as the primary point person for complex cross-functional projects.

• Oversee detailed planning, coordination, execution, and delivery of complex cross-functional projects.

• Identify bottlenecks in current workflows and implement automation to improve efficiency and reduce manual overhead.

• Proactively identify and resolve cross-team dependencies with an emphasis on proactive risk mitigation to ensure seamless release cycles.

• Hold team members accountable, set clear performance standards and goals, resolve performance issues, and keep teams engaged and on task across multiple major project initiatives.

• Maintain readiness for FDA audits, focusing on Design Controls, Software Validation, and the newly effective QMSR (Quality Management System Regulation) standards.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Fan Experience
jobs.description:
About Us:

Live experiences help people cross today’s digital divide and focus on what truly connects us – the here, the now, this once-in-a-lifetime moment that’s bringing us together. To fulfill Gametime’s mission of uniting the world through shared experiences, we make it easy for people to discover and access the live experiences that matter most.

With platforms on iOS, Android, mobile web and desktop supporting more than 60,000 events across the US and Canada, we are reimagining the event ticket industry in order to move at the speed of life.

The Role

Gametime’s Fan Experience team owns how fans discover, decide on, and purchase tickets on the demand side of our marketplace — the core experience for millions of ticket buyers across iOS, Android, mobile web, and desktop. This Engineering Manager will lead a team of full-stack and front-end engineers building the features and value propositions that define how fans experience Gametime, partnering day-to-day with a dedicated Product Manager and Designer to move quickly from idea to production.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll spend real time on the keyboard alongside your team, and you’ll set the standard for how the team uses frontier models, AI coding tools, and new harnesses to generate, review, test, and monitor code — raising both velocity and quality as the bar for what’s possible keeps moving. This role reports to the VP of Product.

What You’ll Do

• Hands-on leadership: spend a meaningful share of your time actually coding alongside the team — you lead from the front, not just from the roadmap

• AI-forward engineering: set the standard for how your team uses frontier models, AI coding agents/harnesses, and new tooling to generate, review, test, and monitor code — the primary lever for increasing velocity and quality (i.e. fewer bugs, more stable services, cohesive system architecture) together, not as a trade-off

• Cross-functional partnership: partner closely, day-to-day, with a dedicated PM and Designer as a trio; bring a real point of view on what the product and features should be, not just how to build them

• Velocity investment: partner with product to identify and invest in what will let the team move faster over time — tooling, domain foundation design, tech debt paydown, and better use of AI in the development loop

• Risk partnership: partner with product to surface the risks in what’s being proposed, and bring concrete recommendations and proposals for how to mitigate and eliminate those risks over time

• Delivery: own the engineering roadmap and execution plan for your area, balancing speed, quality, and technical debt

• Mentorship and talent bar: mentor engineers toward their next career level, hold a high talent bar for hiring and performance on your team, and help level up talent on other teams too

• Cross-team technical leadership: partner with engineering leads and counterparts on other teams to improve the marketplace more broadly, technically, over time

• A team and roadmap tied directly to fan-facing feature velocity, quality, and business outcomes on the demand side of our marketplace

What You’ll Bring

• A hands-on engineering manager — comfortable spending real time writing and reviewing code alongside your team, not just directing from above

• Direct experience using frontier models, AI coding agents/harnesses, and modern tooling to meaningfully improve engineering velocity and quality, and a point of view on where this is headed

• A track record of shipping consumer-facing product features that moved measurable business outcomes

• Strong cross-functional partnership skills — comfortable operating as a true peer to Product and Design, with your own opinions on what should be built, not just executing their specs

• Experience managing full-stack and/or front-end engineering teams, with meaningful people-management experience (typically 5+ years in engineering, including several as a manager)

• Familiarity with SQL/analytics to diagnose funnel and feature performance

• Experience leading full-stack teams with end-to-end ownership of consumer-facing web and mobile products, backend services, and APIs in a high-traffic marketplace or e-commerce environment.

• Strong understanding of modern front-end stacks (e.g., React and React Native), backend services, APIs, and full-stack architecture, with the technical depth to lead teams across the stack.

• Experience partnering with Product and Design in a fast-moving, iterative environment (feature flags, A/B testing, rapid experimentation)

• A data-driven approach to prioritization and technical trade-offs

Nice to Have

• Experience in consumer marketplaces or high-intent, high-conversion consumer apps

• A track record of building or championing internal tooling/platform investments that compounded team velocity over time

What We Offer

• Flexible PTO

• Competitive salary & equity package

• Monthly Gametime credits for any event ($1,200/yr)

• Medical, dental, & vision insurance

• Life insurance and disability benefits

• Diverse Family-forming benefits through Carrot Fertility

• 401k, HSA, pre-tax savings programs

• Company off-sites and meet-ups

• Wellness programs

• Tenure recognition

jobs.title: Clinical Navigator - PT (Shift:  9-6pm CT/8-5pm MT/10-7pm ET)
jobs.description:
About TailorCare

TailorCare is transforming the experience of specialty care. Our comprehensive care program takes a profoundly personal, evidence-based approach to improving patient outcomes for joint, back, and muscle conditions. By carefully assessing patients' symptoms, health histories, preferences, and goals with predictive data and the latest evidence-based guidelines, we help patients choose and navigate the most effective treatment pathway for them every step of the way.

TailorCare values the experiences and perspectives of individuals from all backgrounds. We are a highly collaborative, curious, and determined team passionate about scaling a high-growth start-up to improve the lives of those in pain. TailorCare is a remote-first company with our corporate office located in Nashville.

About the Role

The Clinical Navigator is a licensed Doctor of Physical Therapy responsible for delivering high-quality clinical navigation through both telephonic and video-based member interactions in a fast-paced, metrics-driven clinical operations environment. This role serves as the primary point of contact for members throughout their TailorCare journey, engaging members through outbound and inbound calls, virtual visits, and digital touchpoints to assess needs, build trust, drive participation, and support adherence to evidence-based care plans.

Success in this role requires a strong balance of clinical expertise, operational excellence, communication skills, and the ability to consistently meet engagement, productivity, quality, and member outcome goals. Clinical Navigators spend the majority of their workday actively engaging with members while leveraging technology, AI-enabled tools, predictive insights, and standardized workflows to personalize care, improve efficiency, and optimize outcomes.

The ideal candidate thrives in a high-volume virtual environment, is energized by member engagement, embraces innovation, and demonstrates accountability for both member outcomes and operational performance.

As TailorCare continues to evolve its clinical offerings, this role will play a foundational part in expanding virtual musculoskeletal care navigation. Clinical Navigators will help shape and support future virtual physical therapy programs, leveraging their clinical expertise to deliver increasingly comprehensive care experiences through digital and video-enabled platforms.

Primary Responsibilities

Member Engagement & Clinical Navigation

• Serve as the primary navigator for an assigned member population, managing members from intake through program completion in a contact center environment.

• Conduct comprehensive clinical intake assessments to evaluate MSK conditions, functional limitations, treatment history, goals, and readiness for care.

• Deliver clinical navigation through both telephonic and video-based interactions, selecting the most effective engagement modality to support member needs and outcomes.

• Maintain a high volume of daily member interactions through outbound and inbound outreach while delivering a personalized, empathetic, and clinically sound experience.

• Build trust and engagement through motivational interviewing, behavioral coaching, and evidence-based communication techniques.

• Educate members on treatment options, clinical recommendations, and available resources to support informed decision-making.

• Proactively follow up with members to drive adherence, address barriers to care, reinforce treatment plans, and improve engagement outcomes.

• Monitor member progress and identify opportunities for intervention, escalation, or additional support.

• Act as a trusted advocate throughout the member journey, ensuring continuity of care and a seamless member experience.

• Support the evolution of TailorCare’s virtual care capabilities by participating in the development, implementation, and future delivery of virtual physical therapy services and digital MSK care programs.

Operational Excellence & Performance

• Consistently achieve established operational performance metrics, including member engagement targets, outreach productivity, call and video visit quality, follow-up completion rates, documentation accuracy, and care plan adherence metrics.

• Effectively manage daily workflows, outreach queues, and member caseloads while balancing quality and efficiency in a call center-like environment.

• Demonstrate strong time management, accountability, and discipline within a high-volume call center and virtual care environment.

• Maintain readiness and availability for scheduled member interactions throughout the workday.

• Utilize performance dashboards, reporting tools, and operational data to prioritize outreach activities and maximize member engagement.

• Embrace continuous improvement initiatives and adapt quickly to evolving workflows, processes, technologies, and organizational priorities.

Technology, AI & Innovation

• Leverage AI-powered tools, predictive analytics, automation, and workflow technologies to enhance member interactions and improve operational efficiency.

• Utilize clinical decision-support tools and data-driven recommendations to personalize engagement strategies and support evidence-based care navigation.

• Identify opportunities to improve workflows, member experiences, and operational effectiveness through innovative thinking and feedback.

• Maintain proficiency across multiple technology platforms, communication tools, telehealth systems, CRMs, and documentation systems.

• Contribute to the adoption and optimization of emerging technologies that support scalable, high-quality clinical navigation and virtual care delivery.

Care Coordination & Collaboration

• Collaborate closely with interdisciplinary care teams, providers, health plan partners, and internal stakeholders to ensure a coordinated and seamless member experience.

• Communicate timely updates regarding member progress, barriers, escalations, and clinical concerns.

• Escalate complex clinical or operational issues appropriately while maintaining ownership of the member experience.

• Partner with colleagues across Clinical Operations, Product, Technology, and Provider Success teams to continuously improve the member journey.

• Contribute to a collaborative team culture through knowledge sharing, peer support, and participation in team meetings, training initiatives, and workflow improvement efforts.

Documentation & Compliance

• Accurately document all member interactions, assessments, care plans, and outreach efforts within established timelines.

• Ensure compliance with clinical protocols, quality standards, documentation requirements, and organizational policies.

• Maintain confidentiality and adhere to all applicable regulatory requirements and professional standards.

• Other duties as assigne

Qualifications

Required

• Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) or Masters in Physical Therapy (MPT)

• Current unrestricted Physical Therapy license in Georgia, Texas, Colorado and/or Indiana (Compact License preferred).

• Willingness to obtain and maintain additional state licenses as TailorCare expands.

• Minimum 3 years of experience in physical therapy, musculoskeletal care, care navigation, telehealth, or related clinical settings.

• Demonstrated success managing patient interactions in high-volume, performance-oriented environments.

• Strong communication, motivational interviewing, and patient engagement skills.

• Experience utilizing technology and data to improve workflow efficiency and patient outcomes.

• Ability to work independently while maintaining accountability to productivity, engagement, and quality expectations.

• Comfortable working across multiple technology platforms, communication tools, and dual-monitor environments.

• Ability and willingness to travel up to 10% as needed for onsite meetings, team collaboration, and company events.

Preferred

• Experience in telephonic care navigation, virtual care, care management, population health, utilization management, or digital health environments.

• Experience working within a call center, contact center, or metrics-driven healthcare operations setting.

• Familiarity with AI-enabled clinical tools, workflow automation, and digital health technologies.

• Experience in value-based care, employer-sponsored healthcare programs, or population health initiatives.

• Experience in high-growth startup environments.

Skills

• Member Engagement & Relationship Building

• High-Volume Telephonic & Video-Based Communication

• Motivational Interviewing & Behavior Change Coaching

• Clinical Assessment & Care Planning

• Operational Excellence & Productivity Management

• Data-Driven Decision Making

• Virtual Care Delivery & Telehealth Excellence

• AI & Technology Utilization

• Adaptability & Continuous Improvement

• Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Accountability & Results Orientation

Pay Range

$85,000—$90,000 USD

What's In It For You

• Meaningful Work: We are dedicated to our mission and deeply value our patients and each other. Each day offers the opportunity to make a positive impact.

• Work Environment: We operate as a remote-first company with options for a hybrid work model in Nashville.

• Time Off: Our generous paid time off (PTO) and holiday plans ensure you have ample time to rest and recharge.

• Family First: We offer paid parental leave and support a healthy work-life balance, encouraging flexibility and autonomy. We love talking about our family and pets!

• Comprehensive Benefits: From Day 1, employees enjoy medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, wellness resources and an employer HSA contribution.

• Fair Compensation: We are committed to equitable pay for all team members and support your future goals with a 401k plan that includes employer matching.

• Community: We foster an inclusive environment where you can rely on your teammates, share honest feedback, and feel comfortable being your authentic self at work each day.

TailorCare seeks to recruit and retain staff from diverse backgrounds and encourages qualified candidates to apply. We're an AI-first organization, which means artificial intelligence isn't a buzzword here — it's woven into how we build products, how we work, and how we think about solving complex problems for our customers. When you join Precisely, you join a team of curious, driven innovators who believe that better data makes the world run better. If you're ready to do meaningful work at the intersection of AI and data — and help define what's possible — we'd love for you to apply!

This position is 100% remote anywhere in the US

Overview:

As a Technical Product Marketing Manager, you will help developers, architects, data practitioners, evaluators and teams building AI-powered applications, agents, and automations understand, evaluate, and adopt Precisely technology. Sitting at the intersection of Product Marketing, Product Management, Engineering, and Sales Engineering, you will translate complex technologies into compelling technical content, demonstrations, and experiences that support product adoption and go-to-market success.

This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities. It is an excellent opportunity for a software engineer, CS graduate, or technical professional looking to transition into product marketing. If you enjoy working with both technology and customers, want to use your engineering background to help customers understand how products solve real business problems, this role offers a clear growth path from individual contributor to broader ownership in technical marketing.

What you will do:

• Work collaboratively with Product Marketing Managers, Product Managers, Engineering, and Sales Engineers to create technical messaging that helps practitioners understand product capabilities and architecture, ensuring it accurately supports market positioning.

• Develop technical content — including demonstrations, solutions guides, presentations, videos, and blogs — for developers, data practitioners, and teams building AI-powered applications and automations.

• Develop deep technical expertise in assigned products and emerging technologies.

• Collaborate with team members across Marketing to develop the tools and processes that allow us to run on AI as an organization.

What we are looking for:

Required:

• 2–4 years of experience in a technical role — including Software Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Developer Relations, Product Management, Technical Product Marketing, or a related technical go-to-market role. We welcome applications from engineers and technical professionals making a first move into product marketing.

• Eagerness and growing ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and business audiences.

• Working knowledge in at least one of: cloud platforms, APIs, data management, or AI — with the curiosity and ability to build expertise across adjacent areas.

• Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a customer-first mindset.

AI Skills/Knowledge:

• Understanding of AI concepts, technologies, and current trends, including the ability to explain use cases, implementation approaches, and business applications to both technical and business audiences.

• Experience using AI tools to improve productivity, content creation, research, analysis, and workflow efficiency.

• Ability to review and apply AI-generated outputs with appropriate judgment, with an interest in developing broader awareness of accuracy, security, and governance considerations.

Preferred Skills:

• Familiarity with cloud platforms including AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Snowflake, or Databricks.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Payments
jobs.description:
About Us

Dorsia is at the forefront of hospitality-tech innovation, redefining how the world gains access to the most in-demand restaurants, events, and experiences. By fusing cutting-edge technology with the art of luxury hospitality, we empower our members to secure impossible-to-get reservations while providing operators with unprecedented levels of control, visibility, and revenue optimization.

In 2025, we grew revenue 480% and scaled to 400+ venues across 25 destinations, with the launch of our Culture Calendar extending Dorsia beyond restaurants into the world’s most sought-after cultural moments.

Backed by $54M in funding from investors including Index Ventures, Invus, and Red Sea Ventures, and strategic partners including MoonPay, Major Food Group, and The Dinex Group - Daniel Boulud, we are entering our most consequential phase of growth and reshaping the global hospitality landscape. We’re adding exceptional talent to drive what comes next, and that’s where you come in.

About the Role

Dorsia is seeking a Product Manager, Payments to own Dorsia Pay and the full member payment experience, from card on file and deposits through checkout, split bills, tipping, settlement, and post-dining support. At Dorsia, the best payment is the one a member never has to think about. We're getting there with agents that understand intent, use payment tools, act within clear permissions, recover from exceptions, and move real money on a member's behalf. The hardest problem in agentic commerce is trust, and this role owns it.

This is a builder role at the boundary of product, engineering, and operations. You won't just write requirements for AI features or bolt on off-the-shelf copilots. You'll prototype agents yourself, define their tools and decision boundaries, write the evals, read the traces, and decide how much autonomy they've earned before they reach production.

The right candidate has hands-on experience in consumer payments or digital wallets, has shipped payment features on mobile, and has built and deployed agents that take real actions in production, beyond features that only summarize or suggest. You'll be accountable for payment conversion, adoption, authorization rates, agent task completion, member trust, and operational leverage.

What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Execution

• Shape the roadmap for Dorsia Pay and the in-app wallet, with agentic payments at the core.

• Build and ship agents that settle checks, handle deposits and tipping, and recover failed payments on members' behalf.

• Define each agent's tools, context, permissions, and escalation paths, with hard limits on amount, risk, and reversibility.

• Prototype agent behaviors in code, get them in front of users in days, and partner with engineering to ship what works.

• Build golden task sets and adversarial evals before launch, inspect production traces, and expand autonomy only when the evidence earns it.

Payment Experience and Design Flow

• Audit and optimize core payment flows, from card onboarding and Apple Pay through split bills, tipping, and post-dining support.

• Replace multi-screen workflows with intent, so a member can split a bill, add a guest, or fix a charge with a single request.

• Design for delegation, so members can hand a payment job to an agent and trust the outcome.

• Build confirmation, explanation, rollback, and human-handoff patterns for ambiguous or high-stakes actions.

• Turn wireframes and agent behaviors into testable builds in days, then refine them through live traces and usability testing.

Payments Infrastructure and Partnerships

• Partner with engineering and finance on processor integrations, tokenization, venue payouts, ledgers, and reconciliation.

• Help build a reusable agentic payments platform with shared tools, policies, evals, and observability.

• Deploy back-office agents for reconciliation, disputes, fraud triage, and payout exceptions as volume scales.

• Turn operators' repeated judgment calls into safe, testable agent capabilities.

• Partner with risk, legal, and compliance to define the controls, audit trails, and scoped permissions for agent-initiated transactions.

Customer and Market Insight

• Stay close to member and venue behavior through interviews, funnel data, support conversations, and agent traces.

• Build agents that turn tickets, disputes, and failed tasks into product requirements and new eval cases.

• Track emerging agent payment protocols, competitor wallets, and agentic-commerce standards as they take shape.

• Bring a sharp point of view on what members will trust an agent to do with their money, and how Dorsia leads that category in hospitality.

Data-Driven Decision Making

• Partner with analytics to pinpoint payment drop-off, failed transactions, and agent failure modes.

• Build agentic workflows that detect anomalies, diagnose root causes, and route fixes to the right owner.

• Own the agent quality bar across task success, accuracy, latency, cost, override rate, and escalation rate.

• Use Mixpanel, Looker, and traces to move from signal to action quickly.

• Tie agent performance to member and business outcomes, and use it to decide where agents earn more autonomy.

The Winning Recipe

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3-5 years in product management roles, with a proven track record of owning consumer payments, digital wallet, or fintech surfaces end to end.

• AI-native builder who has built and deployed agents that take real actions in production, beyond features that only summarize or suggest.

• Hands-on experience shipping payment features on mobile, including card on file, Apple Pay, deposits, split bills, and tipping.

• Comfort prototyping agent behaviors in code, writing evals, and reading traces to decide how much autonomy an agent has earned.

• Strong understanding of payments infrastructure, including processor integrations, tokenization, authorization rates, venue payouts, ledgers, and reconciliation.

• Sound judgment on trust and risk, with experience defining permissions, controls, and audit trails alongside risk, legal, and compliance partners.

• Familiarity with emerging agent payment protocols and agentic commerce standards is a strong plus, as is experience in hospitality or luxury consumer products.

• Working knowledge of disputes, chargebacks, fraud triage, and the operational edge cases that come with moving real money.

• Advanced analytical skills, including the ability to query, model, and interpret data using SQL, Mixpanel, Looker, and agent traces.

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to explain complex payment and agent behaviors and inspire alignment toward a solution.

• Strong product intuition backed by rigorous user research and usability testing, with a talent for designing confirmation, rollback, and handoff patterns members trust.

• Builder's mindset with a bias for action, a high level of ownership, and comfort with ambiguity and rapid iteration.

Compensation:

New York Pay Range

$150,000—$210,000 USD

Workplace Philosophy at Dorsia

At Dorsia, we believe that culture eats strategy. The best ideas in the world mean nothing without the right people around the table and the right chemistry between them. We are, unapologetically, a people-first organization.

In-Person Matters

We’re creating once-in-a-lifetime experiences for the most discerning audience in the world. That doesn’t happen over Zoom. It happens through collisions: a spark across a desk, a kitchen-side conversation that unlocks a partnership, the energy of ideas felt, not typed. That’s why in-office culture is non-negotiable at Dorsia.

Who We Hire

We don’t subscribe to check-the-box hiring. We hire for merit and mindset, which naturally creates a team with varied backgrounds. What unites us isn’t demographics, it’s a shared vision: to build the social operating system for the cultural vanguard.

Lifestyle Hours

We’re not a 9-to-5 company. Our lifestyle mirrors our members. Early flights, after-work events, and late-night sprints when the work demands it. But we love what we do, and we definitely love a good party.

High Performance Culture

Working at Dorsia isn’t for everyone—and that’s the point. Our culture is designed for builders, not passengers. We move fast, set ambitious standards, and expect people to rise to them. If you have the talent and the drive, this will be a ride to remember.

A Final Word

We’re building something special. It will take long hours and relentless effort. It’s not for everyone. For those with the metabolism, you’ll create something that changes how culture is lived. And that’s the kind of work worth your life’s energy.

jobs.title: Staff Digital Mixed-Signal System Engineer
jobs.description:
Renesas is seeking an experienced Staff Digital Mixed-Signal Systems Engineer to develop, model, and verify digitally implemented mixed-signal data paths for next-generation digital power management products used in AI, datacenter, and high-performance computing applications.

This role focuses on the digital processing that connects real-world analog measurements to control-loop decisions. Areas of responsibility include ADC interfaces and controllers, front-end filtering, digital signal processing, telemetry paths, emulation models, timing behavior, fixed-point implementation, and hardware and firmware interfaces.

The successful candidate will work closely with systems, digital design, firmware, verification, validation, applications, and analog design teams to translate product and feature requirements into executable models, detailed engineering specifications, RTL implementation requirements, and verification evidence.

This is a digital systems engineering role for mixed-signal power products. It does not involve transistor-level analog circuit design, but it requires a solid understanding of analog behavior and its interaction with digital control and signal-processing functions.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

• Develop the digital processing paths that connect sensed power-rail behavior to control-loop, telemetry, protection, and diagnostic functions.

• Improve the modeling, observability, and verification of mixed-signal behavior in advanced digital power products.

• Help engineering teams identify and resolve differences among system requirements, models, digital implementation, and measured behavior.

• Create reusable models, test methods, and specifications that improve engineering execution across product development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop digital mixed-signal data paths for digital multiphase power controllers and related power management products.

• Design and evaluate front-end digital signal-processing functions that filter, condition, scale, decimate, observe, and route sensed voltage and current information.

• Develop requirements for ADC interfaces and controllers, including sampling relationships, data-valid timing, channel sequencing, calibration support, latency, saturation, quantization, and error handling.

• Create executable behavioral models and emulation-oriented representations that allow system and feature behavior to be evaluated before RTL and silicon are complete.

• Translate system and control-loop requirements into detailed RTL requirements, fixed-point formats, datapath behavior, register definitions, firmware interfaces, and verification criteria.

• Analyze fixed-point implementation tradeoffs involving numeric range, precision, quantization, rounding, saturation, latency, area, and implementation complexity.

• Collaborate with analog design engineers to understand ADC, sensing, reference, timing, noise, and accuracy assumptions that affect digital implementation.

• Work with firmware engineers to develop configuration, observability, debug, telemetry, and bring-up capabilities needed for characterization and customer support.

• Work with design verification and validation engineers to develop reference scenarios, measurable pass/fail criteria, correlation methods, and test coverage for assigned features.

• Analyze results from behavioral models, RTL simulations, emulation, bench testing, and silicon measurements to identify differences and support issue resolution.

• Contribute to technical tradeoff decisions involving loop performance, latency, noise sensitivity, resolution, dynamic range, power, area, configurability, and customer-visible behavior.

• Document data-path behavior, interfaces, assumptions, models, limits, corner cases, and verification expectations for cross-functional engineering teams.

• Participate in technical reviews and communicate analysis, results, implementation risks, and recommended solutions.

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• 5+ years of relevant experience in digital design, mixed-signal systems, digital signal processing, power management, control-oriented digital design, semiconductor verification, or related product development.
• Strong understanding of digital signal-processing concepts, fixed-point arithmetic, sampling, filtering, timing, latency, quantization, saturation, and numeric precision.
• Experience developing or verifying ADC-facing digital logic, sensor data paths, telemetry paths, digital controllers, or control-loop support functions.
• Experience translating system or feature requirements into detailed digital implementation requirements and measurable verification criteria.
• Experience with behavioral modeling, data analysis, simulation, or engineering automation using Python, MATLAB, C/C++, SystemVerilog, or similar tools.
• Ability to analyze complex behavior across digital and analog boundaries and methodically investigate differences between expected and observed results.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with systems, digital design, firmware, analog design, verification, validation, applications, and software teams.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical behavior and present engineering results clearly.

PREFERRED

• Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Signal Processing, Control Systems, Power Electronics, or a related discipline.
• Experience with digital power controllers, DC/DC converters, voltage regulators, power management ICs, multiphase control, or high-current datacenter power applications.
• Experience with RTL development or verification using SystemVerilog or a similar hardware-description language.
• Experience with Python, MATLAB, C/C++, emulation, FPGA prototyping, behavioral modeling, real-number modeling, or hardware/software co-development.
• Experience with ADC controllers, coherent sampling, digital filtering, decimation, telemetry, protection functions, loop-compensation support, or real-time control data paths.
• Experience developing fixed-point models and comparing their behavior with floating-point reference models or RTL implementations.
• Experience creating reusable models, automated tests, reference data, or structured results that improve model-to-RTL, model-to-emulation, or model-to-silicon correlation.
• Familiarity with control-loop behavior, including stability, bandwidth, transient response, sampling effects, latency, saturation, and noise.
• Experience debugging issues at the boundary among algorithms, RTL implementation, firmware configuration, mixed-signal behavior, and silicon measurements.

jobs.title: Associate Motorsport Connectivity Engineer
jobs.description:
Welcome to Bosch Motorsport, a premier supplier of electronics, sensors, actuators, and engineering services to top racing series and teams worldwide. Here at Bosch Motorsport North America, you'll be part of a growing, dynamic, and entrepreneurial team, taking on challenging tasks.

As a vital member of our engineering team, you will play a key role in supporting our application and development engineers in projects focused on professional motorsport within North America. Embrace this opportunity to make an impact in the exciting world of motorsport technology!

What You Will Do

The Associate Motorsport Connectivity Engineer supports the worldwide development and application of connectivity products and services for motorsport applications. This position requires the ability to work effectively in fast-paced, dynamic environments and involves frequent domestic and international travel (approximately 40–60 days per year).

• Connectivity and Telemetry Development Participate in development of advanced connectivity and telemetry products and services at global development sites, customer locations, and race tracks.
• Trackside Diagnostics and System Configuration Deploy trackside to set up and maintain trackside telemetry servers, manage wireless radio connections, and develop standardized data analysis dashboards for performance evaluation. Identify and resolve complex software, connectivity, and system-level issues under high-pressure conditions. Willingness to participate in an on call rotation to support race events.
• Customer Application Engineering Collect customer requirements, manage project timelines, and deliver technical application support for motorsport products and services focusing on telemetry gateway units and Cloud services for data collection, analysis, and distribution.
• Requirements Management Interface directly with customers to collect and clarify technical requirements to help manage project timelines, and ensure on-time delivery to meet project and customer milestones.
• HIL and Cloud System Testing Validate customer-level, component-level, and system-level requirements through Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) bench tests and Cloud system tests. Interface directly with internal development teams to align feedback for development improvements.
• Workflow Optimization Support the development and optimization of internal software tools and workflow scripts using MATLAB, Python, C#, or similar languages to improve application processes and team efficiency.
• Domestic and International Travel Travel domestically and internationally (approximately 40–60 days per year) to provide elite technical support directly on-site at customer, track, and other development sites.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
• 1+ years of experience in industry-relevant application engineering (academic or industry experience).
• 1+ years of experience working with industry-standard data acquisition and data analysis software.
• Experience in professional motorsport, significant collegiate racing (e.g., Formula SAE, EcoCAR), or equivalent high-performance environments.

Preferred Qualifications

• Automotive Communications and Networking Knowledge of network communication frameworks, including the OSI and TCP/IP models. Experience with wired and wireless networking technologies and protocols, such as TCP, UDP, Ethernet, Wi-Fi, and cellular communications. Familiarity with hardware configuration, communication software, embedded systems, Linux or Windows command-line environments, and automotive communication protocols such as CAN and Ethernet.
• Cloud Technologies and Data Streaming Experience with Cloud-based services, containerized applications, and data-stream processing technologies, such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, MQTT, and Grafana.
• Database Management and Querying Experience writing queries using SQL or similar database query languages. Experience with relational and non-relational database technologies used to manage engineering, testing, or simulation data, such as SQL Server, MongoDB, or InfluxDB.
• Programming and Scripting Experience using programming or scripting languages, such as Python, MATLAB, or C#, for data analysis, automation, testing, or software development activities.
• Diagnostic and Engineering Tools Experience using engineering, diagnostic, or test tools such as Wireshark, CANalyzer, oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, or similar technologies.
• Electrical and System Analysis Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics. Experience with system troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, software debugging, and vehicle-level diagnostics.
• Powertrain and Control Systems Knowledge of or experience with internal combustion, hybrid, and/or battery-electric vehicle systems, including powertrain, chassis, or controls development.

Ideal Candidate Characteristics

• Motorsport Passion and Drive Possesses a genuine passion for professional motorsport with a relentless drive to make meaningful technical contributions to internal teams and customers.
• Proactive Self-Starter Thrives in an entrepreneurial, fast-paced environment; demonstrates strong personal accountability and takes the initiative to solve problems without waiting for step-by-step instructions.
• Data-Driven Adaptability Maintains high flexibility in fast-moving trackside environments, utilizing objective data and analytical logic to manage uncertainty and resolve system issues.
• Disciplined Independence and Teamwork Collaborates seamlessly within a tight-knit, multi-disciplinary trackside team, while maintaining the self-discipline and time management necessary to execute individual tasks to meet deadlines.
• Growth Mindset and Curiosity Willingness to learn and grow outside of immediate area of responsibility, constantly seeking ways to continuously improve both personal workflows and team processes.
• Clear and Objective Communication Articulates technical concepts, test observations, and diagnostic issues clearly and objectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, through verbal communication and in written reports.

If you’re passionate about motorsport and thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply. Join Bosch Motorsport in shaping the future of racing technology.

Our Motorsport Culture

Passion and Performance: At Bosch Motorsport North America, we are a close-knit team of dedicated professionals united by our unwavering passion for achieving peak performance, both on and off the track. Our shared commitment drives us to strive for nothing less than the top step of the podium in everything we undertake.

Entrepreneurial Mindset and Innovation: Embracing an entrepreneurial mindset, we constantly challenge the conventional norms. Fueled by innovation and a thirst for progress, we fearlessly tackle technical and commercial challenges to pave the way for groundbreaking solutions.

Communication: Building strong relationships internally and with our valued customers is paramount. Through open and transparent dialogue, we foster a culture of trust and collaboration, ensuring that we understand and meet the needs of everyone involved.

Balance: While we relentlessly pursue victory, we recognize the importance of balance. We believe in working hard but also cherish the value of a healthy work-life balance. This equilibrium empowers our team members to maintain their passion and drive while enjoying personal well-being and growth.

Together, we embrace a culture that pushes boundaries, fosters innovation, and cultivates genuine connections. Our collective determination and relentless pursuit of excellence propel us forward as a winning team, setting new standards in the world of motorsport.

Driver, Wrecker/Rollback-DOT (ADESA)
