jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
This role is part of our ScraperAPI team, one of our growing brands at saas.group.

ScraperAPI is an enterprise-scale web scraping solution, trusted by businesses across a wide range of industries to extract crucial data at scale. From e-commerce, travel to real estate and market research, we support companies in turning the web into actionable insights. We're currently on an exciting growth journey, scaling rapidly as demand for reliable, high-performance web scraping and data keeps rising.

Profile Overview

This is the hard end of web scraping. The sites we rely on, Google, Amazon, Walmart and many others, actively work to block us, and they change the rules without warning. We're looking for a senior engineer who can go deep on why we're being blocked, work out how the detection actually functions, and design repeatable ways around it. You'll be joining a self-driven, high-autonomy team to take on our most involved problems, with the room and the trust to build something from close to a blank page: an environment that turns one-off breakthroughs into a methodical, repeatable way of defeating anti-bot systems. If you like confronting problems that genuinely resist you, and you work methodically rather than by trial and error, this is an unusually open brief.

Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:

• Getting a full local environment running and becoming fluent in our systems and how they operate, in the first few weeks.

• Contributing to a proposal on the design for a repeatable environment we can pose anti-bot problems to and get reliable analysis out of.

• Building that environment out over the following months so that, by month six, we can point it at a target or provider and have it reliably tell us how we're being blocked and what is and isn't being used against us.

Your responsibilities

• Analyse how specific anti-bot and bot-mitigation systems (the likes of DataDome, Cloudflare Turnstile, Kasada, PerimeterX and Akamai) detect and block us, and design systems to work around them.

• Turn isolated breakthroughs into durable, repeatable processes: hypothesis, test, discard what's wrong, move on.

• In collaboration with other senior team members, design and build a greenfield agentic environment that can propose and run tests on anti-bot behaviour and bypass approaches, and do it in a way that's well understood and repeatable.

• Work largely independently on deep, concentrated problems, while actively pulling in knowledge from across the wider engineering team.

• Communicate clearly what you plan to do, and step into major incidents when the team needs your depth.

What you bring to the table

• Deep, genuine understanding of how the internet works underneath: HTTP, TLS and fingerprinting, proxies, headers, cookies, and browser behaviour. This is the core of the role and it isn't something we can shortcut.

• Excellent problem-solving built on a scientific, methodical approach: you form a hypothesis, design a test, read the result honestly, and iterate. Trying things at random is the opposite of what this role needs.

• Strong hands-on skills in our stack, Node.js and TypeScript with solid Python, and comfort across backend systems at scale (Postgres, Redis/Valkey, MongoDB, Puppeteer/Camoufox, Kubernetes).

• Real skill at directing AI coding agents with precision, and the judgement to tell strong output from weak. The specific tool doesn't matter (Claude, Codex or similar); knowing how to steer it well is what counts.

• A background that has given you this kind of depth and rigour. That might be scraping, anti-bot or web-security work, reverse engineering, or a research or academic path where you built your own tooling and lived by the scientific method. Direct scraping experience is a strong plus rather than a strict requirement.

• Independence and strong communication: you're comfortable owning hard problems in a remote-first team with little hand-holding, and you keep the team in the loop on your thinking as you go.

What's in it for you

• Ultimate flexibility: We're 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.

• Freedom and autonomy: We're a high-trust team, and you'll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way, with plenty of help from the team when you need it.

• Minimum bureaucracy: We don't like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.

• Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.

• Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.

• Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

ScraperAPI is part of saas.group and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.

What is saas.group?

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 400 colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

We don't just simply offer you to "take a job with us" but rather to "join us on this journey" to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.

Sounds like something you're up for? Feel free to apply even if you don't check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

—

saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.

We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

Quest Defense Systems & Solutions is seeking a Platform Systems Engineer to support the integration, verification, and qualification of advanced aerospace and defense systems. This role offers the opportunity to support waveform integration and migration to next-generation hardware while working closely with FPGA teams to understand builds, resource constraints, timing, and place-and-route considerations. U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain a Secret clearance are required. Active Secret clearance is preferred.

What You’ll Do

• Plan and execute system integration, verification, validation, and qualification testing.

• Evaluate system performance against requirements, analyze test results, and resolve performance gaps.

• Integrate and port waveforms to next-generation hardware platforms.

• Work with FPGA teams to understand builds, resource utilization, timing constraints, and place-and-route considerations.

• Develop test plans, procedures, cases, and system-level verification evidence.

• Troubleshoot complex interactions among hardware, software, FPGA, and waveform components.

• Collaborate with hardware, software, FPGA, test, and program teams throughout the development lifecycle.

• Create and maintain interface documentation, specifications, test reports, and requirements traceability.

• Participate in technical reviews, risk assessments, and problem-resolution activities.

• Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.

• 5+ years of experience in systems engineering, system integration, or testing of complex electronic or embedded systems.

• Experience developing, analyzing, and verifying system-level requirements and architectures.

• Hands-on experience with system integration, verification and validation, qualification testing, and performance analysis.

• Ability to troubleshoot interactions among hardware, software, FPGA, and other platform components.

• Systems-level understanding of FPGA builds, resource utilization, timing constraints, and place-and-route concepts.

• Familiarity with Xilinx tools and the FPGA development lifecycle.

• Strong analytical, technical documentation, and cross-functional communication skills.

• Ability to work onsite in Cedar Rapids, Iowa.

• U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Active Secret security clearance.

• Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

• Previous systems engineering experience within aerospace or defense programs.

• Experience integrating or porting waveforms to FPGA-based hardware platforms.

• Hands-on experience with Xilinx development tools, including reviewing resource-utilization and timing reports.

• Experience with requirements-management tools such as DOORS or Jama.

• Familiarity with MBSE methodologies and tools such as SysML, Cameo, or Rhapsody.

About InMarket

Since 2010, InMarket has been the leader in 360-degree consumer intelligence and real-time activation for thousands of today's top brands. *Source: Wordstream US Google Display Benchmarks for Mobile Media

About the Role

InMarket is seeking a strategic, commercially-minded Client Strategy Manager to join our Activation Client Strategy team.

You will partner with Sales Directors, Account Management, Ad Operations, and Data Analysts across the full client lifecycle to shape RFP responses and strategic proposals pre-sale, then use in-flight and post-campaign performance to inform smarter planning, deepen relationships, and grow the account.

We are also looking for someone fluent in AI who can build reusable skills, agents, and workflows that drive efficiencies and amplify outputs.

Core Areas of Responsibility

Media Planning & Strategic Recommendations

• Own the development of InMarket media plans and strategic recommendations that connect a client's business objectives to specific audiences, Moments, channels, budgets, and flighting

• Build client-facing planning collateral: proposals, one-pagers, category POVs, and strategy decks that are accurate but creative, succinct but thorough.

• Keep abreast of emerging consumer behaviors, media channels, technologies, and competitors impacting our clients' categories, and feed that back into how we plan

Pre-Sales Partnership & Commercial Growth

• Lead the strategic response to RFPs and briefs, partnering with Sales to shape a differentiated, winnable point of view

• Co-present at client meetings and on calls, representing the strategic rationale behind the plan with confidence and clarity

• Use in-flight and prior campaign performance to inform the next plan, turning results into the reason for the client's next investment

• Act as an internal resource for Sales, Marketing, and Product on how best to position InMarket's activation capabilities against a given client challenge

Storytelling & Client Insight

• Translate complex data into a simple, compelling narrative to state the non-obvious learning and answer the 'So What?' and 'Now What?'

• Partner with Account Management, Ad Operations, and Data Insights Analysts to interpret campaign performance and convert it into forward-looking planning guidance

• Present recommendations and results to internal and external audiences, ensuring the message lands clearly with both marketers and their agencies

• Contribute to Quarterly Business Reviews, identifying macro trends and growth opportunities spanning multiple campaigns on key accounts

AI Fluency & Ways of Working

• AI-Powered Data & Insights: Use AI to pull, structure, and analyze data across internal systems and translate findings into actionable, client-facing insights for pre-sales and campaign work. AI-Powered Storytelling: Use AI to develop client presentations, narratives, and deliverables from initial concept through final polish. AI-Enabled Workflow Development: Reimagine and improve team workflows using AI, going beyond basic automation to create more scalable and efficient ways of working. AI Product & Workflow Development: Build or configure AI-powered tools, products, and workflows that improve how teams deliver insights and client work. Scalable Insights: Develop productized insights, frameworks, and solutions that can be reused and scaled across clients.

Impact & Success Indicators

In your first 90 days

• Fluent in InMarket's activation products, audience taxonomy, Moments capabilities, and how they map to common client objectives

• Independently leading the strategic response on RFPs and briefs for assigned accounts

• Trusted by your Sales partners to co-present the plan and defend the rationale on client calls

• Built or improved at least one AI-assisted workflow that measurably speeds up a recurring part of the planning process

• Delivered a strategic recommendation that surfaced an opportunity the client had not asked about

In your first year

• Recognized as a go-to strategic partner for your accounts

• A demonstrable track record of contributing to won business and organic account growth through upsell and expansion recommendations

• Your planning narratives and frameworks are reused across the wider team as the standard

• Shipped reusable AI skills or workflows that are adopted beyond your own accounts and have shortened proposal turnaround times

• Consistently spotting category and behavioral trends early, and translating them into commercial opportunities for InMarket and our clients

We're Looking for Someone With

• 3-5+ years in media planning, brand or agency strategy, insights, client success, and/or account management. Media planning experience strongly preferred

• Comfort with quantitative analysis and a data-driven approach to decision-making

• Strategic thinking that goes beyond the obvious: you reframe the brief, question the assumption, and find the angle others miss

• Advanced AI fluency. You can build skills, prompts, and workflows that change how work gets done

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across all functions and levels

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, including client-facing presentation experience

• Strong proficiency with MS Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint

• Familiarity with Looker or other data visualization tools

Quest Defense Systems & Solutions is seeking a Senior High-Speed Digital Hardware Engineer to design complex circuit cards for advanced aerospace and defense systems. You’ll work with high-speed serial interfaces, multi-lane architectures, Ethernet, fiber and copper interfaces, multiple FPGAs and SoCs, and advanced DDR5/DDR6 memory.

As an early senior member of the team, you’ll help establish the technical direction and drive designs from architecture and schematic capture through PCB layout, integration, and first-pass hardware success. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving challenging signal-integrity problems and taking meaningful ownership of critical hardware designs.

This position is based in Cedar Rapids, IA. Relocation assistance is available.

U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain a Secret clearance are required. Active Secret clearance is preferred.

What You’ll Do

• Architect and design complex high-speed digital circuit cards for aerospace and defense applications.

• Develop schematics, select components, and define board-level interfaces and design requirements.

• Design high-speed serial interfaces with multiple data lanes, including Ethernet, fiber, and copper connectivity.

• Integrate multiple FPGAs, complex SoCs, and DDR5/DDR6 or comparable high-performance memory.

• Analyze and resolve signal-integrity, timing, crosstalk, and electrical-interference challenges.

• Partner closely with ECAD and PCB layout engineers to define stackups, routing constraints, placement, and layout requirements.

• Lead technical reviews, design trade studies, risk assessments, and hardware troubleshooting activities.

• Support board bring-up, integration, testing, debugging, and validation in the lab.

• Collaborate with FPGA, software, systems, mechanical, and test engineers to deliver cohesive system solutions.

• Create and maintain schematics, design documentation, bills of materials, analysis results, and test procedures.

• Drive first-pass hardware success while meeting demanding technical and program schedules.

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.

• 5+ years of experience designing complex digital hardware or circuit-card assemblies.

• Hands-on experience with high-speed digital board design, from schematic capture through hardware bring-up and validation.

• Experience designing high-speed serial interfaces with multiple lanes per card.

• Experience integrating multiple FPGAs, complex SoCs, and high-performance memory such as DDR5 or DDR6.

• Strong understanding of signal integrity, timing, crosstalk, electrical interference, and board-level design constraints.

• Experience collaborating closely with ECAD and PCB layout engineers.

• Ability to lead technical decisions, resolve complex hardware issues, and deliver under demanding schedules.

• Ability to work onsite in Cedar Rapids, Iowa.

• U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Active Secret security clearance.

• Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

• Previous experience developing hardware for aerospace or defense applications.

• Experience with schematic and PCB design tools such as Cadence, Mentor Graphics, or Altium.

• Experience with Ethernet and fiber and copper communication interfaces.

• Familiarity with signal- and power-integrity analysis tools and techniques.

• Hands-on experience using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other high-speed debugging equipment.

• Knowledge of DO-160, MIL-STD, EMI/EMC, or environmental qualification requirements.

• Experience serving as a technical lead for complex circuit-card development.

• Experience adopting and/or integrating emerging technologies (e.g., generative AI, automation platforms, digital assistants) into day-to-day operations for continuous improvement.

The QDSS Advantage:

At QDSS, our advantage is purpose-driven work, collaborative teams, and complex challenges that push boundaries and build lasting impact. You’ll grow your career while contributing to mission-critical programs that demand excellence and shape the future.

What You’ll Find Here

• Work That Matters – Next-generation, safety- and mission-critical projects where your contributions have real-world impact.

• Growth That’s Supported – Competitive compensation, employer-matched 401(k), certification assistance, and clear opportunities for advancement.

• A Culture That Works – A flexible, collaborative, and people-first environment where teamwork, innovation, and balance are valued.

Benefits Include

• Competitive pay, comprehensive medical/dental/life and disability coverage, 401(k) with employer match, professional development support, and a flexible, friendly workplace.

Full compensation package is based on candidate experience and certifications

Pay Ranges

$120,000—$145,000 USD

At Quest Defense Systems and Solutions, we don’t just build technology — we engineer the future. From next-generation aerospace solutions to cutting-edge defense systems, we tackle the toughest, mission-critical challenges that keep people safe and push the boundaries of innovation. This is where problem-solvers, innovators, and visionary thinkers come together to shape the future. With over 25 years of aerospace and defense engineering expertise, our commitment to delivering high-quality, transformative solutions sets us apart — not just as an industry leader, but as a driving force for impactful change. jobs.description:
About the Team

ACCEL Schools is hiring a highly qualified 1st Grade Teacher at STEAM Academy of Warrensville Heights in Cleveland, Ohio dedicated to providing a superior education for all students. We are seeking teachers who are passionate and dedicated to bringing the curriculum to life for each student. We want our teachers to be excited to create a positive classroom environment that prioritizes student learning and social-emotional development.

Be part of the difference at STEAM Academy of Warrensville Heights! STEAM Academy is an award-winning public charter school serving EK-8th grade students throughout the Heights communities. Founded in 2015, STEAM Academy of Warrensville Heights has a Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Math focus. The school is the top academic performing school in the neighborhood with a positive school culture and active campus life. STEAM Academy of Warrensville Heights is part of ACCEL Schools, an established network of public charter schools serving K-12 students throughout the United States since 2014.

About the Opportunity:

Responsibilities of the Teacher include to-

• Prepare and deliver lesson plans with the ability to modify accordingly during the school year

• Differentiate instruction to meet the needs of all students

• Maintain accurate and complete records of students’ progress and development

• Utilize research-based best practices in daily planning and classroom instruction

• Manage student behavior in the classroom

• Create a positive classroom environment for students to learn in

• Utilize school approved curricula that reflects the diverse educational, cultural, and linguistic backgrounds of the students

• Implement school-wide culture expectations and norms

• Communicate and meet with families regarding the academic and social-emotional growth of their child

• Incorporate technology skills into daily classroom practice to support learning

• Participate in the planning and implementation of non-instructional activities, as needed

• Collaborate and communicate effectively with colleagues

• Perform other duties as assigned

About You:

• Active and current state of Ohio teaching license in appropriate content area

• Bachelor’s degree in education or related field

• High level of comfort working in a growth-focused coaching environment based on frequent observations, debriefs, action planning, and progress monitoring

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to properly manage confidential information

• Able to supervise students of various ages in different school settings (playground, cafeteria, etc.)

• Ability to pass federal and state criminal background checks

• Experience working within an urban environment

About Us

“We believe that every child should be able to be anything they want in life, regardless of their birthplace and circumstances.” – Ron Packard, CEO & Founder

ACCEL Schools is a network of 80+ high-performing, public charter schools serving PK-12 students. We proudly advocate for school choice and work to address educational inequities throughout the United States. Our schools are inclusive and widely differ to reflect the unique values of the many urban, suburban, and rural communities we serve. Our brick and mortar, and virtual schools specialize in closing educational gaps and offer innovative models such as career-technical education, sports training, bilingual programming, and more. We have been recognized and praised by legislators, authorizers, and researchers for providing exceptional education options to students in historically under-resourced communities.

Career benefits – keep growing

jobs.description:
The Oncology Nurse Clinician PNE reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.  This position works in a multidisciplinary environment which will require exceptional interpersonal skills, including the ability to establish and maintain effective relationships with patients, physicians, clinical and administrative units.  The Oncology Nurse Clinician PNE coordinates multidisciplinary care using the nursing process.

Responsibilities:

• Assesses and reassesses the patient and family for on-going care needs with knowledge of high-risk criteria and initiates referrals to the appropriate resources in a timely manner.
• For all new patients collects and analyzes data, identifies and coordinates appropriate multidisciplinary care and appointments. Triages this information and schedules patients appropriately.
• Collaborates with patient, family, physicians and ancillary staff and coordinates new patients for the multidisciplinary clinics. Assists in creating a plan of care that indicates this collaboration and communication.
• Serves as a resource to non-clinical staff regarding prospective patients calling the program for information.
• Is able to state rationale for clinical decisions based on critical thinking.
• Performs all aspects of patient care in a manner which optimizes patient safety and reduces the likelihood of medical/health care errors.
• Identifies learning needs, abilities, preferences and readiness; assesses support systems, coping mechanisms and barriers to learning, making referrals as appropriate.
• Educates patient, family and caregivers regarding diagnosis, process, therapies, and testing.
• Assists with transitions of care and providers.
• Communicates effectively and works cooperatively with other team members. Has respect for and an understanding of other clinical disciplines.
• Delegates appropriately to other care providers to facilitate meeting patient needs in a timely manner.
• Promotes a positive work environment.
• Demonstrates an interest in personal development and growth beyond routine expected educational sessions.
• Embraces new employees and care team members, contributing to their growth and learning.
• Attains knowledge and competency that reflects current nursing practice through participation in ongoing educational activities. Seeks experiences and formal and independent learning activities to maintain and develop clinical and professional skills and knowledge.
• Engages in a formal process seeking feedback regarding one's own practice from peers and professional colleagues.
• Exhibits creativity and flexibility through the dynamics of change

Required:

• Completion of an accredited Registered Nurse program with an RN License in the state of Illinois.
• Current nursing experience within the past 5 years.
• BLS Certification.

Preferred:

• Bachelor of Science in Nursing.
• Oncology Certified Nurse.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Business Analytics – Trade Parkinsons
jobs.description:
As a key leader within APEX MAPS Trade, this role will lead trade and distribution analytics & insights to support Market Access, Trade, and Brand stakeholders for Parkinsons Therapeutic Area. The individual will use secondary data, syndicated sources, and research to evaluate specialty pharmacy, wholesaler, GPO, FFS, inventory, and channel performance; identify risks and opportunities; and translate insights into clear recommendations that support market access trade and distribution strategy.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead trade and distribution analytics and research to inform strategy, evaluate contract and program performance, and quantify ROI across therapeutic areas and customer segments.
• Partner cross-functionally with Market Access, Trade & Distribution, Brand Marketing, Finance, Legal, Pricing, HEOR, Patient Services, and franchise teams to influence strategic decisions and portfolio impact.
• Plan and execute analytics and primary research to support commercialized brands across specialty pharmacy, retail pharmacy, payors, GPOs, wholesalers, and patient services stakeholders.
• Pull, integrate, and analyze internal and syndicated data to generate insights on channel performance, patient access, distribution flow, and commercial risks and opportunities.
• Develop and apply advanced analytical models to assess payer, channel, and trade dynamics and support evidence-based decision-making.
• Drive KPI reporting, standardized performance measurement, and Trade Quarterly Business Reviews to monitor product, program, and channel performance.
• Evaluate the value and impact of Specialty Pharmacy, FFS, and GPO contracts, and develop data-driven strategies to identify value-based opportunities with trading partners.
• Evaluate specialty pharmacy, wholesaler, GPO, FFS, inventory, and channel performance to identify risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
• Communicate clear, actionable recommendations to leadership and guide vendors and team members to deliver high-quality analytics, research, and insights on time.

Bachelor’s degree, or foreign equivalent, in Business Analytics, Statistics, or a related field, plus 5 years of experience as a consultant or analyst with a pharmaceutical manufacturer, including 5 years of relevant experience in the following areas; or alternatively, a Master’s degree, or foreign equivalent, in Business Analytics, Statistics, or a related field, plus 3 years of experience as a consultant or analyst with a pharmaceutical manufacturer, including 3 years of relevant experience in the following areas.

• Applying practical statistical methods, including trend analysis, multivariate analysis, forecasting, ROI measurement, and scenario analysis, using pharmaceutical and trade data sources including CMS, IQVIA, Symphony Health, Rebate, EDI 867 (Product Transfer & Resale), EDI 852 (Product Activity), and HIRC.
• Performing data analysis using each of the following tools: SQL, Advanced Excel and data visualization tools such as Power BI; Experience with Python or R is preferred.
• Ability to pull, integrate, validate, and analyze internal and syndicated pharmaceutical data to generate insights on channel performance, patient access, distribution flow, commercial opportunities, risks, and trade impact.
• Demonstrated ability to lead both analytics and primary research activities in support of supply chain stakeholders, including specialty pharmacies, retail pharmacies, wholesalers, and patient services.
• Experience leading analytics and primary research to support trade, distribution, and supply chain stakeholders, including specialty pharmacies, retail pharmacies, wholesalers, GPOs, and patient services.
• Proven business acumen, strategic and analytical thinking, executive presence, and the ability to influence without authority across cross-functional partners and leadership.
• Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to speak and write persuasively, clearly, and concisely.
• Ability to effectively use AI tools to improve analytics, reporting, and communication while ensuring accuracy, privacy, and compliance.
• Ability to synthesize complex analytics, research, and trade/distribution data into clear, concise, and persuasive recommendations for senior stakeholders.
• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, adaptability, and resourcefulness in a dynamic, collaborative, and deadline-driven environment.

jobs.description:

Quest Defense Systems & Solutions is seeking an FPGA/Firmware Engineer to develop and verify complex FPGA solutions for safety-critical aerospace systems. This role spans the full DO-254 Design Assurance Level A lifecycle, including hardware requirements and traceability in DOORS, digital architecture, RTL development in VHDL or Verilog, simulation, timing closure, verification, and certification evidence.

You’ll work alongside hardware, software, systems, and verification engineers to solve challenging design problems and deliver high-reliability solutions from initial requirements through hardware validation. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who enjoys technically complex FPGA work and the rigor required for mission-critical aerospace programs.

This position is based in Cedar Rapids, IA. Relocation assistance is available.

U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain a Secret clearance are required. Active Secret clearance is preferred.

• Architect, design, and implement complex FPGA solutions in VHDL or Verilog for safety-critical aerospace applications in accordance with DO-254 DAL A processes.

• Develop, review, and maintain hardware requirements and bidirectional traceability using DOORS.

• Define digital circuit architectures and evaluate performance, timing, and FPGA resource tradeoffs.

• Perform RTL simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, timing analysis, and timing closure using tools such as ModelSim, Synplify, and Vivado.

• Develop verification plans, procedures, and testbenches using VHDL or SystemVerilog.

• Conduct functional testing, quantitative analyses, and design and verification reviews.

• Manage design files and revisions using configuration management tools such as Git or Subversion.

• 5+ years of related FPGA experience.

• U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Active Secret security clearance.

• Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Experience supporting a complete DO-254 lifecycle, including formal reviews and certification activities.

• Experience using Python, TCL, or similar scripting languages to automate FPGA development and verification activities.

jobs.title: Manager, Business Operations, Specialty Travel & Events
jobs.description:
The Specialty Travel & Events Business Operations team is built to solve our organization's most critical, emergent challenges across business, product, and operations. As a Manager-level individual contributor, you will have the unique opportunity to scope, design, and drive high-impact initiatives that support business growth, optimization, and stability.

This is a role for a first-principles thinker. You are someone who can look at a highly complex business challenge, map out the unseen connections between teams and systems, and help design a creative, elegant path forward. You aren't just managing projects; you are critically evaluating how our business runs, leveraging data to challenge assumptions, and driving the hands-on execution of some of our most important strategic initiatives.

What You'll Do

• Drive Strategic Initiatives: Execute on high-impact, 0-to-1 operational initiatives end-to-end. Investigate complex, ambiguous problems, develop rigorous work plans, and drive day-to-day execution.

• Solve Complex Systems Problems: Identify operational bottlenecks and help design scalable processes that allow cross-functional teams (Sales, Operations, Data Analytics, Finance, etc.) to work together seamlessly.

• Synthesize Data into Strategy: Dig into raw business data (using Excel, SQL, or other systems) to reveal patterns and truths behind operational challenges. Translate these findings into clear, actionable recommendations for leadership and cross-functional partners.

• Balance Trade-offs: Anticipate roadblocks and partner with leadership to find the right balance between strategic business goals and technical or financial constraints.

• Manage Change and Execution: Clearly communicate progress, manage stakeholder alignment, and guide cross-functional teams through process changes without losing momentum.

• Unblock and Accelerate: Anticipate technical bottlenecks, call out trade-offs between business desires and constraints, and keep project teams aligned and moving forward.

What We’re Looking For

• Experience: 4–6 years of experience in business operations, strategy, or a highly strategic cross-functional operations role in a fast-paced environment.

• Influence Without Authority: Proven track record of managing cross-functional relationships, building alignment, and driving results across diverse teams without direct management authority.

• Analytical Tooling: Strong comfort with data. You should be highly proficient in Excel/Google Sheets and comfortable using SQL (or eager to leverage it) to query databases, join tables, and extract your own insights.

• Education: BA or BS degree (or equivalent practical experience).

• Natural Systems Thinker: You intuitively see how different parts of an organization, workflow, and technology stack interconnect. You don't build temporary "band-aid" fixes; you design systems that hold complex, interdependent relationships in balance.

• Intellectual Humility & Curiosity: You approach problems with a "beginner’s mind." You have the self-critical awareness to challenge your own initial assumptions, ask deeply thoughtful questions before forming a plan, and actively seek out diverse perspectives to find the best solution.

• Data-Driven Critical Thinker: You don't make decisions based on gut feel alone. You are energized by messy, fragmented data, and you know how to ask the right questions, connect the dots, and find the narrative within a raw dataset.

• High Momentum (Anti-"Swirl"): You move quickly and decisively. While you are thorough, you do not get caught in analysis paralysis or allow yourself to be dragged sideways by organizational noise. You know how to maintain focus and keep projects moving forward.

• Collaborative & Growth-Minded: You love being in rooms with brilliant people who challenge you. Instead of feeling intimidated, you use those environments as fuel to grow, learn, and elevate your own capabilities.

Preferred Experience

• Prior experience in business operations or strategic program management in a high-growth tech environment.

• Experience driving organizational change management alongside system or process rollouts.

jobs.title: Product Specialist | Healthcare Billing
jobs.description:
🌿 MISSION

The US healthcare system is complex, error-prone, and financially draining. Medical bills and insurance coverage shouldn't be this hard to navigate. At Granted, we're building the one solution every American can turn to for help.

Thanks to AI and new regulations, Granted can fight claim denials, correct billing errors, negotiate bills, and make coverage easier to understand — saving people time, money, and stress. Our goal is simple: to be the #1 platform that empowers all Americans to take charge of their healthcare.




🏢 ABOUT US

Founded by a former Oscar Health leader, we're a seed-stage company with $17M in funding. We're lucky to be backed by the founders and investors at Hugging Face, Rocket Money, Oscar Health, CaseText, Forerunner Ventures, RRE Ventures, and more. We are well-funded for the next few years.




🧭 ABOUT THE ROLE

Granted lowers people's healthcare costs and cuts down on admin and stress. We're building the AI-native patient financial OS — the first purpose-built company working entirely on the user's side of the healthcare system, unequivocally advocating for consumers.

The hook is bill lowering. People come to us when they have a medical bill they can't afford or don't understand. Granted checks it — catches errors, overcharges, and denials, secures financial assistance, and negotiates with providers. Our Healthcare Advocates (HAs) and AI agents work those cases together.

This is primarily a strategy role, but you're not afraid of getting in the weeds of case-work. You've seen medical billing from inside the system, and you use that judgment to find what's systematically leaving money on the table — then turn it into the rules, playbooks, and product logic that make every case better. You'll look across hundreds of cases, spot the patterns an individual advocate wouldn't, and decide what Granted should build, change, or automate next.

You'll sit between Product and CX. With Product, you're the healthcare brain behind our bill-lowering AI: what's lowerable, how, and with what confidence. With CX, you raise advocacy quality across the HA team. When Product ships something that changes how advocates work, you make sure it lands.

A typical week may look like: strategic bill analysis and pattern-finding (~40%), product partnership (~30%), advocacy quality and escalation (~20%), with the remainder on process and enablement for the HA team.




🛠 WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Review uploaded bills each week and analyze: lowerable or not, how, with what confidence, and what data would change your mind. This analysis tunes our bill checker and intake.

 - Look across open and closed cases to find systematic opportunities — where advocates or AI agents are leaving savings on the table — and translate the patterns into strategy, process changes, and product input.

 - Be the escalation point for VIP, high-complexity, and specialized cases.

 - Act as strategic partner to Product as the domain owner on our AI bill analyzer — shaping what we build and how we automate.

 - Partner on the playbooks, training, and onboarding that lets quality scale as the HA team grows (led with CX, not owned solo).

 - Make sure features that touch HA workflows land with the context advocates need.

 - Publish weekly reports on opportunities for the HA team.

 - Stretch: turn user and advocate pain points from casework into input for the roadmap




🧰 YOU'LL BRING


MUST-HAVES:

 - 4+ years of work experience in a complex consumer industry.

 - Experience in a strategy, product, or operations role at a tech company where you built something from scratch.

 - Fluency in how a medical bill gets built, from CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS coding to the EOB, and how to lower one through appeals, financial assistance policies, No Surprises Act protections, and tactful negotiations.

 - Comfort in a fast-moving startup: scrappy, sharp, and quick to ramp on new products and tools.


NICE-TO-HAVES:

 - Time spent on both the provider and payer sides of a bill.

 - Hands-on work with AI or agentic tools in a billing, clinical, or ops setting.

 - Experience working directly with patients, such as advocacy, care navigation, or patient financial services.

 - Experience training or leading a team of billers, advocates, or specialists.




✨ YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You're comfortable with ambiguous projects that impact several teams

 - You consider yourself a subject matter expert in healthcare navigation

 - You're comfortable with a scope that shifts as the product and team learn




📍 WHERE YOU'LL WORK

Office based Chelsea, NYC - in-office Monday through Thursday, with Fridays remote.

jobs.title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Manchester, United Kingdom
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

• Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

• Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on

• Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests

• Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work

• Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them

• Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there

• Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows

• A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does

• A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster

• The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally

• Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for

• Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec

• Excellent communication skills

Bonus

• Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects

• Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

• Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

jobs.title: Mechanical Hardware Test Engineer - Failure Analysis (Starlink)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

MECHANICAL HARDWARE TEST ENGINEER – FAILURE ANALYSIS (STARLINK)

As a Mechanical Hardware Test Engineer, you will solve challenging, high impact problems for the Starlink network. We are producing complex vacuum amplifier hardware at orders of magnitude higher rate than anyone in history and this role will play a critical part in making it highly reliable. This requires extreme critical thinking skills and a desire to learn about nuanced, cutting edge technology. The most important skillset is demonstrated problem solving ability – in whatever form that may be.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Perform detailed failure analysis of novel high voltage vacuum amplifiers on both new-production and active-service units

• Perform advanced physical failure analysis using SEM, FIB, EDS, cross-sectioning, and related techniques to identify failure mechanisms in functional materials

• Collaborate with design, manufacturing, and supply chain teams to improve product reliability and manufacturing processes

• Apply physics-of-failure principles and develop deep knowledge of vacuum tube failure modes to determine root causes

• Develop and improve failure analysis techniques and workflows to support new manufacturing technologies and advanced materials

• Monitor yield rates and quality metrics, driving corrective actions to address non-conforming products

• Drive continual improvements to designs by building physical and digital tools to analyze data collected both in the field and in the lab

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in materials science, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, physics, chemical engineering, or other STEM discipline

• 1+ years of experience in hardware development, failure analysis, or reliability engineering (internships, co-ops, and extracurriculars acceptable)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Master’s degree in STEM discipline

• Excellent problem-solving, communication, and technical writing skills

• Experience with electronics, mechanical design, analysis, and knowledge of RF principles

• Direct experience with hardware failure analysis tools and techniques (SEM, FIB, EDS, cross-sectioning, fault isolation, or equivalent)

• Experience analyzing complex datasets with Python, AI

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to work overtime and weekends as needed for mission critical dead lines

• Ability to work in a cleanroom or ESD-controlled environment when required

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:

Level 1: $100,000.00 - $135,000.00
Level 2: $115,000.00 - $165,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

About the Role

6sense is seeking a Customer Success Manager, Advertising to help customers get measurable value from their advertising programs and grow their use of 6sense Advertising over time. In this post-sale role, you’ll serve as the trusted advisor for a portfolio of advertising customers - guiding onboarding, activation, adoption, campaign success, value realization, and renewal readiness.

You’ll partner closely with customers and internal teams to connect business goals to audience strategy, campaign performance, and clear next steps. You’ll also help identify opportunities to expand advertising usage by building the customer success foundation that makes growth possible.

What You’ll Do

• Own post-sale success for a portfolio of 6sense Advertising customers, ensuring clear goals, success plans, risks, and next steps.

• Advise customers on audience strategy, campaign structure, targeting, channel mix, budget allocation, measurement, and optimization.

• Partner with Campaign Operations, Professional Services, Product, Support, Sales, and Account teams to deliver a coordinated customer experience.

• Monitor campaign delivery, pacing, utilization, and performance; translate results into insights, recommendations, and customer-ready narratives.

• Drive adoption of relevant advertising capabilities, workflows, audiences, reporting, and best practices.

• Lead customer conversations and business reviews focused on performance, value, stakeholder alignment, and future opportunities.

• Identify risks early, coordinate recovery plans, and keep customers on track for successful renewal outcomes.

• Surface qualified expansion opportunities and partner with commercial owners on next steps.

• Contribute to the evolution of playbooks and processes that are at the core of 6sense customers’ advertising success.

What You’ll Bring

• 5+ years of customer-facing experience in Customer Success, client services, consulting, account management, or a related post-sale role within SaaS, adtech, or martech.

• 3+ years of hands-on experience with digital advertising or programmatic advertising campaigns.

• Strong understanding of campaign planning, audience strategy, targeting, pacing, optimization, reporting, measurement, and common advertising KPIs.

• Ability to build trusted relationships with practitioners and executive stakeholders and connect platform usage to measurable business outcomes.

• Analytical mindset with the ability to turn campaign and account data into clear insights, recommendations, and customer-ready stories.

• Proven ability to manage risk, drive adoption, lead business reviews, and coordinate cross-functional work across internal and customer teams.

• Excellent communication, presentation, project-management, and stakeholder-management skills.

• Preferred: experience with B2B advertising, ABM, demand generation, intent-based audiences, DSPs, Salesforce, Gainsight, BI/reporting tools, or the 6sense platform.

Base Salary Range: $79,567.50 - $116,699.00. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). #Li-remote

From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.

jobs.description:
Title: Patient Coordinator
Practice: Northern Virginia Oral Surgery Centers
Location: Warrenton, Virginia
Hours:

Monday | 8am - 4:30pm
Tuesday | 8am - 4:30pm
Wednesday | 8am - 4:30pm
Thursday | 8am - 4:30pm
Friday | 8am - 4pm
Saturday | Closed
Sunday | Closed

Position Purpose:

The Patient Coordinator is a key member of our healthcare team, responsible for ensuring smooth and efficient patient flow and coordination within our practice. This role involves direct patient interaction, administrative support, and collaboration with clinical staff to deliver excellent patient care and service.

Essential Functions

Patient Interaction and Support:

• Greet and welcome patients upon arrival.

• Assist patients with check-in and check-out processes.

• Provide information on clinic policies, procedures, and services.

• Answer patient phone calls and address inquiries promptly and professionally.

• Schedule and confirm patient appointments, ensuring optimal appointment utilization.

• Monitor schedules for patient cancellations and follow-up with patients that need to reschedule.

Administrative Duties:

• Maintain and update patient records in the electronic health record (EHR) system.

• Coordinate referrals, diagnostic tests, and follow-up appointments.

• Verify patient insurance information and manage prior authorization processes.

• Handle billing and payment processes, including collection of co-pays and outstanding balances.

• Prepare and manage patient forms and documentation.

• Other duties as assigned by the practice administrator.

Communication and Coordination:

• Serve as a liaison between patients, healthcare providers, and other staff members.

• Communicate effectively with clinical staff to ensure patient needs are met.

• Facilitate communication regarding patient care plans and instructions.

Customer Service:

• Always maintain a high standard of customer service and professionalism.

• Address patient complaints and escalate issues to management when necessary.

• Strive to create a positive and supportive environment for patients and their families.

Compliance and Confidentiality:

• Adhere to all healthcare regulations and privacy laws, including HIPAA.

• Ensure patient confidentiality and security of sensitive information.

• Follow clinic policies and procedures to maintain compliance with healthcare standards.

Qualifications

Education:

• High school diploma or equivalency, required.

Experience:

• Previous experience in a healthcare setting, particularly in patient coordination or administrative roles, is highly desirable.

• Proficiency in using electronic health record (EHR) systems and other office software.

• Knowledge of relevant regulations and compliance requirements in healthcare.

Performance Requirements:

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks concurrently.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a patient-centered approach.

• Approachable, professional demeanor

• Detail-oriented and thorough in task execution.

• Ability to work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

• Team player with excellent collaboration skills.

What we do for you:

• We offer Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance plans to our full-time employees.

• Two out of the three medical plans offered include Health Savings Account (HSA) eligibility.

• Company-paid Life, AD&D and Long-Term Disability coverage.

• Additional Voluntary Life and AD&D Insurance for you and your family!

• Voluntary Short-Term Disability Insurance available to you as well

• Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA) offered.

• Immediately begin saving for retirement through our 401(k) starting with very first paycheck!

• Employer 401(k) contribution and Profit Sharing after six months of employment

• PTO and 8 Paid holidays for fulltime employees!

DISCLAIMER

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the work being performed by people assigned to this work.  This is not an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities.  OPS’s management reserves the right to amend and change responsibilities to meet business and organizational needs as necessary.

jobs.title: Photonics Engineer - Fiber Amplifiers, Satellites (Starlink)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

PHOTONICS ENGINEER - FIBER AMPLIFIERS, SATELLITES (STARLINK)

Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and the leading global satellite internet provider. The laser communications team develops the high-power optical links that interconnect Starlink satellites enabling a high-throughput, low-latency global network. This role focuses on the fiber amplifier systems that are central to those links: high-performance, high-reliability amplifiers that must operate in the extreme thermal, radiation, and vacuum environment of space.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Own the development of fiber amplifier systems for laser communications, including requirements definition, system design and analysis, and design validation.

• Conduct validation and verification testing, including environmental qualification (thermal, TVAC, and radiation considerations), performance characterization, reliability testing, and fault injection testing

• Work closely with manufacturing and supply chain teams to ensure final designs can be manufactured in accordance with overall project goals

• Represent the photonic system in program-level, cross-disciplinary trades and issue resolution

• Lead optical architecture definition through internal trade studies, concept of operations definition, and risk reduction testing

• Lead anomaly investigations through to resolution.

• Maintain link budgets, design specifications, and system capabilities data.

• Collaborate with software and automation teams to develop tools and protocols for automated tested of fiber amplifier systems.

• Represent laser communications systems for reliability and risk discussions with internal reliability teams, management, customers, and vendors.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in physics, optics, electrical engineering, or other engineering/STEM discipline

• 2+ years of hands-on laboratory or work experience in fiber-based optical systems/networks, integrated photonics chips, or fiber laser technology (university lab, student project, or internship experience qualifies)

• 1+ years of experience in a computer programming language (e.g. C++, MATLAB, and/or Python)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Master's degree or PhD in physics or an engineering discipline

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in engineering capacity in the field of fiber amplifiers, laser systems, or opto-electronics.

• Hands-on experience in fiber amplifier design, integration, and test

• Experience with high-power fiber system design, mitigation of non-linearities, and thermal management

• Hands-on experience with optical pump lasers, fiber combiners, filters, and large-mode-area (LMA) fiber, electro-optic modulators.

• Competence with fiber optics processing and handling (cleaving, stripping, splicing, recoating, glass processing, etc.)

• Experience with characterizing fiber laser systems using optical test equipment (power meters, spectral analyzers, high-speed photodiodes, oscilloscopes, laser sources, beam profilers)

• Knowledge of and experience in precision metrology techniques, manufacturing and integration processes

• Experience leading the development of commercial photonics products

• Experience with hardware development for high-reliability applications

• Competence with Python scripting and a Linux operating system environment

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, autonomously driven, and demanding atmosphere

• Ability to assess risk and make design and development decisions without all available data

• Experience with laser safety best practices

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:

Level 1: $105,000.00 - $145,000.00
Level 2: $120,000.00 - $175,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.
